  (`realizability_needs_i1`);
* frame transitions: `enterFrame`, `spawn`, `exitFrameC` with reparenting, `terminate`, `join`
  (`frames_run`), and `join` on a live context has no outcome (`join_waits`);
* two `newMutex` on two protected roots owned by the same field share one controller
  (`shared_controller`, report).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Traces

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Mutex value (WC2 C12, C13) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `m`, `1` its field `data`, `2` its field `lock`, `3`
the protected value `T`, a root owned by `data`; every leaf `Init`. -/
def mst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- The reference layout (WC2 C12): `guarded` is held by the first field, the controller is the
second. -/
def L0 : MutexLayout := ⟨0, 1⟩

/-- Initial single-context state (Spec 1 §47): root authority `0` of `m` held by frame 0, root
authority `1` of `T` held by `data` (place 1). -/
def c0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst)

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem mst_ok : StaticsOK mst := by decide

/-- After `newMutex(guarded = 1)` (WC2 C13). -/
def reg1 : SyncReg := [⟨1, none⟩]

/-- `newMutex(1)` executed by context 0 is enabled on `c0`; its controller is place 2. -/
theorem newMutex_ok : NewMutexOk L0 [] c0 [] 0 1 (c0, reg1) ∧
    ControlOf L0 c0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide⟩

/-! ## Theorem 4: counterexample without encapsulation (WC2 C22) -/

/-- `derive(guarded = 1, footprint(T) = [3], Observe)` by context 0, the exclusive owner. -/
def c1 : SC := c0.set (deriveEff (c0.view 0) 1 [3] .observe)

/-- The derivation is an enabled kernel step (Spec 1 §60) and it is not encapsulated. -/
theorem derive_step : opStepC K0 (.derive 1 [3] .observe) 0 c0 (.ok c1) ∧
    ¬ Encap (c0, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .observe)) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, fun h => h ⟨1, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl⟩

/-- Theorem 4, second half (WC2 C22): after the non-encapsulated `derive`, the entry is live with
`grant = none`, `GrantDiscipline` fails, and `acquire` is not enabled. -/
theorem acquire_blocked_by_derive : (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live c1 ∧ ¬ GrantDiscipline c1 reg1 ∧
    ∀ st', ¬ AcquireOk K0 L0 c1 reg1 0 0 st' := by
  refine ⟨by decide, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := h ⟨1, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl
    exact (by decide : ¬ NoCoveringDesc c1 1) this
  · rintro st' ⟨-, e, he, -, hd, -⟩
    simp only [reg1, List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at he
    subst he
    exact (by decide : ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC K0 L0 reg1) c1 0 1) hd

/-- The grant created by `acquire` on `c0` (WC2 C15, C16). -/
def c2 : SC := deriveSyncEff c0 0 1

/-- Registry after `acquire` (WC2 C16): the grant is authority 2. -/
def reg2 : SyncReg := [⟨1, some 2⟩]

/-- Positive twin (WC2 C16): without the derivation, `acquire` is enabled and records the grant. -/
theorem acquire_enabled : AcquireOk K0 L0 c0 reg1 0 0 (c2, reg2) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨1, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- State after `unlock` (WC2 C17). -/
def c3 : SC := c2.set (releaseEff (c2.view 0) 2)

/-- `unlock` is enabled after `acquire` (WC2 C17). -/
theorem unlock_enabled : UnlockOk L0 c2 reg2 0 0 (c3, reg1) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨1, some 2⟩, 2, rfl, by decide, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- An encapsulated trace `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock` from `c0` with an empty registry (WC2
C13, C16, C17, C22). -/
theorem mutex_trace : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (c0, [])
    [.newMutex 0 1 [], .acquire 0 0, .unlock 0 0] (c3, reg1) :=
  .cons trivial (.newMutex newMutex_ok.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.acquire acquire_enabled) <|
  .cons trivial (.unlock unlock_enabled) .nil

/-! ## Theorem 5 needs the kernel invariant (WC2 C25; Spec 1 §50) -/

/-- `c0` with an extra active root `Modify` authority over `T` held by frame 0, unrelated to
`guarded` (violates I1, Spec 1 §50). -/
def bad : SC := { c0 with A := c0.A ++ [⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 0, true⟩] }

/-- Theorem 5 is false without the kernel invariant: in `bad`, `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and
the library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` hold for the current frame of context 0, `I1`
fails, and the preconditions of `deriveSync` fail (Spec 1 §60.3). -/
theorem realizability_needs_i1 : SyncInv L0 bad reg1 ∧ GrantDiscipline bad reg1 ∧
    LibSyncAuthorized L0 reg1 bad 1 (bad.view 0).top ∧ ¬ I1 bad.flat ∧
    ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC K0 L0 reg1) bad 0 1 := by
  have hl : ∀ {i : Nat} {e : SyncEntry}, reg1[i]? = some e → i = 0 ∧ e = ⟨1, none⟩ := by
    intro i e h
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [reg1] at h; exact ⟨rfl, h.symm⟩
    | succ i => simp [reg1] at h
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, by decide, fun h => ?_, by decide⟩
  · intro e he _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · intro e he _ g hg; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; cases hg
  · intro e he _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · intro i j e e' hi hj _ _ _; rw [(hl hi).1, (hl hj).1]
  · intro e he _ _; simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · have := h 1 2 ⟨.modify, none, [3], .place 1, true⟩ ⟨.modify, none, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ 3
      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    cases this.1

/-! ## Frame transitions (WC2 C4, C6–C8) -/

/-- Context 0 enters a call frame (frame 1) without parameter nor local (Spec 1 §72). -/
def f1 : SC := enterEffC c0 0 [] []
/-- From frame 1, context 0 spawns context 1 (frame 2, parent 1) with one local (place 4) (WC2
C4). -/
def f2 : SC := spawnEff f1 0 [] [(none, 0)]
/-- Frame 1 exits; context 1 is reparented to frame 0 (WC2 C6). -/
def f3 : SC := exitEffC f2 0
/-- Context 1 terminates (WC2 C7). -/
def f4 : SC := termEffC f3 1

/-- A run of frame transitions (WC2 C4, C6–C8): `enterFrame`, `spawn`, `exitFrameC` (reparenting
context 1 from the exiting frame 1 to its caller 0), `terminate`, `join`. -/
theorem frames_run : opStepC K0 (.enter [] []) 0 c0 (.ok f1) ∧ SpawnStep f1 0 [] [(none, 0)] (.ok f2) ∧
    f2.ctxParent 1 = some 1 ∧ opStepC K0 .exit 0 f2 (.ok f3) ∧ f3.ctxParent 1 = some 0 ∧
    TermStep K0 f3 1 (.ok f4) ∧ JoinStep f4 0 1 (.ok f4) := by
  refine ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide,
    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, .ok (by decide) ?_⟩
  decide

/-- WC2 C8 (brief: waiting is a non-enabled transition): while context 1 is live, `join` has no
outcome. -/
theorem join_waits : ∀ o, ¬ JoinStep f3 0 1 o := by
  intro o h
  cases h with
  | ok _ hd => exact (by decide : ¬ OptP (f3.C[1]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False) hd

/-- `ancestorC` across contexts after `spawn` (WC2 C3): the creating frame 1 and the base frame 0
are ancestors of the initial frame 2 of context 1; after `exitFrameC`, frame 0 still is. -/
theorem ancestry : f2.ancestorC 1 2 ∧ f2.ancestorC 0 2 ∧ ¬ f2.ancestorC 2 1 ∧
    f3.ancestorC 0 2 ∧ ¬ f3.ancestorC 1 2 := by decide

/-! ## Non-vacuity of the re-indexed kernel invariant (WC2 C20) -/

/-- `FramesC` from bounded, decidable clauses (decision procedure for WC2 C3). -/
theorem framesC_of {s : SC} (h0 : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False)
    (hne : ∀ c ∈ List.range s.C.length, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []) (hnd : s.frames.Nodup)
    (hb : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF)
    (hr : ∀ c ∈ List.range s.C.length, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none)
    (hp : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, OptP (s.parC f) (fun g => g ∈ s.frames ∧ g < f) True) : FramesC s := by
  have hlt : ∀ c, s.Live c → c < s.C.length := fun c hc => by
    unfold SC.Live at hc; unfold OptP at hc; split at hc
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · exact hc.elim
  refine ⟨h0, fun c hc => hne c (List.mem_range.2 (hlt c hc)) hc, hnd, hb,
    fun c h0 hc => hr c (List.mem_range.2 (hlt c hc)) h0 hc, fun f hf g hg => ?_⟩
  have := hp f hf; rw [hg] at this; exact this

/-- The initial single-context state satisfies the re-indexed kernel invariant (WC2 C20, C24). -/
theorem c0_kInvC : KInvC c0 := by
  refine (single_kInvC ⟨_, rfl⟩).2 ⟨framesC_of (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide) (by decide), ?_⟩
  exact (init_kinv mst_ok).1

/-- The two-context state `f2` (after `spawn` from a call frame) satisfies the re-indexed kernel
invariant (WC2 C20): `KInvC` is not vacuous on multi-context states. -/
theorem f2_kInvC : KInvC f2 := by
  have hk := (Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.KInvB.sound (s := f2.flat) (by decide)).1
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩, -, hno⟩ := hk
  exact ⟨⟨framesC_of (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), hw⟩,
    ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, fun _ => i4_always _⟩, by decide, hnd⟩, by decide, hno⟩

/-! ## Two entries sharing a controller (report, WC2 C12 and C13) -/

/-- Statics: the mutex value `m = {data, lock}` and two protected roots `T₁`, `T₂` both owned by
`data`. -/
def mst2 : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- Initial state: root authorities 1 (of `T₁`) and 2 (of `T₂`) are both held by `data`. -/
def d0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst2)

/-- WC2 C12 requires distinct controller associations for different mutex instances; the
preconditions formalized from WC2 C13 accept `newMutex(1)` then `newMutex(2)`, and both entries
have the same positional controller (place 2). -/
theorem shared_controller : NewMutexOk L0 [] d0 [] 0 1 (d0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧
    NewMutexOk L0 [] d0 [⟨1, none⟩] 0 2 (d0, [⟨1, none⟩, ⟨2, none⟩]) ∧
    ControlOf L0 d0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 d0 ⟨2, none⟩ = some 2 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide, by decide⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.Traces

/-! ## `deriveSync` (WC2 C15) -/

/-- `deriveSync` preserves the re-indexed invariant (Spec 1 §57, §60; WC2 C15, C20) when
`guarded` has own mode `Modify` (WC2 C12, C21.1: the `guarded` of a live entry; WC2 C15 "mode
restrictions"). Without it the statement is false: `deriveSync_breaks_i2`. -/
theorem deriveSync_preserves {kc : KC} {s : SC} {c g : Nat} (hk : KInvCA s)
    (hpre : DeriveSyncPre kc s c g)
    (hmode : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify) False) :
    KInvCA (deriveSyncEff s c g) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hb, hd, hc, hh⟩ := view_facts hk c
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa⟩ := hpre.active
  have hxm : x.mode = .modify := by
    have hx' : s.A[g]? = some x := hx
    simp only [OptP, hx'] at hmode; exact hmode
  have hafp : (s.view c).afp g = x.footprint := by simp [S3.afp, hx]
  have hbase := addAuth_preserves hw hb hx xa (by rw [hxm]; exact Mode.le_refl _)
    (fun p hp => by rw [← hafp]; exact hp) hpre.modeOK
    (hd := .frame (s.view c).top) hpre.frameLive
  have hd' : NoDangling (deriveEff (s.view c) g ((s.view c).afp g) .modify) := by
    intro j z hz za q hq l hl hlz
    have hU := S3.Usable.congr (q := q) (s := s.view c)
      (s' := deriveEff (s.view c) g ((s.view c).afp g) .modify) rfl rfl rfl
    rcases addAuth_get hz with ⟨-, hz⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact hd j z hz za q (fun hu => hq (hU.2 hu)) l hl hlz
    · rw [hafp] at hlz
      exact hd g x hx xa q (fun hu => hq (hU.2 hu)) l hl hlz
    exact store_preserves hk hpre
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact push_preserves hk hpre.params hpre.localsOK (enter_push hk.1.1.1 hpre.callerLive)
      hpre.anchorOrderHeld
  | derive | split | release | read | write | writeShared | pin | unpin | endUse | free | alloc =>
    obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
    cases o₃ with
    | ok t =>
      cases ho
      exact viewOp_preserves hdd hk hR (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
    | reject => cases ho
    | fail => cases ho

/-- Theorem 2 (WC2 C4, C20, C23): `spawn` (with the preconditions `SpawnPreBase`) preserves `KInvC`
with the auxiliaries on the flat state: the new context has the fresh frame `nF`, child of the
creating frame; the kernel effect is that of Spec 1 §72. -/
theorem spawn_preservesC {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hk : KInvCA s) (h : SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s')) : KInvCA s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact push_preserves hk hpre.params hpre.localsOK (spawn_push hk.1.1.1 hpre.creatorLive)
    hpre.anchorOrderHeld

/-- Theorem 2 (WC2 C8, C20): `join` leaves the state unchanged, hence preserves the invariant. -/
theorem join_preservesC {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} (hk : KInvCA s) (h : JoinStep s c d (.ok s')) :
    KInvCA s' := by
  cases h; exact hk

/-- Theorem 2 (WC2 C15, C20, C23) for `deriveSync`, when `guarded` has own mode `Modify` (WC2
C12, C21.1; WC2 C15 "mode restrictions"). The unrestricted statement is false:
`deriveSync_breaks_i2`. -/
theorem deriveSync_preservesC {kc : KC} {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat} (hk : KInvCA s)
    (hmode : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify) False)
    (h : DeriveSyncStep kc s c g (.ok s')) : KInvCA s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact deriveSync_preserves hk hpre hmode

/-- WC2 C15 replaces the conjunct `ExercisableAt(source, Modify)` of Spec 1 §60.1, which bounds
the requested mode by the own mode of the source, by `SyncAuthorized`; §60.2 bounds it only leaf
by leaf. With an opaque `SyncAuthorized` that holds, `deriveSync` from an active `Observe`
authority with an empty footprint (authority 3, derived by frame 0 from the root of static 0)
creates a `Modify` derivative and breaks `I2` (Spec 1 §51: "does not elevate its mode"), from a
state satisfying the invariant. -/
theorem deriveSync_breaks_i2 :
    ∃ (kc : KC) (s s' : SC), KInvCA s ∧ DeriveSyncStep kc s 0 3 (.ok s') ∧ ¬ I2 s'.flat := by
  let t := deriveEff Examples.s0 0 [] .observe
  let s := SC.ofS3 t
  let kc : KC := { Examples.K0 with SyncAuthorized := fun _ _ _ => True }
  have hreach : Reachable Examples.K0 Examples.st t :=
    .step .init (KStep.derive (src := 0) (region := []) (m := .observe) (.ok (by decide)))
  obtain ⟨hkt, hat, hht⟩ := reachable_inv (fun _ _ h => (h : False).elim) (by decide) hreach
  have hs : s.Single := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hts : s.toS3 = t := rfl
  have hfr : FramesC s :=
    { initial := by simp [s, SC.ofS3, OptP]
      nonempty := by
        intro c hc
        unfold SC.Live at hc
        cases c with
        | zero => simp [s, SC.stk, SC.ofS3, t, deriveEff, S3.addAuth, Examples.s0, S3.init]
        | succ c => simp [s, SC.ofS3, OptP] at hc
      nodup := by decide
      bound := by decide
      rooted := by
        intro c hc hl
        unfold SC.Live at hl
        cases c with
        | zero => exact absurd rfl hc
        | succ c => simp [s, SC.ofS3, OptP] at hl
      parent := by decide }
  have hflat : s.flat = t := by rw [single_flat hs, hts]
  refine ⟨kc, s, deriveSyncEff s 0 3, ⟨(single_kInvC hs).2 ⟨hfr, hts ▸ hkt⟩,
    by rw [hflat]; exact hat, by rw [hflat]; exact hht⟩,
    ⟨by decide, .ok ⟨by decide, trivial, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
      by decide⟩⟩, fun h2 => ?_⟩
  have e4 : (deriveSyncEff s 0 3).flat.A[4]? =
      some ⟨.modify, some 3, [], .frame 0, true⟩ := by decide
  have e3 : (deriveSyncEff s 0 3).flat.A[3]? =
      some ⟨.observe, some 0, [], .frame 0, true⟩ := by decide
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hm, -⟩ := h2 4 _ 3 e4 rfl
  rw [e3] at hx; cases hx
  simp [Mode.le] at hm

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib

/-!
# Preservation of the synchronization invariants (WC2 C21–C23)

Theorem 4 of the brief, preservation half: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5) and
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) are preserved by every labelled step `LStep` taken under the
encapsulation hypothesis `Encap` (WC2 C22, C23), together with two auxiliary invariants that are
not WC2 clauses (`GrantSubtree`, `RegBound`). The kernel facts about the states before and after
a step (`KInvC` before, `ConcurrentWF` after) are hypotheses supplied by theorem 2 (preservation of
the re-indexed kernel invariant).

`newMutex_nonleaf_rejected` shows the role of the leaf clause of `NewMutexPreBase.control` (WC2
C12, C13.3): a positional controller that is not a leaf would break `SyncInv.control`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Auxiliary invariants (not WC2 clauses) -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause (needed by `unlock`, WC2 C17): while the recorded grant
of a live entry is active, every active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf is the
grant or one of its descendants. -/
def GrantSubtree (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause: every registered `guarded` identity exists (an entry
cannot become live by the creation of a fresh authority). -/
def RegBound (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The preserved conjunction: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) with the
auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg ∧ GrantSubtree s reg ∧ RegBound s reg

namespace SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Per-entry decomposition -/

/-- The clauses of `SyncState` about one entry (WC2 C21.1–C21.3, C22, auxiliaries). -/
structure EntryOK (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop where
  guarded : e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  grant : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  control : e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  disc : e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
  sub : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  bound : e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The global clause of `SyncState` (WC2 C21.5). -/
def Uniq (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' → e.Live s →
    e'.Live s → e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j

/-- `SyncState` is the per-entry clauses and uniqueness (WC2 C21, C22). -/
theorem syncState_iff {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} :
    SyncState L s reg ↔ (∀ e ∈ reg, EntryOK L s e) ∧ Uniq s reg := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hg, ht, hb⟩
    exact ⟨fun e he => ⟨hi.guarded e he, hi.grant e he, hi.control e he, hg e he, ht e he,
      hb e he⟩, hi.unique⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hu⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun e he => (h e he).guarded, fun e he => (h e he).grant,
      fun e he => (h e he).control, hu⟩, fun e he => (h e he).disc, fun e he => (h e he).sub,
      fun e he => (h e he).bound⟩

/-! ## Controller -/

/-- Unfolding of the positional `ControlOf` (WC2 C12). -/
theorem controlOf_spec {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (h : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) : ∃ y hp m, s.A[e.guarded]? = some y ∧
      y.holder = .place hp ∧ parentOf s.P hp = some m ∧
      (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp ∧ (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? = some ctl := by
  unfold ControlOf at h
  cases hy : s.A[e.guarded]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at h; simp at h
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at h
    cases hh : y.holder with
    | frame f => simp [hh] at h
    | place hp =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, hh] at h
      cases hm : parentOf s.P hp with
      | none => rw [hm] at h; cases h
      | some m =>
        rw [hm] at h
        by_cases hk : (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp
        · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte] at h; exact ⟨y, hp, m, rfl, hh, hm, hk, h⟩
        · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte] at h; cases h

/-- The controller of a live entry is usable when the place holding `guarded` is (WC2 C12: the
fields of the mutex value share its owner and death marker, Spec 1 §49.2). -/
theorem control_usable {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hl : e.Live s) (h : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) : s.flat.Usable ctl := by
  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hh, hm, hk, hc⟩ := controlOf_spec h
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya⟩ := hl
  have hy' : s.flat.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
  rw [hy'] at hy₀; cases hy₀
  have hu : s.flat.Usable hp := by have := hw.holders _ _ hy' ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hc)).2
  have hpar : ∀ q, parentOf s.P q = some m → ∃ pl pm, s.P[q]? = some pl ∧ s.P[m]? = some pm ∧
      pm.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead m = s.dead q := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [parentOf] at hq
    cases hpl : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [hpl] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl =>
      rw [hpl] at hq
      obtain ⟨pm, hpm, -, ho, hd⟩ := hw.places q pl m hpl hq
      exact ⟨pl, pm, rfl, hpm, ho, hd⟩
  obtain ⟨ph, pm, hph, hpm, ho, hd⟩ := hpar hp hm
  obtain ⟨pc, pm', hpc, hpm', ho', hd'⟩ := hpar ctl hcm
  rw [hpm] at hpm'; cases hpm'
  exact S3.Usable.of_same hu hph hpc (by rw [← ho', ho]) (by
    show s.dead ctl = s.dead hp; rw [← hd', hd])

/-! ## Abstract effect of a step on authorities -/

/-- What a step does to authorities, read on the effects of Spec 1 §60–§75 re-indexed and of WC2
C4, C7, C8, C15: authorities are only added; an old authority keeps its footprint and mode, is
never reactivated, keeps an origin that stays active, and its origin chain only loses elements
(and keeps those that stay active, when it stays active); an added authority is a root or is
derived from an active authority within its footprint. -/
structure Skel (s s' : SC) : Prop where
  len : s.A.length ≤ s'.A.length
  old : ∀ j y', s'.A[j]? = some y' → j < s.A.length → ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧
    y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧ (y'.active = true → y.active = true) ∧
    (∀ o, y.origin = some o → s'.flat.Active o → y'.origin = some o)
  ancsSub : ∀ j, j < s.A.length → ∀ x ∈ s'.flat.ancs j, x ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  ancsKeep : ∀ j, j < s.A.length → s'.flat.Active j → ∀ x ∈ s.flat.ancs j, s'.flat.Active x →
    x ∈ s'.flat.ancs j
  new : ∀ j y', s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = none ∨
    ∃ o, y'.origin = some o ∧ o < s.A.length ∧ s.flat.Active o ∧
      (∀ l ∈ y'.footprint, l ∈ s.flat.afp o) ∧ s'.flat.ancs j = o :: s.flat.ancs o

section SkelLemmas

variable {s s' : SC}

/-- An index below the length has an element (Spec 1 §38: identities are indices). -/
theorem getElem?_of_lt {α : Type} {l : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < l.length) :
    ∃ x, l[i]? = some x :=
  ⟨l[i], List.getElem?_eq_getElem h⟩

/-- Footprint of an existing authority (Spec 1 §42). -/
theorem afp_of {t : SC} {j : Nat} {y : Authority} (h : t.A[j]? = some y) :
    t.flat.afp j = y.footprint := by
  show (match t.A[j]? with | some x => x.footprint | none => []) = _
  rw [h]

/-- An active authority exists (Spec 1 §42). -/
theorem active_lt {t : SC} {j : Nat} (h : t.flat.Active j) : j < t.A.length := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := h; exact lt_of_getElem? hy

/-- Activity after a step implies activity before it (no reactivation). -/
theorem Skel.active (hsk : Skel s s') {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) (h : s'.flat.Active x) :
    s.flat.Active x := by
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, ha, -⟩ := hsk.old x y' hy' hx
  exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya'⟩

/-- Footprints of existing authorities are kept by a step (Spec 1 §42). -/
theorem Skel.afp (hsk : Skel s s') {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    s'.flat.afp x = s.flat.afp x := by
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hx hsk.len)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hf, -⟩ := hsk.old x y' hy' hx
  rw [afp_of hy', afp_of hy, hf]

/-- A covering descendant (WC2 C22) after a step was one before it. -/
theorem Skel.covering (hsk : Skel s s') {g j : Nat} (hg : g < s.A.length) (hj : j < s.A.length)
    (h : CoveringDesc s' g j) : CoveringDesc s g j := by
  obtain ⟨hanc, hact, l, hl1, hl2⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hsk.ancsSub j hj g hanc, hsk.active hj hact, l, by rwa [← hsk.afp hj],
    by rwa [← hsk.afp hg]⟩

/-- A covering descendant created by the step is derived either directly from `g` or from a
covering descendant of the state before (WC2 C22). -/
theorem Skel.covering_new (hsk : Skel s s') {g j : Nat} (hg : g < s.A.length)
    (hj : s.A.length ≤ j) (h : CoveringDesc s' g j) : ∃ y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧
      y'.origin = some o ∧ (g = o ∨ CoveringDesc s g o) ∧ s'.flat.ancs j = o :: s.flat.ancs o := by
  obtain ⟨hanc, ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩, l, hl1, hl2⟩ := h
  have hy'' : s'.A[j]? = some y' := hy'
  rcases hsk.new j y' hy'' hj with ho | ⟨o, ho, hoA, hoa, hfp, hanc'⟩
  · have : s'.flat.org j = none := by simp [S3.org, hy', ho]
    rw [S3.ancs, chain_none this] at hanc; simp at hanc
  · refine ⟨y', o, hy'', ho, ?_, hanc'⟩
    rw [hanc'] at hanc
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hanc with rfl | hanc
    · exact .inl rfl
    · refine .inr ⟨hanc, hoa, l, hfp l (by rwa [afp_of hy''] at hl1), ?_⟩
      rwa [← hsk.afp hg]

end SkelLemmas

/-- One entry keeps its clauses across a step with an unchanged registry record (WC2 C21.1–C21.3,
C22, auxiliaries). `hsrc`: no authority added by the step is derived directly from `guarded`
(from `Encap`); `hhold`: a place-held `guarded` stays place-held; `hctl`: the controller stays
a leaf; `hw'`: `WF3` after the step (theorem 2). -/
theorem entry_step {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (he : EntryOK L s e)
    (hsrc : e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = some o →
      o ≠ e.guarded)
    (hhold : e.Live s' → ∀ y y', s.A[e.guarded]? = some y → s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' →
      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder → ∃ q, y'.holder = .place q)
    (hctl : e.Live s' → ∀ ctl, ControlOf L s e = some ctl → isLeaf s.P ctl →
      ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl') : EntryOK L s' e := by
  have hb := he.bound
  have hlive : e.Live s' → e.Live s := hsk.active hb
  refine ⟨fun hl => ?_, fun hl g₀ hg₀ => ?_, fun hl => ?_, fun hl hn => ?_,
    fun hl g₀ hg₀ ha₀ => ?_, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb hsk.len⟩
  · obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl
    have hy'' : s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' := hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -, hm, -⟩ := hsk.old _ y' hy'' hb
    have h1 := he.guarded (hlive ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩)
    simp only [OptP, hy] at h1
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hhold ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ y y' hy hy'' h1.2
    simp only [OptP, hy'']
    refine ⟨hm ▸ h1.1, ?_⟩
    have := hw'.holders _ y' hy' ya'
    rw [hq] at this ⊢; exact this
  · have h2 := he.grant (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀
    unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
    · rename_i z hz
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_getElem? hz) hsk.len)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hf, -, -, ho⟩ := hsk.old g₀ z' hz' (lt_of_getElem? hz)
      rw [hz] at hz₀; cases hz₀
      simp only [OptP, hz']
      refine ⟨ho _ h2.1 hl, fun l => ?_⟩
      rw [hf, hsk.afp hb]; exact h2.2 l
    · exact h2.elim
  · have h3 := he.control (hlive hl)
    unfold OptP at h3; split at h3
    · rename_i ctl hc
      obtain ⟨ctl', hc', hleaf'⟩ := hctl hl ctl hc h3.2
      simp only [OptP, hc']
      exact ⟨control_usable hw' hl hc', hleaf'⟩
    · exact h3.elim
  · intro j hj hcov
    by_cases hjA : j < s.A.length
    · exact he.disc (hlive hl) hn j (List.mem_range.2 hjA) (hsk.covering hb hjA hcov)
    · obtain ⟨y', o, hy', ho, hor, -⟩ := hsk.covering_new hb (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) hcov
      rcases hor with rfl | hcov'
      · exact hsrc (hlive hl) j y' _ hy' (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) ho rfl
      · exact he.disc (hlive hl) hn o (List.mem_range.2 (active_lt hcov'.2.1)) hcov'
  · intro j hcov
    have hg₀A : g₀ < s.A.length := by
      have h2 := he.grant (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀
      unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
      · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
      · exact h2.elim
    have ha₀' := hsk.active hg₀A ha₀
    by_cases hjA : j < s.A.length
    · rcases he.sub (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀ ha₀' j (hsk.covering hb hjA hcov) with rfl | h
      · exact .inl rfl
      · exact .inr (hsk.ancsKeep j hjA hcov.2.1 g₀ h ha₀)
    · obtain ⟨y', o, hy', ho, hor, hanc⟩ := hsk.covering_new hb (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) hcov
      rcases hor with rfl | hcov'
      · exact absurd rfl (hsrc (hlive hl) j y' _ hy' (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) ho)
      · rw [hanc]
        rcases he.sub (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀ ha₀' o hcov' with rfl | h
        · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

/-- Uniqueness across a step with an unchanged registry (WC2 C21.5): liveness only decreases. -/
theorem uniq_step {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s') (hb : RegBound s reg)
    (hu : Uniq s reg) : Uniq s' reg := fun i j e e' hi hj hl hl' hg =>
  hu i j e e' hi hj (hsk.active (hb e (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)) hl)
    (hsk.active (hb e' (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)) hl') hg

/-- A step with an unchanged registry preserves `SyncState`, given the per-entry hypotheses of
`entry_step`. -/
theorem kernel_step {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (hst : SyncState L s reg)
    (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded)
    (hhold : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s' → ∀ y y', s.A[e.guarded]? = some y →
      s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' → PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder → ∃ q, y'.holder = .place q)
    (hctl : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s' → ∀ ctl, ControlOf L s e = some ctl → isLeaf s.P ctl →
      ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl') : SyncState L s' reg := by
  obtain ⟨he, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hst
  exact syncState_iff.2 ⟨fun e hm => entry_step hsk hw' (he e hm) (hsrc e hm) (hhold e hm)
    (hctl e hm), uniq_step hsk (fun e hm => (he e hm).bound) hu⟩

# Preservation of the synchronization invariants (WC2 C21–C23)

Theorem 4 of the brief, preservation half: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5) and

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Auxiliary invariants (not WC2 clauses) -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause (needed by `unlock`, WC2 C17): while the recorded grant
of a live entry is active, every active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf is the
grant or one of its descendants. -/
def GrantSubtree (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause: every registered `guarded` identity exists (an entry
cannot become live by the creation of a fresh authority). -/
def RegBound (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The preserved conjunction: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) with the
auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg ∧ GrantSubtree s reg ∧ RegBound s reg

namespace SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Per-entry decomposition -/

/-- The clauses of `SyncState` about one entry (WC2 C21.1–C21.3, C22, auxiliaries). -/
structure EntryOK (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop where
  guarded : e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  grant : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  control : e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  disc : e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
  sub : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  bound : e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The global clause of `SyncState` (WC2 C21.5). -/
def Uniq (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' → e.Live s →
    e'.Live s → e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j

/-- `SyncState` is the per-entry clauses and uniqueness (WC2 C21, C22). -/
theorem syncState_iff {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} :
    SyncState L s reg ↔ (∀ e ∈ reg, EntryOK L s e) ∧ Uniq s reg := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hg, ht, hb⟩
    exact ⟨fun e he => ⟨hi.guarded e he, hi.grant e he, hi.control e he, hg e he, ht e he,
      hb e he⟩, hi.unique⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hu⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun e he => (h e he).guarded, fun e he => (h e he).grant,
      fun e he => (h e he).control, hu⟩, fun e he => (h e he).disc, fun e he => (h e he).sub,
      fun e he => (h e he).bound⟩

/-! ## Controller -/

/-- Unfolding of the positional `ControlOf` (WC2 C12). -/
theorem controlOf_spec {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (h : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) : ∃ y hp m, s.A[e.guarded]? = some y ∧
      y.holder = .place hp ∧ parentOf s.P hp = some m ∧
      (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp ∧ (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? = some ctl := by
  unfold ControlOf at h
  cases hy : s.A[e.guarded]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at h; simp at h
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at h
    cases hh : y.holder with
    | frame f => simp [hh] at h
    | place hp =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, hh] at h
      cases hm : parentOf s.P hp with
      | none => rw [hm] at h; cases h
      | some m =>
        rw [hm] at h
        by_cases hk : (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp

theorem control_usable {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}

  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hh, hm, hk, hc⟩ := controlOf_spec h
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya⟩ := hl
  have hy' : s.flat.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
  rw [hy'] at hy₀; cases hy₀
  have hu : s.flat.Usable hp := by have := hw.holders _ _ hy' ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hc)).2
  have hpar : ∀ q, parentOf s.P q = some m → ∃ pl pm, s.P[q]? = some pl ∧ s.P[m]? = some pm ∧

    intro q hq
    simp only [parentOf] at hq

  obtain ⟨pc, pm', hpc, hpm', ho', hd'⟩ := hpar ctl hcm

(from `Encap`); `hhold`: a place-held `guarded` stays place-held; `hctl`: the controller stays
a leaf; `hw'`: `WF3` after the step (theorem 2). -/
theorem entry_step {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (he : EntryOK L s e)
    (hsrc : e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = some o →
      o ≠ e.guarded)
    (hhold : e.Live s' → ∀ y y', s.A[e.guarded]? = some y → s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' →
      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder → ∃ q, y'.holder = .place q)
    (hctl : e.Live s' → ∀ ctl, ControlOf L s e = some ctl → isLeaf s.P ctl →
      ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl') : EntryOK L s' e := by
  have hb := he.bound
  have hlive : e.Live s' → e.Live s := hsk.active hb
  refine ⟨fun hl => ?_, fun hl g₀ hg₀ => ?_, fun hl => ?_, fun hl hn => ?_,
    fun hl g₀ hg₀ ha₀ => ?_, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb hsk.len⟩
  · obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl
    have hy'' : s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' := hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -, hm, -⟩ := hsk.old _ y' hy'' hb
    have h1 := he.guarded (hlive ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩)
    simp only [OptP, hy] at h1
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hhold ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ y y' hy hy'' h1.2
    simp only [OptP, hy'']
    refine ⟨hm ▸ h1.1, ?_⟩
    have := hw'.holders _ y' hy' ya'
    rw [hq] at this ⊢; exact this
  · have h2 := he.grant (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀
    unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
    · rename_i z hz
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_getElem? hz) hsk.len)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hf, -, -, ho⟩ := hsk.old g₀ z' hz' (lt_of_getElem? hz)
      rw [hz] at hz₀; cases hz₀
      simp only [OptP, hz']
      refine ⟨ho _ h2.1 hl, fun l => ?_⟩
      rw [hf, hsk.afp hb]; exact h2.2 l
    · exact h2.elim
  · have h3 := he.control (hlive hl)
    unfold OptP at h3; split at h3
    · rename_i ctl hc
      obtain ⟨ctl', hc', hleaf'⟩ := hctl hl ctl hc h3.2
      simp only [OptP, hc']
      exact ⟨control_usable hw' hl hc', hleaf'⟩
    · exact h3.elim

    by_cases hjA : j < s.A.length
    · exact he.disc (hlive hl) hn j (List.mem_range.2 hjA) (hsk.covering hb hjA hcov)
    · obtain ⟨y', o, hy', ho, hor, -⟩ := hsk.covering_new hb (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) hcov
      rcases hor with rfl | hcov'
      · exact hsrc (hlive hl) j y' _ hy' (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) ho rfl
      · exact he.disc (hlive hl) hn o (List.mem_range.2 (active_lt hcov'.2.1)) hcov'
  · intro j hcov
    have hg₀A : g₀ < s.A.length := by
      have h2 := he.grant (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀
      unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
      · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
      · exact h2.elim
    have ha₀' := hsk.active hg₀A ha₀
    by_cases hjA : j < s.A.length
    · rcases he.sub (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀ ha₀' j (hsk.covering hb hjA hcov) with rfl | h
      · exact .inl rfl
      · exact .inr (hsk.ancsKeep j hjA hcov.2.1 g₀ h ha₀)
    · obtain ⟨y', o, hy', ho, hor, hanc⟩ := hsk.covering_new hb (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) hcov
      rcases hor with rfl | hcov'
      · exact absurd rfl (hsrc (hlive hl) j y' _ hy' (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) ho)
      · rw [hanc]
        rcases he.sub (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀ ha₀' o hcov' with rfl | h
        · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

/-- Uniqueness across a step with an unchanged registry (WC2 C21.5): liveness only decreases. -/
theorem uniq_step {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s') (hb : RegBound s reg)
    (hu : Uniq s reg) : Uniq s' reg := fun i j e e' hi hj hl hl' hg =>
  hu i j e e' hi hj (hsk.active (hb e (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)) hl)
    (hsk.active (hb e' (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)) hl') hg

/-- A step with an unchanged registry preserves `SyncState`, given the per-entry hypotheses of
`entry_step`. -/
theorem kernel_step {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (hst : SyncState L s reg)
    (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded)
    (hhold : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s' → ∀ y y', s.A[e.guarded]? = some y →
      s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' → PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder → ∃ q, y'.holder = .place q)

      ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl') : SyncState L s' reg := by
  obtain ⟨he, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hst
  exact syncState_iff.2 ⟨fun e hm => entry_step hsk hw' (he e hm) (hsrc e hm) (hhold e hm)
    (hctl e hm), uniq_step hsk (fun e hm => (he e hm).bound) hu⟩

def PSkel (P P' : List Place) : Prop :=
  P.length ≤ P'.length ∧ (∀ q, q < P.length → parentOf P' q = parentOf P q) ∧
    ∀ r q, parentOf P' r = some q → q < P.length → r < P.length

/-- A filter rejecting every element is empty. -/
theorem filter_nil {α : Type} {p : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a ∈ l, p a = false) →
    l.filter p = []
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    rw [List.filter_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)]
    exact filter_nil fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)

/-- Children of an existing place are kept (Spec 1 §63.2 `kids`). -/
theorem PSkel.kids {P P' : List Place} (h : PSkel P P') {m : Nat} (hm : m < P.length) :
    kids P' m = kids P m := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, P'.length = P.length + d := ⟨P'.length - P.length, by have := h.1; omega⟩
  unfold Ern.MemoryModel.Access.kids
  rw [hd, List.range_add, List.filter_append]
  rw [filter_nil (l := List.map (fun x => P.length + x) (List.range d)) (fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hr
    cases e : decide (parentOf P' (P.length + i) = some m)
    · rfl
    · have := h.2.2 _ m (of_decide_eq_true e) hm; omega), List.append_nil]
  exact List.filter_congr fun r hr => by rw [h.2.1 r (List.mem_range.1 hr)]

/-- Leaf-ness of an existing place is kept (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem PSkel.isLeaf {P P' : List Place} (h : PSkel P P') {l : Nat} (hl : l < P.length) :
    isLeaf P' l ↔ isLeaf P l := by
  constructor
  · intro h' r hr hp
    exact h' r (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hr h.1) (by rw [h.2.1 r hr]; exact hp)
  · intro h' r hr hp
    have hrP := h.2.2 r l hp hl
    exact h' r hrP (by rw [← h.2.1 r hrP]; exact hp)

/-- Unchanged places satisfy `PSkel`. -/
theorem pskel_refl (P : List Place) : PSkel P P :=
  ⟨Nat.le_refl _, fun _ _ => rfl, fun r q hp _ => by
    simp only [parentOf] at hp
    cases hr : P[r]? with
    | none => rw [hr] at hp; cases hp
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hr⟩

/-- Appending a well-formed shape satisfies `PSkel` (Spec 1 §71.1, §72.2 `ShapeOK`). -/
theorem pskel_shapeP {P : List Place} {hd : Holder} {sh : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hsh : ShapeOK P.length sh) : PSkel P (shapeP P hd sh) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [shapeP], fun q hq => ?_, fun r q hp hq => ?_⟩
  · simp only [parentOf, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_left hq]
  · refine (Nat.lt_or_ge r P.length).elim id fun hr' => absurd hq ?_
    simp only [parentOf, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right hr', List.getElem?_map] at hp
    by_cases hi : r - P.length < sh.length
    · rw [List.getElem?_range hi] at hp
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some] at hp
      have := (hsh (r - P.length) (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
      rw [hp] at this
      exact Nat.not_lt.2 this.1
    · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by simp only [List.length_range]; omega)] at hp; cases hp

/-- Folding of the positional `ControlOf` (WC2 C12). -/
theorem controlOf_of {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {y : Authority} {hp m : Nat}
    (hy : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y) (hh : y.holder = .place hp) (hm : parentOf s.P hp = some m)
    (hk : (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp) :
    ControlOf L s e = (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? := by
  simp [ControlOf, hy, hh, hm, hk]

/-- With the same holder for `guarded` and kept parents, the controller is unchanged and stays a
leaf (WC2 C12). -/
theorem ctl_same {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hb : e.guarded < s'.A.length) (hh : HoldSame s s') {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) (hl : isLeaf s.P ctl) :
    ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl' := by
  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hph, hm, hk, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt hb
  have hhp : y'.holder = .place hp := by rw [hh _ y y' hp hy hy' hph, hph]
  have hpP : hp < s.P.length := by
    simp only [parentOf] at hm
    cases hq : s.P[hp]? with
    | none => rw [hq] at hm; cases hm
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hq
  have hmP : m < s.P.length := (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).2
  have hctlP : ctl < s.P.length := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1
  have hm' : parentOf s'.P hp = some m := by rw [hP.2.1 hp hpP, hm]
  have hk' : (kids s'.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp := by rw [hP.kids hmP]; exact hk
  refine ⟨ctl, by rw [controlOf_of hy' hhp hm' hk', hP.kids hmP, hkc], (hP.isLeaf hctlP).2 hl⟩

/-- `kernel_step` for steps keeping holders of places and parents. -/
theorem kernel_step_same {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hh : HoldSame s s') (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat)
    (hst : SyncState L s reg)
    (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded) : SyncState L s' reg :=
  kernel_step hsk hw' hst hsrc
    (fun e _ _ y y' hy hy' hu => by
      cases hq : y.holder with
      | frame f => rw [hq] at hu; exact hu.elim
      | place q => exact ⟨q, by rw [hh _ y y' q hy hy' hq, hq]⟩)
    (fun e hm _ ctl hc hl => ctl_same hw hP
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hst.2.2.2 e hm) hsk.len) hh hc hl)

/-- `Skel`, holders, places and the encapsulated sources of new authorities after a step with an
unchanged registry. -/
structure StepFacts (reg : SyncReg) (s s' : SC) : Prop where
  skel : Skel s s'
  hold : HoldSame s s'
  pskel : PSkel s.P s'.P
  src : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
    y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded

/-- Constructor of `StepFacts`. -/
theorem StepFacts.of {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (h : Skel s s' ∧ HoldSame s s')
    (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' →
      s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded) : StepFacts reg s s' :=
  ⟨h.1, h.2, hP, hsrc⟩

/-- No authority is created (source condition vacuous). -/
theorem src_none {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (hlen : s'.A.length = s.A.length) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded :=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ hy' hj _ => absurd (lt_of_getElem? hy') (by omega)

/-- Appended authorities are roots or derived from `src` (source condition from `Encap`). -/
theorem src_append {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {N : List Authority} {src : Nat}
    (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ N) (hN : ∀ z ∈ N, z.origin = none ∨ z.origin = some src)
    (he : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → src ≠ e.guarded) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded := by
  intro e hm hl j y' o hy' hj ho
  rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right hj] at hy'
  rcases hN y' (List.mem_of_getElem? hy') with h | h
  · rw [ho] at h; cases h
  · rw [ho] at h; cases h; exact he e hm hl

/-- Appended authorities are roots (source condition vacuous). -/
theorem src_roots {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {B N : List Authority} (hA : s'.A = B ++ N)
    (hlen : B.length = s.A.length) (hN : ∀ z ∈ N, z.origin = none) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded := by
  intro e _ _ j y' o hy' hj ho
  rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy'
  rw [hN y' (List.mem_of_getElem? hy')] at ho; cases ho

/-- An `ok` outcome of an operation run on a view (WC2 C2). -/
theorem viewStep_ok {R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (h : ViewStep R c s (.ok s')) : ∃ t, R (s.view c) (.ok t) ∧ s' = s.set t := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  cases o₃ with
  | ok t => cases ho; exact ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩
  | reject => cases ho
  | fail => cases ho

/-- Authorities appended by `enterFrame`/`spawn` (Spec 1 §72 effect): parameters change their
frame holder, root authorities of the locals have no origin. -/
theorem skel_enter {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hA : s'.A = (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls).A)
    (hpar : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) :
    Skel s s' ∧ HoldSame s s' := by
  refine skel_append (B := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then
      { y with holder := .frame (s.view c).nF } else y) 0 s.A)
    (N := (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
      (⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP (s.view c) ls) ((s.view c).P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame (s.view c).nF) i, true⟩ : Authority))
    (by rw [hA]; rfl) (length_mapI _ _ _) (fun j y' hy' => ?_) (fun z hz => ?_)
  · rw [getElem?_mapI] at hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy'
    refine ⟨y, hy, ⟨by split <;> rfl, by split <;> rfl, by split <;> rfl,
      by split <;> exact id, fun q hq => ?_⟩⟩
    split
    · rename_i hj
      have := hpar j (by simpa using hj)
      have hy2 : (s.view c).A[j]? = some y := hy
      simp only [OptP, hy2] at this
      rw [this.2.1] at hq; cases hq
    · rfl
  · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz; exact .inl rfl

/-- Steps of the inherited operations other than `transfer` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §64–§75 effects
re-indexed, WC2 C2, C6). -/
theorem opStep_facts {k : K} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : SC}
    (h : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) (he : Encap (s, reg) (.kernel c op))
    (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) (hw : WF3 s.flat) : StepFacts reg s s' := by
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst => exact absurd rfl (hnt src dst)
  | depend q x =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact .of (skel_sameA rfl) (pskel_refl _) (src_none rfl)
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hd := hpre.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at hd; split at hd
    · rename_i y hy
      have hy' : s.A[a]? = some y := hy
      have hA : (storeEffC s c a p).A = s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p } := by
        show (storeEff (s.view c) a p).A = _; simp [storeEff, hy]; rfl
      have hP : (storeEffC s c a p).P = s.P := by
        show (storeEff (s.view c) a p).P = _; simp [storeEff, hy]; rfl
      refine .of (skel_set hy' hA ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, id, fun q hq => ?_⟩)
        (by rw [hP]; exact pskel_refl _) (src_none (by rw [hA, List.length_set]))
      rw [hd.2.2] at hq; cases hq
    · exact hd.elim
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact .of (skel_enter rfl hpre.params) (pskel_shapeP hpre.localsOK)
      (src_roots rfl (length_mapI _ _ _) fun z hz => by
        obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz; rfl)
  | exit =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact .of (skel_exit hw rfl) (pskel_refl _) (src_none (by
      show (exitEff (s.view c)).A.length = _; simp [exitEff, length_mapI]; rfl))
  | derive src region m =>
    obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok h
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR
    have hA : (s.set (deriveEff (s.view c) src region m)).A =
        s.A ++ [⟨m, some src, region, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := rfl
    refine .of (skel_append hA rfl (fun j y' hy' => ⟨y', hy', Same.refl _⟩) fun z hz => ?_)
      (pskel_refl _) (src_append hA (fun z hz => by
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hz; subst hz; exact .inr rfl) he)
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hz; subst hz

theorem PSkel.kids {P P' : List Place} (h : PSkel P P') {m : Nat} (hm : m < P.length) :
    kids P' m = kids P m := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, P'.length = P.length + d := ⟨P'.length - P.length, by have := h.1; omega⟩
  unfold Ern.MemoryModel.Access.kids
  rw [hd, List.range_add, List.filter_append]
  rw [filter_nil (l := List.map (fun x => P.length + x) (List.range d)) (fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hr
    cases e : decide (parentOf P' (P.length + i) = some m)
    · rfl
    · have := h.2.2 _ m (of_decide_eq_true e) hm; omega), List.append_nil]
  exact List.filter_congr fun r hr => by rw [h.2.1 r (List.mem_range.1 hr)]

/-- Leaf-ness of an existing place is kept (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem PSkel.isLeaf {P P' : List Place} (h : PSkel P P') {l : Nat} (hl : l < P.length) :
    isLeaf P' l ↔ isLeaf P l := by
  constructor
  · intro h' r hr hp
    exact h' r (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hr h.1) (by rw [h.2.1 r hr]; exact hp)
  · intro h' r hr hp
    have hrP := h.2.2 r l hp hl
    exact h' r hrP (by rw [← h.2.1 r hrP]; exact hp)

/-- Unchanged places satisfy `PSkel`. -/
theorem pskel_refl (P : List Place) : PSkel P P :=
  ⟨Nat.le_refl _, fun _ _ => rfl, fun r q hp _ => by
    simp only [parentOf] at hp
    cases hr : P[r]? with
    | none => rw [hr] at hp; cases hp
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hr⟩

/-- Appending a well-formed shape satisfies `PSkel` (Spec 1 §71.1, §72.2 `ShapeOK`). -/
theorem pskel_shapeP {P : List Place} {hd : Holder} {sh : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hsh : ShapeOK P.length sh) : PSkel P (shapeP P hd sh) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [shapeP], fun q hq => ?_, fun r q hp hq => ?_⟩
  · simp only [parentOf, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_left hq]
  · refine (Nat.lt_or_ge r P.length).elim id fun hr' => absurd hq ?_
    simp only [parentOf, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right hr', List.getElem?_map] at hp
    by_cases hi : r - P.length < sh.length
    · rw [List.getElem?_range hi] at hp
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some] at hp
      have := (hsh (r - P.length) (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
      rw [hp] at this
      exact Nat.not_lt.2 this.1
    · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by simp only [List.length_range]; omega)] at hp; cases hp

/-- Folding of the positional `ControlOf` (WC2 C12). -/
theorem controlOf_of {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {y : Authority} {hp m : Nat}
    (hy : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y) (hh : y.holder = .place hp) (hm : parentOf s.P hp = some m)
    (hk : (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp) :
    ControlOf L s e = (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? := by
  simp [ControlOf, hy, hh, hm, hk]

/-- With the same holder for `guarded` and kept parents, the controller is unchanged and stays a
leaf (WC2 C12). -/
theorem ctl_same {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hb : e.guarded < s'.A.length) (hh : HoldSame s s') {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) (hl : isLeaf s.P ctl) :
    ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl' := by
  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hph, hm, hk, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt hb
  have hhp : y'.holder = .place hp := by rw [hh _ y y' hp hy hy' hph, hph]
  have hpP : hp < s.P.length := by
    simp only [parentOf] at hm
    cases hq : s.P[hp]? with
    | none => rw [hq] at hm; cases hm
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hq
  have hmP : m < s.P.length := (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).2
  have hctlP : ctl < s.P.length := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1
  have hm' : parentOf s'.P hp = some m := by rw [hP.2.1 hp hpP, hm]
  have hk' : (kids s'.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp := by rw [hP.kids hmP]; exact hk
  refine ⟨ctl, by rw [controlOf_of hy' hhp hm' hk', hP.kids hmP, hkc], (hP.isLeaf hctlP).2 hl⟩

/-- `kernel_step` for steps keeping holders of places and parents. -/
theorem kernel_step_same {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hh : HoldSame s s') (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat)
    (hst : SyncState L s reg)
    (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded) : SyncState L s' reg :=
  kernel_step hsk hw' hst hsrc
    (fun e _ _ y y' hy hy' hu => by
      cases hq : y.holder with
      | frame f => rw [hq] at hu; exact hu.elim
      | place q => exact ⟨q, by rw [hh _ y y' q hy hy' hq, hq]⟩)
    (fun e hm _ ctl hc hl => ctl_same hw hP
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hst.2.2.2 e hm) hsk.len) hh hc hl)

/-! ## Builders of `Skel` -/

    · simp only [e, ↓reduceIte] at hy'; exact ⟨y', hy', Same.refl _⟩

/-- `Skel`, holders, places and the encapsulated sources of new authorities after a step with an
unchanged registry. -/
structure StepFacts (reg : SyncReg) (s s' : SC) : Prop where
  skel : Skel s s'
  hold : HoldSame s s'
  pskel : PSkel s.P s'.P
  src : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
    y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded

/-- Constructor of `StepFacts`. -/
theorem StepFacts.of {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (h : Skel s s' ∧ HoldSame s s')
    (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' →
      s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded) : StepFacts reg s s' :=
  ⟨h.1, h.2, hP, hsrc⟩

/-- No authority is created (source condition vacuous). -/
theorem src_none {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (hlen : s'.A.length = s.A.length) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded :=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ hy' hj _ => absurd (lt_of_getElem? hy') (by omega)

/-- Appended authorities are roots or derived from `src` (source condition from `Encap`). -/
theorem src_append {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {N : List Authority} {src : Nat}
    (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ N) (hN : ∀ z ∈ N, z.origin = none ∨ z.origin = some src)
    (he : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → src ≠ e.guarded) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded := by
  intro e hm hl j y' o hy' hj ho
  rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right hj] at hy'
  rcases hN y' (List.mem_of_getElem? hy') with h | h
  · rw [ho] at h; cases h
  · rw [ho] at h; cases h; exact he e hm hl

/-- Appended authorities are roots (source condition vacuous). -/
theorem src_roots {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {B N : List Authority} (hA : s'.A = B ++ N)
    (hlen : B.length = s.A.length) (hN : ∀ z ∈ N, z.origin = none) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded := by
  intro e _ _ j y' o hy' hj ho
  rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy'
  rw [hN y' (List.mem_of_getElem? hy')] at ho; cases ho

/-- An `ok` outcome of an operation run on a view (WC2 C2). -/
theorem viewStep_ok {R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (h : ViewStep R c s (.ok s')) : ∃ t, R (s.view c) (.ok t) ∧ s' = s.set t := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  cases o₃ with
  | ok t => cases ho; exact ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩
  | reject => cases ho
  | fail => cases ho

/-- Authorities appended by `enterFrame`/`spawn` (Spec 1 §72 effect): parameters change their
frame holder, root authorities of the locals have no origin. -/
theorem skel_enter {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hA : s'.A = (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls).A)
    (hpar : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) :
    Skel s s' ∧ HoldSame s s' := by
  refine skel_append (B := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then
      { y with holder := .frame (s.view c).nF } else y) 0 s.A)
    (N := (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
      (⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP (s.view c) ls) ((s.view c).P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame (s.view c).nF) i, true⟩ : Authority))
    (by rw [hA]; rfl) (length_mapI _ _ _) (fun j y' hy' => ?_) (fun z hz => ?_)
  · rw [getElem?_mapI] at hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy'
    refine ⟨y, hy, ⟨by split <;> rfl, by split <;> rfl, by split <;> rfl,
      by split <;> exact id, fun q hq => ?_⟩⟩
    split
    · rename_i hj
      have := hpar j (by simpa using hj)
      have hy2 : (s.view c).A[j]? = some y := hy
      simp only [OptP, hy2] at this
      rw [this.2.1] at hq; cases hq
    · rfl
  · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz; exact .inl rfl

/-- Steps of the inherited operations other than `transfer` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §64–§75 effects
re-indexed, WC2 C2, C6). -/
theorem opStep_facts {k : K} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : SC}
    (h : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) (he : Encap (s, reg) (.kernel c op))
    (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) (hw : WF3 s.flat) : StepFacts reg s s' := by
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst => exact absurd rfl (hnt src dst)
  | depend q x =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact .of (skel_sameA rfl) (pskel_refl _) (src_none rfl)
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hd := hpre.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at hd; split at hd
    · rename_i y hy
      have hy' : s.A[a]? = some y := hy
      have hA : (storeEffC s c a p).A = s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p } := by
        show (storeEff (s.view c) a p).A = _; simp [storeEff, hy]; rfl
      have hP : (storeEffC s c a p).P = s.P := by
        show (storeEff (s.view c) a p).P = _; simp [storeEff, hy]; rfl
      refine .of (skel_set hy' hA ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, id, fun q hq => ?_⟩)
        (by rw [hP]; exact pskel_refl _) (src_none (by rw [hA, List.length_set]))
      rw [hd.2.2] at hq; cases hq
    · exact hd.elim
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact .of (skel_enter rfl hpre.params) (pskel_shapeP hpre.localsOK)
      (src_roots rfl (length_mapI _ _ _) fun z hz => by
        obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz; rfl)
  | exit =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact .of (skel_exit hw rfl) (pskel_refl _) (src_none (by
      show (exitEff (s.view c)).A.length = _; simp [exitEff, length_mapI]; rfl))
  | derive src region m =>
    obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok h
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR
    have hA : (s.set (deriveEff (s.view c) src region m)).A =
        s.A ++ [⟨m, some src, region, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := rfl
    refine .of (skel_append hA rfl (fun j y' hy' => ⟨y', hy', Same.refl _⟩) fun z hz => ?_)
      (pskel_refl _) (src_append hA (fun z hz => by
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hz; subst hz; exact .inr rfl) he)
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hz; subst hz
