import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib

/-!
# Preservation of the synchronization invariants (WC3 C21–C23)

Theorem 4 of the exploratory pass, preservation half, for `SyncInv` (WC3 C21.1–C21.6) and
`GrantDiscipline` (WC3 C22) under the encapsulation hypothesis `Encap` (WC3 C22.1–C22.3):

* every clause other than controller uniqueness (WC3 C21.4, first sentence) is preserved by every
  labelled step (`lstep_preserves`, on `SyncCore`);
* controller uniqueness is preserved by every labelled step other than a kernel `transfer`
  (`lstep_ctlUnique`); `Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.transfer_merges_controllers` is an
  encapsulated `transfer(M, M′)` after which it fails.

The kernel facts about the states before and after a step (`WF3`) are hypotheses supplied by
theorem 2 (preservation of the re-indexed kernel invariant).

`newMutex_nonleaf_rejected` shows the role of the leaf clause of `NewMutexPre.control` (WC3 C12,
C13.3): a positional controller that is not a leaf would break `SyncInv.control`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The invariant of theorem 4: `SyncInv` (WC3 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC3 C22). -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg

def SyncCore (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ reg, EntryOK L s e) ∧ Uniq s reg

/-- `SyncState` is `SyncCore` with controller uniqueness (WC3 C21, C22). -/
theorem syncState_iff {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} :
    SyncState L s reg ↔ SyncCore L s reg ∧ CtlUnique L s reg := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hg⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun e he => ⟨hi.guarded e he, hi.grant e he, hi.control e he, hg e he,
      hi.grantSubtree e he, hi.regBound e he⟩, hi.unique⟩, hi.ctlUnique⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨h, hu⟩, hc⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun e he => (h e he).guarded, fun e he => (h e he).grant,
      fun e he => (h e he).control, hc, hu, fun e he => (h e he).sub,
      fun e he => (h e he).bound⟩, fun e he => (h e he).disc⟩

namespace SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Controller -/

/-- Unfolding of the positional `ControlOf` (WC3 C12). -/
theorem controlOf_spec {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
      (by rw [hpar]; exact hm) (by rw [hkids]; exact hk), hkids, hkc]

/-- `transfer` preserves `SyncCore` under `Encap` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed). -/
theorem transfer_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c src dst : Nat}
    {s s' : SC} (h : opStepC k (.transfer src dst) c s (.ok s'))
    (he : Encap (s, reg) (.kernel c (.transfer src dst))) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat)
    (hs : SyncCore L s reg) : SyncCore L s' reg := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hget : ∀ j : Nat, (transferEffC s c src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun (y : Authority) =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y :=
    fun j => transfer_A_get (s.view c) src dst j
  have hlen : (transferEffC s c src dst).A.length = s.A.length := by
    show (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A.length = _; simp [transferEff]; rfl
  have hsk : Skel s (transferEffC s c src dst) := by
    have horg : ∀ i, (transferEffC s c src dst).flat.org i = s.flat.org i := by
      intro i
      show ((transferEffC s c src dst).A[i]?).bind (·.origin) = (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)
      rw [hget]; cases s.A[i]? with
      | none => rfl
      | some y => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl
    have hancs : ∀ j, (transferEffC s c src dst).flat.ancs j = s.flat.ancs j :=
      fun j => chain_congr fun i _ => horg i
    refine ⟨by omega, fun j y' hy' _ => ?_, fun j _ x hx => by rwa [hancs] at hx,
      fun j _ _ x hx _ => by rwa [hancs], fun j y' hy' hj => by
        have := lt_of_getElem? hy'; omega⟩
    rw [hget] at hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy'
    refine ⟨y, hy, by split <;> rfl, by split <;> rfl, by split <;> exact id, fun o ho _ => ?_⟩
    split <;> exact ho
  refine kernel_step hsk hw' hs (src_none hlen) (fun e _ _ y y' hy hy' hu => ?_)
    (fun e hm hl ctl hc hleaf => ctl_transfer hw hpre.sameShape
      (he e hm (hsk.active (hs.1 e hm).bound hl)) hc hleaf)
  rw [hget, hy] at hy'
  simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy'
  subst hy'
  cases hq : y.holder with
  | frame f => rw [hq] at hu; exact hu.elim
  | place q => split <;> simp [hq, mvTo]

import Ern.Concurrency.SyncPreserve
import Ern.Concurrency.TransferPreserve

/-!
# Theorem 4 with controller uniqueness and initialization (WC3 C21.4, WC3.1 C21, C22.3)

Preservation of `SyncState` (`SyncInv`, WC3 C21.1–C21.6 and WC3.1 C21, with `GrantDiscipline`,
WC3 C22) by the labelled steps admitted by `Encap` (WC3 C22.1, C22.2, WC3.1 C22.3), `transfer` and
the by-value composite included.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace SyncInitAux

open SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Structural parts (Spec 1 §40, §49.2) -/

section Tree

variable {t : S3}

/-- Structural parthood is transitive (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_trans (hw : WF3 t) {a b c : Nat} (hab : partOf t.P a b) (hbc : partOf t.P b c) :
    partOf t.P a c := by
  have hlt : ∀ i o, parentOf t.P i = some o → o < i := fun i o h => (WF3.parent_lt hw h).1
  refine ⟨hab.1, ?_⟩
  rcases hab.2 with rfl | hab'
  · exact hbc.2
  · rcases hbc.2 with rfl | hbc'
    · exact .inr hab'
    · exact .inr (chain_trans hlt (a + 1) a (Nat.lt_succ_self a) b hab' c hbc')

/-- The structural ancestors of a place are totally ordered (Spec 1 §40, §49.2: each place has at
most one structural parent). -/
theorem partOf_total (hw : WF3 t) : ∀ (n l : Nat), l < n → ∀ {a b : Nat},
    partOf t.P l a → partOf t.P l b → partOf t.P a b ∨ partOf t.P b a
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, l, hl, a, b, ha, hb => by
    rcases ha.2 with rfl | ha'
    · exact .inl hb
    rcases hb.2 with rfl | hb'
    · exact .inr ha
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpl, hap⟩ := mem_chain ha'
    obtain ⟨p', hp', -, hbp⟩ := mem_chain hb'
    rw [hp] at hp'; cases hp'
    have hpP : p < t.P.length := (WF3.parent_lt hw hp).2
    have ha₁ : partOf t.P p a := ⟨hpP, hap.elim (fun e => .inl e.symm) .inr⟩
    have hb₁ : partOf t.P p b := ⟨hpP, hbp.elim (fun e => .inl e.symm) .inr⟩
    exact partOf_total hw n p (by omega) ha₁ hb₁

/-- Two places sharing a leaf are structurally comparable (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem footprint_comparable (hw : WF3 t) {a b l : Nat} (ha : l ∈ footprint t.P a)
    (hb : l ∈ footprint t.P b) : partOf t.P a b ∨ partOf t.P b a := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, -, hla⟩ := mem_footprint.1 ha
  obtain ⟨-, -, hlb⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hb
  exact partOf_total hw (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hla hlb

/-- A strict ancestor of a place with parent `m` is an ancestor of `m` (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_parent (hw : WF3 t) {x a m : Nat} (h : partOf t.P x a) (hne : x ≠ a)
    (hm : parentOf t.P x = some m) : partOf t.P m a := by
  obtain ⟨o, ho, -, hor⟩ := mem_chain (h.2.resolve_left hne)
  rw [hm] at ho; cases ho
  exact ⟨(WF3.parent_lt hw hm).2, hor.elim (fun e => .inl e.symm) .inr⟩

/-- A leaf has no strict part (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_leaf (hw : WF3 t) : ∀ (n y : Nat), y < n → ∀ {x : Nat}, isLeaf t.P x →
    partOf t.P y x → y = x
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, y, hy, x, hx, h => by
    rcases h.2 with e | hc
    · exact e
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpy, hor⟩ := mem_chain hc
    rcases hor with rfl | hor
    · exact absurd hp (hx y h.1)
    · have := partOf_leaf hw n p (by omega) hx ⟨(WF3.parent_lt hw hp).2, .inr hor⟩
      subst this
      exact absurd hp (hx y h.1)

/-- A leaf in the footprint of a place is a part of it (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem leaf_mem_footprint {x q : Nat} (hx : isLeaf t.P x) (h : partOf t.P x q) :
    x ∈ footprint t.P q :=
  mem_footprint.2 ⟨h.1, hx, h⟩

/-- A leaf in the footprint of a place is the place or a strict part of it (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_of_mem_footprint {x q : Nat} (h : x ∈ footprint t.P q) : partOf t.P x q :=
  (mem_footprint.1 h).2.2

end Tree

/-! ## Corresponding parts of a transfer (Spec 1 §63.2) -/

/-- Membership gives a position (Spec 1 §63.2 `posIn`). -/
theorem getElem?_posIn : ∀ {l : List Nat} {x : Nat}, x ∈ l → l[posIn x l]? = some x
  | [], _, h => by simp at h
  | a :: l, x, h => by
    by_cases e : a = x
    · subst e; simp [posIn]
    · have hx : x ∈ l := (List.mem_cons.1 h).resolve_left (Ne.symm e)
      simp only [posIn, e, ↓reduceIte, List.getElem?_cons_succ]

    obtain ⟨b, hb, hxb, -⟩ := corr_parent eq hpq hpqq hxq
    rw [hxa] at hxb; cases hxb
    have hps : partOf t.P p src := partOf_parent hw hrs er hp
    have hpqs : partOf t.P pq src := partOf_parent hw hqs eq hpq
    have hpp : p = pq := corr_inj hw hd n p pq (by omega) (by omega) ha hb hps hpqs
    subst hpp
    rw [corr_step er hp hpr, ha, Option.bind_some] at hxr
    rw [corr_step eq hpq hpqq, ha, Option.bind_some] at hxq
    have hi := posIn_of_getElem (kids_pairwise _ _) hxr
    have hj := posIn_of_getElem (kids_pairwise _ _) hxq
    have hpos : posIn r (kids t.P p) = posIn q (kids t.P p) := by rw [← hi, hj]
    have hr' := getElem?_posIn (mem_kids.2 ⟨hrs.1, hp⟩)
    have hq' := getElem?_posIn (mem_kids.2 ⟨hqs.1, hpq⟩)
    rw [hpos, hq'] at hr'
    cases hr'; rfl

/-- The place corresponding to a leaf of the source is a leaf of the destination (the proof of
`Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.corr_leaf`, Spec 1 §63.2). -/
theorem corr_leaf' {t : S3} (hw : WF3 t) {src dst l l' : Nat} (hd : dst < t.P.length)
    (hsh : SameShape t.P src dst) (hl : l ∈ footprint t.P src)
    (hc : corr t.P src dst l = some l') : l' ∈ footprint t.P dst ∧ isLeaf t.P l' := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hls⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  have hp := corr_partOf hw hd (l + 1) l l' (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hc
  have hk := hsh.1 l (List.mem_range.2 hlP) hls
  rw [hc] at hk; simp only [OptP] at hk
  rw [kids_nil_iff.2 hlf] at hk
  have hleaf := kids_nil_iff.1 (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hk)
  exact ⟨mem_footprint.2 ⟨hp.1, hleaf, hp⟩, hleaf⟩

/-- `spawn` and the creation phase of the by-value composite keep the footprints of existing
places and their `Init` leaves (WC3 C4 effect, Spec 1 §72 effect). -/
theorem spawn_init {s : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape) : InitFacts s (spawnEff s c ps ls) := by
  refine ⟨fun q hq l => Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.footprint_shapeP hsh hq l, fun l hl hi => ?_⟩
  show (if (s.view c).P.length ≤ l then InitSt.uninit else s.I l) = .init
  rw [if_neg (Nat.not_le.2 hl)]; exact hi

/-- The initialization invariant (WC3.1 C21) across a step with an unchanged registry that keeps
holders of places, parents, footprints and `Init` leaves. -/
theorem init_step {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (hf : StepFacts reg s s')
    (hi : InitFacts s s') (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hs : SyncCore L s reg) (hsi : SlotInit s reg)
    (hci : CtlInit L s reg) : SlotInit s' reg ∧ CtlInit L s' reg := by
  refine ⟨fun e he hl => ?_, fun e he hl => ?_⟩
  · have heo := hs.1 e he
    have hl₀ := hf.skel.active heo.bound hl
    have h1 := heo.guarded hl₀
    have h2 := hsi e he hl₀
    cases hy : s.A[e.guarded]? with
    | none => rw [hy] at h1; exact h1.elim
    | some y =>
      rw [hy] at h1
      cases hh : y.holder with
      | frame f => rw [hh] at h1; exact h1.2.elim
      | place q =>
        have hsl : slotOf s e.guarded = some q := by simp [slotOf, hy, hh]
        rw [hsl] at h2
        obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le heo.bound hf.skel.len)

        have hsl' : slotOf s' e.guarded = some q := by simp [slotOf, hy', hh']
        rw [hsl']
        have hq : q < s.P.length := by
          have := h1.2; rw [hh] at this; exact this.lt
        intro l hl'
        have hl₁ := (hi.fp q hq l).1 hl'
        exact hi.keep l (mem_footprint.1 hl₁).1 (h2 l hl₁)
  · have heo := hs.1 e he
    have hl₀ := hf.skel.active heo.bound hl
    have h3 := heo.control hl₀
    have h4 := hci e he hl₀
    cases hc : ControlOf L s e with
    | none => rw [hc] at h3; exact h3.elim
    | some ctl =>
      rw [hc] at h3 h4
      rw [ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le heo.bound hf.skel.len) hf.hold hc]
      exact hi.keep ctl (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h3.1.lt (Nat.le_refl _)) h4

`InitFacts`. -/
theorem facts_syncState {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (hf : StepFacts reg s s')
    (hi : InitFacts s s') (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg) :

  exact syncState_iff.2 ⟨kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hc hf.src,
    facts_ctlUnique hf hw hc hu, hsi', hci'⟩

/-! ## `endUse` under the proposed clause (Spec 1 §69) -/

/-- An authority active after `endUse p` was not held within `p` (Spec 1 §69 effect). -/
theorem endUse_active {v : S3} {p j : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hy : (endUseEff v p).A[j]? = some y') (ha : y'.active = true) :
    ∃ y, v.A[j]? = some y ∧ ¬ heldIn v.P p y.holder := by
  simp only [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS, List.getElem?_map] at hy
  cases hv : v.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hv] at hy; cases hy
  | some y =>
    rw [hv] at hy
    refine ⟨y, rfl, fun hh => ?_⟩
    simp only [hh, ↓reduceIte, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy
    subst hy
    split at ha <;> simp at ha

/-- `endUse` (Spec 1 §69) preserves `SyncState` under `Encap` and the clause `EndUseExcl`
proposed by the report. -/
theorem endUse_syncState {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c p : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (h : opStepC k (.endUse p) c s (.ok s')) (he : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.endUse p)))
    (hx : EndUseExcl L (s, reg) (.kernel c (.endUse p))) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat)
    (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L s' reg := by
  have hf := opStep_facts (reg := reg) h he (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw
  obtain ⟨hc, hu, hsi, hci⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok h
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR
  have hI : ∀ l, (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c) p)).I l =
      if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l := fun _ => rfl
  -- the slot of a live entry after the step is not within `p`
  have hslot : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c) p)) →
      ∃ y q, s.A[e.guarded]? = some y ∧ y.holder = .place q ∧ ¬ partOf s.P q p ∧
        slotOf s e.guarded = some q ∧
        slotOf (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c) p)) e.guarded = some q := by
    intro e he' hl
    have heo := hc.1 e he'
    have hl₀ := hf.skel.active heo.bound hl
    obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hnh⟩ := endUse_active (v := s.view c) hy' ya'
    have h1 := heo.guarded hl₀
    have hy₀ : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
    rw [hy₀] at h1; simp only [OptP] at h1
    cases hh : y.holder with
    | frame f => rw [hh] at h1; exact h1.2.elim
    | place q =>
      have hh' : y'.holder = .place q := by rw [hf.hold _ y y' q hy₀ hy' hh, hh]
      refine ⟨y, q, hy₀, hh, fun hq => hnh (by rw [hh]; exact hq), by simp [slotOf, hy₀, hh],
        by simp [slotOf, show (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c) p)).A[e.guarded]? = some y' from hy',
          hh']⟩
  refine syncState_iff.2 ⟨kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hc hf.src,
    facts_ctlUnique hf hw hc hu, fun e he' hl => ?_, fun e he' hl => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, q, hy, hh, hnq, hsl, hsl'⟩ := hslot e he' hl
    have hl₀ := hf.skel.active (hc.1 e he').bound hl
    have h2 := hsi e he' hl₀
    rw [hsl] at h2
    rw [hsl']
    intro l hl'
    rw [hI]
    have hnot : l ∉ footprint s.P p := fun hp => by
      have hx' := (hx e he' hl₀).2
      rw [hsl] at hx'
      rcases footprint_comparable (t := s.flat) hw hl' hp with h₁ | h₁
      · exact hnq h₁
      · exact hnq (by rw [← hx' h₁]; exact h₁)
    simp only [hnot, ↓reduceIte]
    exact h2 l hl'
  · obtain ⟨y, q, hy, hh, hnq, -, -⟩ := hslot e he' hl
    have heo := hc.1 e he'
    have hl₀ := hf.skel.active heo.bound hl
    have h3 := heo.control hl₀
    have h4 := hci e he' hl₀
    cases hco : ControlOf L s e with
    | none => rw [hco] at h3; exact h3.elim
    | some ctl =>
      rw [hco] at h3 h4; simp only [OptP] at h3 h4
      rw [ctl_same_eq hw hf.pskel (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le heo.bound hf.skel.len) hf.hold hco]
      show (s.set (endUseEff (s.view c) p)).I ctl = .init
      rw [hI]
      have hnot : ctl ∉ footprint s.P p := fun hp => by
        have hcp := partOf_of_mem_footprint (t := s.flat) hp
        have hne : ctl ≠ p := fun e' => (hx e he' hl₀).1 (by rw [hco, e'])
        obtain ⟨y₁, hp₁, m, hy₁, hh₁, hm, -, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hco
        rw [hy] at hy₁; cases hy₁
        rw [hh] at hh₁; cases hh₁
        have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
        have hmp := partOf_parent (t := s.flat) hw hcp hne hcm
        have hqm : partOf s.P q m := ⟨(WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).1.trans_le
          (Nat.le_of_lt (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).2) |>.trans_le (Nat.le_refl _) |>
          fun _ => by
            simp only [parentOf] at hm
            cases hq : s.P[q]? with
            | none => rw [hq] at hm; cases hm
            | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hq,
          .inr (by rw [chain_cons hm (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).1];
                   exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
        exact hnq (partOf_trans (t := s.flat) hw hqm hmp)
      simp only [hnot, ↓reduceIte]
      exact h4

theorem ctl_transfer {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {c src dst : Nat} {e : SyncEntry}
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hss : SameShape s.P src dst)
    (henc : (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) ≠ some (.place src)) {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) (hl : isLeaf s.P ctl) :
    ∃ ctl', ControlOf L (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)) e = some ctl' ∧
      isLeaf (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P ctl' := by
  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hph, hm, hk, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  have hP : (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P = (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).P := rfl
  have hpar : parentOf (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P = parentOf s.P :=
    transfer_parentOf (s.view c) src dst
  have hkids : ∀ x, kids (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P x = kids s.P x :=
    transfer_kids (s.view c) src dst
  have hleaf : ∀ x, isLeaf (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P x ↔ isLeaf s.P x :=
    transfer_isLeaf (s.view c) src dst
  have hA' : (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).A[e.guarded]? = some
      (if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y) := by
    have hy2 : (s.view c).A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
    show (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[e.guarded]? = _
    rw [transfer_A_get, hy2]; rfl
  have hmlt := WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
  have hcP : ctl < s.P.length := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1
  have hmc := (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hcm).1
  by_cases hin : heldIn s.P src y.holder
  · rw [hph] at hin
    -- the mutex value is a part of `src`
    have hne : hp ≠ src := fun e' => henc (by simp [hy, hph, e'])
    obtain ⟨o, ho, -, hor⟩ := mem_chain (hin.2.resolve_left hne)
    rw [hm] at ho; cases ho
    have hmsrc : partOf s.P m src := ⟨hmlt.2, hor.elim (fun e => .inl e.symm) .inr⟩
    have hcsrc : partOf s.P ctl src := partOf_child hcP hcm hmc hmsrc
    have hss1 := hss.1 m (List.mem_range.2 hmlt.2) hmsrc
    unfold OptP at hss1; split at hss1
    · rename_i m' hm'
      have hgp : posIn hp (kids s.P m) = L.guardedField := posIn_of_getElem (kids_pairwise _ _) hk
      have hcp : posIn ctl (kids s.P m) = L.controlField :=
        posIn_of_getElem (kids_pairwise _ _) hkc
      have hlen : L.controlField < (kids s.P m').length := by
        rw [hss1]; exact lt_of_getElem? hkc
      have hlen' : L.guardedField < (kids s.P m').length := by
        rw [hss1]; exact lt_of_getElem? hk
      obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt hlen'
      obtain ⟨ctl', hc'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt hlen
      have hcorr : corr s.P src dst hp = some h' := by
        rw [corr_step hne hm hmlt.1, hm', Option.bind_some, hgp, hh']
      have hcne : ctl ≠ src := fun e' => by
        have := Frames.partOf_le hmsrc; omega
      have hcorrc : corr s.P src dst ctl = some ctl' := by
        rw [corr_step hcne hcm hmc, hm', Option.bind_some, hcp, hc']
      have hh'm : parentOf s.P h' = some m' := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hh')).2
      refine ⟨ctl', ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [controlOf_of (y := { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder }) (hp := h') (m := m')
          (by rw [hA']; simp only [show heldIn s.P src y.holder by rw [hph]; exact hin,
            ↓reduceIte])
          (by rw [hph]; simp [mvTo, hcorr])
          (by rw [hpar]; exact hh'm) (by rw [hkids]; exact hh'), hkids, hc']
      · rw [hleaf]
        have hsc := hss.1 ctl (List.mem_range.2 hcP) hcsrc
        rw [hcorrc] at hsc
        simp only [OptP] at hsc
        rw [kids_nil_iff.2 hl] at hsc
        exact kids_nil_iff.1 (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hsc)
    · exact hss1.elim
  · refine ⟨ctl, ?_, (hleaf ctl).2 hl⟩

    show (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[e.guarded]? = _

  have hmlt := WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
  have hcP : ctl < s.P.length := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1
  have hmc := (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hcm).1
  refine ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hph, hm, hcm, ?_⟩
  by_cases hin : partOf s.P hp src
  · have hne : hp ≠ src := fun e' => henc (by simp [hy, hph, e'])

/-- Liveness is unchanged by a transfer (Spec 1 §63 effect: holders change, activity does not). -/
theorem transfer_live {s : SC} {c src dst : Nat} {e : SyncEntry} :
    e.Live (transferEffC s c src dst) ↔ e.Live s := by
  unfold SyncEntry.Live
  have hget : (transferEffC s c src dst).A[e.guarded]? = (s.A[e.guarded]?).map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y :=
    transfer_A_get (s.view c) src dst e.guarded
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩
    change (transferEffC s c src dst).A[e.guarded]? = some y' at hy'
    rw [hget] at hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy'
    exact ⟨y, hy, by split at ya' <;> exact ya'⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
    refine ⟨_, show (transferEffC s c src dst).A[e.guarded]? = _ by rw [hget, show
      s.A[e.guarded]? = some y from hy]; rfl, ?_⟩
    split <;> exact ya

/-- The controller of a live entry across a transfer admitted by WC3.1 C22.3 whose destination
has no `Init` leaf (Spec 1 §63.3): either it moves to the corresponding leaf of the destination,
or it stays and lies outside the source and the destination. -/
theorem transfer_ctl_cases {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c src dst : Nat} {s : SC}
    {e : SyncEntry} (hss : SameShape s.P src dst) (hdni : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init)
    (hd : dst < s.P.length) (hx : TransferExcl L (s, reg) src) (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hc : SyncCore L s reg) (hci : CtlInit L s reg) (he : e ∈ reg) (hl : e.Live s) {ctl : Nat}
    (hco : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) :
    (partOf s.P ctl src ∧ ∃ ctl', corr s.P src dst ctl = some ctl' ∧
        ControlOf L (transferEffC s c src dst) e = some ctl' ∧ ctl' ∈ footprint s.P dst) ∨
      (ControlOf L (transferEffC s c src dst) e = some ctl ∧ ctl ∉ footprint s.P src ∧
        ctl ∉ footprint s.P dst) := by
  have h3 := (hc.1 e he).control hl
  rw [hco] at h3; simp only [OptP] at h3
  have h4 := hci e he hl
  rw [hco] at h4; simp only [OptP] at h4
  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hph, hm, hcm, hcase⟩ :=
    ctl_transfer_eq (c := c) hw hss (holder_ne_of_excl hx hc e he hl) hco
  rcases hcase with ⟨-, hcs, hc'⟩ | ⟨hnp, hc'⟩
  · have hcf : ctl ∈ footprint s.P src := mem_footprint.2 ⟨h3.1.lt, h3.2, hcs⟩
    have hk := hss.1 ctl (List.mem_range.2 h3.1.lt) hcs
    cases hcc : corr s.P src dst ctl with
    | none => rw [hcc] at hk; exact hk.elim
    | some ctl' =>
      exact .inl ⟨hcs, ctl', rfl, by rw [hc', hcc],
        (corr_leaf' (t := s.flat) hw hd hss hcf hcc).1⟩
  · refine .inr ⟨hc', fun hcf => ?_, fun hcd => hdni ctl hcd h4⟩
    have hcs := partOf_of_mem_footprint (t := s.flat) hcf
    by_cases hne : ctl = src
    · exact (hx e he hl).2 (by rw [hco, hne])
    · have hms := partOf_parent (t := s.flat) hw hcs hne hcm
      have hpP : hp < s.P.length := by
        have h1 := (hc.1 e he).guarded hl
        rw [hy] at h1; simp only [OptP] at h1
        have := h1.2; rw [hph] at this; exact this.lt
      have hpm : partOf s.P hp m := ⟨hpP, .inr (by
        rw [chain_cons hm (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
      exact hnp (partOf_trans (t := s.flat) hw hpm hms)

/-- `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect) preserves `SyncState` when it is admitted by
WC3.1 C22.3, the shapes match (§63.2) and no destination leaf is `Init` (§63.3). -/
theorem transfer_syncState {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c src dst : Nat} {s : SC}
    (hss : SameShape s.P src dst) (hdni : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init)
    (hd : dst < s.P.length) (hx : TransferExcl L (s, reg) src) (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hw' : WF3 (transferEffC s c src dst).flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg) :
    SyncState L (transferEffC s c src dst) reg := by
  obtain ⟨hc, hu, hsi, hci⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have hcore := transfer_core (c := c) hss (holder_ne_of_excl hx hc) hw hw' hc
  have hI : ∀ l, (transferEffC s c src dst).I l = if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l := fun _ => rfl
  have hctlI : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ ctl, ControlOf L s e = some ctl →
      ∃ c', ControlOf L (transferEffC s c src dst) e = some c' ∧
        (transferEffC s c src dst).I c' = .init := by
    intro e he hl ctl hco
    have h4 := hci e he hl
    rw [hco] at h4; simp only [OptP] at h4
    rcases transfer_ctl_cases hss hdni hd hx hw hc hci he hl hco with
      ⟨-, ctl', -, hc', hcd⟩ | ⟨hc', hns, hnd⟩
    · exact ⟨ctl', hc', by rw [hI]; simp [hcd]⟩
    · exact ⟨ctl, hc', by rw [hI]; simp [hns, hnd, h4]⟩
  refine syncState_iff.2 ⟨hcore, fun i j e f c₀ hi hj hl hl' h1 h2 => ?_, fun e he hl => ?_,
    fun e he hl => ?_⟩
  · -- controller uniqueness (WC3 C21.4)
    have hl₀ := transfer_live.1 hl
    have hl₀' := transfer_live.1 hl'
    have he := List.mem_of_getElem? hi
    have hf := List.mem_of_getElem? hj
    have h3e := (hc.1 e he).control hl₀
    have h3f := (hc.1 f hf).control hl₀'
    cases hce : ControlOf L s e with
    | none => rw [hce] at h3e; exact h3e.elim
    | some ce =>
      cases hcf : ControlOf L s f with
      | none => rw [hcf] at h3f; exact h3f.elim
      | some cf =>
        rcases transfer_ctl_cases hss hdni hd hx hw hc hci he hl₀ hce with
          ⟨hes, ce', hce', hce'', hced⟩ | ⟨hce'', -, hcend⟩ <;>
        rcases transfer_ctl_cases hss hdni hd hx hw hc hci hf hl₀' hcf with
          ⟨hfs, cf', hcf', hcf'', hcfd⟩ | ⟨hcf'', -, hcfnd⟩
        · rw [hce''] at h1; rw [hcf''] at h2; cases h1; cases h2
          have hcs : (s.P).length > 0 := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hd
          have := corr_inj (t := s.flat) hw hd (ce + cf + 1) ce cf (by omega) (by omega)
            hce' hcf' hes hfs
          subst this
          exact hu i j e f ce hi hj hl₀ hl₀' hce hcf
        · rw [hce''] at h1; rw [hcf''] at h2; cases h1; cases h2
          exact hcfnd hced
        · rw [hce''] at h1; rw [hcf''] at h2; cases h1; cases h2
          exact hcend hcfd
        · rw [hce''] at h1; rw [hcf''] at h2; cases h1; cases h2
          exact hu i j e f ce hi hj hl₀ hl₀' hce hcf
  · -- `slot` stays `Init` (WC3.1 C21)
    have hl₀ := transfer_live.1 hl
    have heo := hc.1 e he
    have h1 := heo.guarded hl₀
    have h2 := hsi e he hl₀
    cases hy : s.A[e.guarded]? with
    | none => rw [hy] at h1; exact h1.elim
    | some y =>
      rw [hy] at h1; simp only [OptP] at h1
      cases hh : y.holder with
      | frame f => rw [hh] at h1; exact h1.2.elim
      | place q =>
        have hsl : slotOf s e.guarded = some q := by simp [slotOf, hy, hh]
        rw [hsl] at h2; simp only [OptP] at h2
        have hqP : q < s.P.length := by have := h1.2; rw [hh] at this; exact this.lt
        have hA' : (transferEffC s c src dst).A[e.guarded]? = some
            (if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder }
              else y) := by
          have hy2 : (s.view c).A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
          show (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[e.guarded]? = _
          rw [transfer_A_get, hy2]; rfl
        by_cases hin : partOf s.P q src
        · have hk := hss.1 q (List.mem_range.2 hqP) hin
          cases hcq : corr s.P src dst q with
          | none => rw [hcq] at hk; exact hk.elim
          | some q' =>
            have hsl' : slotOf (transferEffC s c src dst) e.guarded = some q' := by
              simp only [slotOf, hA', hh, show heldIn s.P src (.place q) from hin, ↓reduceIte,
                Option.map_some, mvTo, hcq, Option.getD_some]
            rw [hsl']; simp only [OptP]
            have hq'd := corr_partOf (s := s.flat) hw hd (q + 1) q q' (Nat.lt_succ_self q) hcq
            intro l hl'
            rw [show footprint (transferEffC s c src dst).P q' = footprint s.P q' from
              transfer_footprint (s.view c) src dst q'] at hl'
            obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl'
            have hld : l ∈ footprint s.P dst :=
              mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hlf, partOf_trans (t := s.flat) hw hlq hq'd⟩
            rw [hI]; simp [hld]
        · have hsl' : slotOf (transferEffC s c src dst) e.guarded = some q := by
            simp only [slotOf, hA', hh, show ¬ heldIn s.P src (.place q) from hin, ↓reduceIte,
              Option.map_some]
          rw [hsl']; simp only [OptP]
          intro l hl'
          rw [show footprint (transferEffC s c src dst).P q = footprint s.P q from
            transfer_footprint (s.view c) src dst q] at hl'
          rw [hI]
          by_cases hld : l ∈ footprint s.P dst
          · simp [hld]
          · have hls : l ∉ footprint s.P src := fun hls => by
              rcases footprint_comparable (t := s.flat) hw hl' hls with h₁ | h₁
              · exact hin h₁
              · have := (hx e he hl₀).1
                rw [hsl] at this
                exact this h₁
            simp [hld, hls, h2 l hl']
  · -- the controller stays `Init` (WC3.1 C21)
    have hl₀ := transfer_live.1 hl
    have h3 := (hc.1 e he).control hl₀
    cases hco : ControlOf L s e with
    | none => rw [hco] at h3; exact h3.elim
    | some ctl =>
      obtain ⟨c', hc', hi'⟩ := hctlI e he hl₀ ctl hco
      rw [hc']; exact hi'

    have hqP : q < s.P.length := by
      simp only [parentOf] at hm
      cases hq : s.P[q]? with
      | none => rw [hq] at hm; cases hm
      | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hq
    have hqm : partOf s.P q m := ⟨hqP, .inr (by
      rw [chain_cons hm (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
    have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
    have hcP : ctl < s.P.length := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1
    have hcmp : partOf s.P ctl m := ⟨hcP, .inr (by
      rw [chain_cons hcm (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hcm).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
    refine syncState_iff.2 ⟨hcore, hcu, fun x hx hl => ?_, fun x hx hl => ?_⟩
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact hsi x hx hl
      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hx]
        show OptP (slotOf s g) _ False
        rw [show slotOf s g = some q by simp [slotOf, hy', hh]]
        exact fun l hl' => hinit l (footprint_sub (s := s.flat) hw hqm hl')
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact hci x hx hl
      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hx, hco]
        exact hinit ctl (leaf_mem_footprint (t := s.flat) h1.2 hcmp)

/-- `acquire` (WC3 C16) preserves `SyncState`. -/
theorem acquire_syncState {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : AcquireOk k L s reg c i st') (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hc, hu, hsi, hci⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have hcore := acquire_preserves h hw hw' hc
  have hcu := acquire_ctlUnique h hw hc hu
  obtain ⟨-, e, hi, -, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
  have hA : (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded).A = s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some e.guarded,
      (s.view c).afp e.guarded, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := rfl
  obtain ⟨hsk, hh⟩ := skel_append hA rfl (fun j y' hy' => ⟨y', hy', Same.refl _⟩) fun z hz => by
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hz; subst hz
    exact .inr ⟨e.guarded, rfl, active_lt hpre.active, hpre.active, fun l hl => hl⟩
  obtain ⟨hsi', hci'⟩ := init_step (L := L) (reg := reg) hsk hh (pskel_refl _)
    (initFacts_same rfl rfl) hw hc hsi hci
  obtain ⟨hsi'', hci''⟩ := init_set (e' := { e with grant := some s.A.length }) hi rfl hsi' hci'
  exact syncState_iff.2 ⟨hcore, hcu, hsi'', hci''⟩

/-- `unlock` (WC3 C17) preserves `SyncState`. -/
theorem unlock_syncState {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : UnlockOk L s reg c i st') (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hc, hu, hsi, hci⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have hcore := unlock_preserves h hw hw' hc
  have hcu := unlock_ctlUnique h hw hc hu
  obtain ⟨-, e, g₀, hi, -, -, hpre, -, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hpre.active
  have hx' : s.A[g₀]? = some x := hx
  have hA : (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀)).A = s.A.set g₀ { x with active := false } := by
    show (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀).A = _; rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; rfl
  have hP : (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀)).P = s.P := by
    show (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀).P = _; rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; rfl
  have hI : (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀)).I = s.I := by
    show (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀).I = _; rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; rfl
  obtain ⟨hsk, hh⟩ := skel_set hx' hA (same_deact x)
  obtain ⟨hsi', hci'⟩ := init_step (L := L) (reg := reg) hsk hh (by rw [hP]; exact pskel_refl _)
    (initFacts_same hP hI) hw hc hsi hci
  obtain ⟨hsi'', hci''⟩ := init_set (e' := { e with grant := none }) hi rfl hsi' hci'
  exact syncState_iff.2 ⟨hcore, hcu, hsi'', hci''⟩

/-- `resetLock` (WC3 C18, WC3.1 C18.3) preserves `SyncState`. -/
theorem resetLock_syncState {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : ResetLockOk L s reg c i st') (hs : SyncState L s reg) :
    SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hc, hu, hsi, hci⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have hcore := resetLock_preserves h hc
  have hcu := resetLock_ctlUnique h hu
  obtain ⟨-, e, hi, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hsi', hci'⟩ := init_set (e' := { e with grant := none }) hi rfl hsi hci
  exact syncState_iff.2 ⟨hcore, hcu, hsi', hci'⟩

/-! ## The by-value composite (WC3 C5; WC3.1 "Formalization coverage") -/

open TransferPreserveAux

/-- Facts of the effect of `spawn` (WC3 C4 effect, Spec 1 §72 effect), from its parameter and
shape clauses. -/
theorem spawnEff_facts {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hpar : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False)
    (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape) : StepFacts reg s (spawnEff s c ps ls) :=
  .of (skel_enter rfl hpar) (pskel_shapeP hsh)
    (src_roots rfl (length_mapI _ _ _) fun z hz => by obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz; rfl)

/-- Authorities after the yield (WC3 C5.3). -/
theorem yield_get {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f j : Nat} :
    (yieldEff t ps f).A[j]? = (t.A[j]?).map (yieldF ps f j) := by
  show (mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 t.A)[j]? = _
  rw [getElem?_mapI, Nat.zero_add]

/-- WC3.1 C22.3 carries from the state before the yield to the state after it, when
`SyncState` holds after it: the `guarded` of a live entry is held by a place, so it is not a
parameter. -/
theorem yield_excl {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f src : Nat}
    (hs : SyncState L (yieldEff t ps f) reg) (hx : TransferExcl L (t, reg) src) :
    TransferExcl L (yieldEff t ps f, reg) src := by
  intro e he hl
  have h1 := hs.1.guarded e he hl
  cases hy : (yieldEff t ps f).A[e.guarded]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at h1; exact h1.elim
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at h1; simp only [OptP] at h1
    rw [yield_get] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e₀⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    have hnp : e.guarded ∉ ps := fun hp => by
      unfold yieldF at e₀; simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte] at e₀
      rw [← e₀] at h1; exact h1.2
    have hA : (yieldEff t ps f).A[e.guarded]? = t.A[e.guarded]? := by
      rw [yield_get, hy₀]; unfold yieldF; simp [hnp]
    have hlt : e.Live t := by
      obtain ⟨z, hz, za⟩ := hl
      change (yieldEff t ps f).A[e.guarded]? = some z at hz
      rw [hA] at hz; exact ⟨z, hz, za⟩
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hx e he hlt
    have hsl : slotOf (yieldEff t ps f) e.guarded = slotOf t e.guarded := by
      unfold slotOf; rw [hA]
    have hco : ControlOf L (yieldEff t ps f) e = ControlOf L t e := by
      unfold ControlOf; rw [hA]; rfl
    exact ⟨by rw [hsl]; exact h₁, by rw [hco]; exact h₂⟩

/-- `SyncState` along the transfer phases of the by-value composite (WC3 C5.2), on the states where
the parameters are already yielded. -/
theorem transfers_sync {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {fin : S3} {c f : Nat}
    {ps : List Nat} :
    ∀ (t : SC) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)), ValTransfersPre k fin c t vs → EncapVals L reg c t vs →
      KBase (yieldEff t ps f) → SyncState L (yieldEff t ps f) reg →
      (∀ v ∈ vs, FrameOwned t.P v.2) →
      (∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) →
      SyncState L (yieldEff (transfersEff c t vs) ps f) reg
  | _, [], _, _, _, hs, _, _ => hs
  | t, v :: vs, ⟨hpre, hrest⟩, ⟨hx, hxs⟩, hk, hs, hown, hp => by
    simp only [transfersEff]
    have hk₁ := transfers_base (ps := ps) (f := f) t [v] ⟨hpre, trivial⟩ hk
      (fun w hw => hown w (by simp at hw; simp [hw])) hp
    simp only [transfersEff] at hk₁
    have hw' : WF3 (transferEffC (yieldEff t ps f) c v.1 v.2).flat := by
      rw [yield_transfer hp]; exact hk₁.2.1
    have hs₁ := transfer_syncState (c := c) (src := v.1) (dst := v.2) hpre.sameShape
      hpre.dstNotInit hpre.dstUsable.lt (yield_excl hs hx) hk.2.1 hw' hs
    rw [yield_transfer hp] at hs₁
    refine transfers_sync (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs hrest hxs hk₁ hs₁ (fun w hw => ?_)
      (fun a ha y hy => ?_)
    · exact transfer_frameOwned (hown w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw))
    · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := transfer_frame_held hy
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp a ha y₀ hy₀
      exact ⟨g, by rw [e ⟨g, hg⟩, hg]⟩

/-- The by-value composite (WC3 C5) admitted by WC3.1 C22.3 preserves `SyncState`, from a state
satisfying `KInvCA`. -/
theorem spawnVal_syncState {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {c : Nat}
    {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {vs : List (Nat × Nat)} (hk : KInvCA s)
    (h : SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s')) (he : EncapVals L reg c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs)
    (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L s' reg := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hpar : ParamsOK (s.view c) ps := hpre.params
  have hlt : ∀ a ∈ ps, a < s.A.length := fun a ha => by
    have := hpre.params a ha
    unfold OptP at this; split at this
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · exact this.elim
  have hframe : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, (spawnCreate s c ls).A[a]? = some y →
      ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g := by
    intro a ha y hy
    have hp := hpre.params a ha
    have hy' : (spawnCreate s c ls).A[a]? = s.A[a]? := by
      show (mapI _ 0 s.A ++ _)[a]? = _
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [length_mapI]; exact hlt a ha), getElem?_mapI]
      cases s.A[a]? <;> simp
    rw [hy'] at hy
    have hy₂ : (s.view c).A[a]? = some y := hy
    rw [hy₂] at hp
    exact ⟨_, hp.2.1⟩
  have hb₀ : KBase (spawnEff s c ps ls) := spawn_base hk hpre.creatorLive hpar hpre.localsOK
  have hs₀ : SyncState L (spawnEff s c ps ls) reg :=
    facts_syncState (spawnEff_facts hpre.params hpre.localsOK) (spawn_init hpre.localsOK)
      hk.1.1.2 hb₀.2.1 hs
  rw [← create_yield hlt] at hb₀ hs₀
  exact transfers_sync (spawnCreate s c ls) vs hpre.transfers he hb₀ hs₀
    (fun v hv => spawn_frameOwned (hpre.freshDst v hv)) hframe

EOF

/-- Theorem 4 (WC3 C21–C23, WC3.1 C21, C22.3, "Formalization coverage") on one labelled step:
every labelled step taken under `Encap`, `transfer` and the by-value composite included, and
satisfying the clause `EndUseExcl` proposed by the report, preserves `SyncState` (`SyncInv` and
`GrantDiscipline`). `KInvCA` before the step and `WF3` after it are supplied by theorem 2. Without
`EndUseExcl` the statement is false (`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.endUse_ctl_breaks_ctlInit`,
`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.endUse_slotPart_breaks_slotInit`). -/
theorem lstep_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap L st lbl) (hx : EndUseExcl L st lbl)
    (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) :
    SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  have hw : WF3 st.1.flat := hk.1.1.2
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case transfer src dst =>
      obtain ⟨-, h'⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h'
      exact transfer_syncState hpre.sameShape hpre.dstNotInit hpre.dstUsable.lt he hw hw' hs
    case endUse p => exact endUse_syncState h he hx hw hw' hs
    all_goals
      exact facts_syncState (opStep_facts (reg := reg) h he (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw)
        (opStep_init h (fun _ _ h => by cases h) (fun _ h => by cases h)) hw hw' hs
  | @spawn s s' reg c ps ls h =>
    obtain ⟨-, h'⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h'
    exact facts_syncState (spawnEff_facts hpre.params hpre.localsOK) (spawn_init hpre.localsOK)
      hw hw' hs
  | @terminate s s' reg c h =>
    have hf := term_facts (reg := reg) hw h
    obtain ⟨-, h'⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h'
    exact facts_syncState hf (initFacts_same rfl rfl) hw hw' hs
  | @join s s' reg c d h =>
    have hf := join_facts (reg := reg) h
    cases h
    exact facts_syncState hf (initFacts_same rfl rfl) hw hw' hs
  | deriveSync h => exact (deriveSync_excluded h he).elim
  | newMutex h => exact newMutex_syncState h hw hs
  | acquire h => exact acquire_syncState h hw hw' hs
  | unlock h => exact unlock_syncState h hw hw' hs
  | resetLock h => exact resetLock_syncState h hs
  | spawnVal h => exact spawnVal_syncState hk h he hs

/-- Runs every step of which satisfies `Encap` and the clause `EndUseExcl` proposed by the report
(WC3.1, "Formalization coverage": the clause is a hypothesis, not part of `Encap`). -/
inductive ProposedTrace (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : ProposedTrace k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      Encap L st lbl → EndUseExcl L st lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ →
      ProposedTrace k L st₁ lbls st₂ → ProposedTrace k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- A `ProposedTrace` is an `EncapsulatedTrace`. -/
theorem ProposedTrace.encap {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st') : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons he _ hs _ ih => exact .cons he hs ih

/-- An `EncapsulatedTrace` without `endUse` label is a `ProposedTrace`. -/
theorem ProposedTrace.of_encap {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st')
    (hn : ∀ lbl ∈ lbls, ∀ c p, lbl ≠ .kernel c (.endUse p)) : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | @cons st st₁ st₂ lbl lbls he hs _ ih =>
    refine .cons he ?_ hs (ih fun l hl => hn l (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl))
    have hl := hn lbl (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    cases lbl with
    | kernel c op =>
      cases op with
      | endUse p => exact absurd rfl (hl c p)
      | _ => trivial
    | _ => trivial

EOF

    SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where

  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :

      ProposedTrace k L st₁ lbls st₂ → ProposedTrace k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

    {lbls : List Label} (h : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st') : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons he _ hs _ ih => exact .cons he hs ih

theorem ProposedTrace.of_encap {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st')
    (hn : ∀ lbl ∈ lbls, ∀ c p, lbl ≠ .kernel c (.endUse p)) : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | @cons st st₁ st₂ lbl lbls he hs _ ih =>
    refine .cons he ?_ hs (ih fun l hl => hn l (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl))
    have hl := hn lbl (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    cases lbl with
    | kernel c op =>
      cases op with
      | endUse p => exact absurd rfl (hl c p)
      | _ => trivial
    | _ => trivial

import Ern.Concurrency.Preservation
import Ern.Concurrency.Reparent
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit

/-!
# Theorems 2 and 4 on labelled steps and traces (WC3 C20–C23, WC3.1)

Assembly of `Ern.Concurrency.Preservation`, `Ern.Concurrency.TransferPreserve`,
`Ern.Concurrency.Reparent` and `Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit`:

* theorem 2 for every labelled step of the kernel with the synchronization library, the by-value
  composite included (`lstep_kInvCA`);
* theorems 2 and 4 together along a `ProposedTrace` (an encapsulated trace whose steps also
  satisfy the clause `EndUseExcl` proposed by the report): `KInvCA` and `SyncState` (`trace_inv`,
  `trace_preserves`, `encapsulated_inv`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- Theorem 2 (WC3 C20, C23) on every labelled step (inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a
context, `spawn`, the by-value composite, `terminate`, `join`, `deriveSync` under the library
instantiation, `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`): the re-indexed kernel invariant with
the auxiliaries of Spec 1 (`KInvCA`) is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80, for `split`). -/
theorem lstep_kInvCA {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (hk : KInvCA st.1) : KInvCA st'.1 := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case exit => exact exitFrameC_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
    all_goals exact opStepC_preservesC hdd hk (fun e => by cases e) h
  | spawn h => exact spawn_preservesC hk h
  | spawnVal h => exact spawnVal_preservesC hk h
  | terminate h => exact terminate_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
  | join h => exact join_preservesC hk h
  | deriveSync h => exact deriveSync_preservesC hk h
  | newMutex h => obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk
  | acquire h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, -, -, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
    exact deriveSync_preservesC (r := _) hk ⟨hc, .ok hpre⟩
  | unlock h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, g, -, -, -, hrel, -, rfl⟩ := h
    exact opStepC_preservesC (op := .release g) hdd hk (fun e => by cases e)
      ⟨hc, _, .ok hrel, rfl⟩
  | resetLock h => obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC3 C20–C23, WC3.1) along a `ProposedTrace`: from a state satisfying
`KInvCA` and `SyncState`, every reached state satisfies both, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : KInvCA st'.1 ∧ SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨hk, hs⟩
  | cons he hx hst _ ih =>
    have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd hst hk
    exact ih hk' (lstep_preserves hst he hx hk hk'.1.1.2 hs)

/-- Theorem 4 (WC3 C22, C23, WC3.1), trace form: along a `ProposedTrace` from a state satisfying
`KInvCA`, `SyncState` is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 :=
  (trace_inv hdd h hk hs).2

/-- The initial state of Spec 1 §47 as a single-context state, with an empty registry (WC3 C3,
C12), satisfies `KInvCA` and `SyncState`. -/
theorem init_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (L : MutexLayout) :
    KInvCA (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) ∧ SyncState L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) [] := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hkc⟩ := reachable_single (k := k) hdd hst .init
  obtain ⟨-, haux, hh⟩ := init_kinv hst
  have hflat : (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)).flat = S3.init statics := by
    rw [single_flat ⟨_, rfl⟩, toS3_ofS3]
  refine ⟨⟨hkc, by rw [hflat]; exact haux, by rw [hflat]; exact hh⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro i j e e' ctl h; simp at h
  · intro i j e e' h; simp at h
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC3 C20–C23, WC3.1) from the initial state: every state reached from the
initial state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty registry) by a `ProposedTrace` satisfies the
re-indexed kernel invariant `KInvC`, `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline`, under `DDSound` (Spec 1
§80) and well-formed statics (Spec 1 §47). The clause `EndUseExcl` of `ProposedTrace` is not part
of `Encap`; without it the statement is false
(`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.endUse_ctl_breaks_ctlInit`). -/
theorem encapsulated_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : ProposedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st') :
    KInvC st'.1 ∧ SyncInv L st'.1 st'.2 ∧ GrantDiscipline st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hst L
  obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := trace_inv hdd h hk hs
  exact ⟨hk'.1, hs'.1, hs'.2⟩

end Ern.Concurrency
EOF

import Ern.Concurrency.Reparent
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit

/-!
# Theorems 2 and 4 on labelled steps and traces (WC3 C20–C23, WC3.1)

Assembly of `Ern.Concurrency.Preservation`, `Ern.Concurrency.TransferPreserve`,
`Ern.Concurrency.Reparent` and `Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit`:

* theorem 2 for every labelled step of the kernel with the synchronization library, the by-value
  composite included (`lstep_kInvCA`);
* theorems 2 and 4 together along a `ProposedTrace` (an encapsulated trace whose steps also
  satisfy the clause `EndUseExcl` proposed by the report): `KInvCA` and `SyncState` (`trace_inv`,
  `trace_preserves`, `encapsulated_inv`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- Theorem 2 (WC3 C20, C23) on every labelled step (inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a
context, `spawn`, the by-value composite, `terminate`, `join`, `deriveSync` under the library
instantiation, `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`): the re-indexed kernel invariant with
the auxiliaries of Spec 1 (`KInvCA`) is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80, for `split`). -/
theorem lstep_kInvCA {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (hk : KInvCA st.1) : KInvCA st'.1 := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case exit => exact exitFrameC_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
    all_goals exact opStepC_preservesC hdd hk (fun e => by cases e) h
  | spawn h => exact spawn_preservesC hk h
  | spawnVal h => exact spawnVal_preservesC hk h
  | terminate h => exact terminate_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
  | join h => exact join_preservesC hk h
  | deriveSync h => exact deriveSync_preservesC hk h
  | newMutex h => obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk
  | acquire h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, -, -, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
    exact deriveSync_preservesC (r := _) hk ⟨hc, .ok hpre⟩
  | unlock h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, g, -, -, -, hrel, -, rfl⟩ := h
    exact opStepC_preservesC (op := .release g) hdd hk (fun e => by cases e)
      ⟨hc, _, .ok hrel, rfl⟩
  | resetLock h => obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk

`KInvCA` and `SyncState`, every reached state satisfies both, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : KInvCA st'.1 ∧ SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨hk, hs⟩
  | cons he hx hst _ ih =>
    have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd hst hk
    exact ih hk' (lstep_preserves hst he hx hk hk'.1.1.2 hs)

`KInvCA`, `SyncState` is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 :=
  (trace_inv hdd h hk hs).2

C12), satisfies `KInvCA` and `SyncState`. -/
theorem init_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (L : MutexLayout) :
    KInvCA (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) ∧ SyncState L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) [] := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hkc⟩ := reachable_single (k := k) hdd hst .init
  obtain ⟨-, haux, hh⟩ := init_kinv hst
  have hflat : (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)).flat = S3.init statics := by
    rw [single_flat ⟨_, rfl⟩, toS3_ofS3]
  refine ⟨⟨hkc, by rw [hflat]; exact haux, by rw [hflat]; exact hh⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro i j e e' ctl h; simp at h
  · intro i j e e' h; simp at h
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC3 C20–C23, WC3.1) from the initial state: every state reached from the
initial state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty registry) by a `ProposedTrace` satisfies the
re-indexed kernel invariant `KInvC`, `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline`, under `DDSound` (Spec 1
§80) and well-formed statics (Spec 1 §47). The clause `EndUseExcl` of `ProposedTrace` is not part
of `Encap`; without it the statement is false
(`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.endUse_ctl_breaks_ctlInit`). -/
theorem encapsulated_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : ProposedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st') :
    KInvC st'.1 ∧ SyncInv L st'.1 st'.2 ∧ GrantDiscipline st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hst L
  obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := trace_inv hdd h hk hs
  exact ⟨hk'.1, hs'.1, hs'.2⟩

end Ern.Concurrency

/-- `transfer(slot, Y)` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §63 re-indexed. -/
theorem stepC_transfer : opStepC K0 (.transfer 1 7) 0 e2 (.ok eC) :=
  ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-! ## The transfer clause of `Encap` -/

/-- The transfer clause of `Encap` (WC3 C22.3) compares the source of O4 with the place holding
`guarded`, for every live entry; it says nothing of other places. -/
theorem encap_transfer_iff (st : SC × SyncReg) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Encap st (.kernel c (.transfer src dst)) ↔
      ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → (st.1.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) ≠ some (.place src) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- In `e2`, `guarded` (authority 4) is held by `slot` (place 1), a field of `M` (place 0). -/
theorem guarded_in_slot : (e2.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 1) ∧
    parentOf e2.P 1 = some 0 := by decide

/-- Verdict (b): `Encap` admits `transfer(M, M′)` in both variants and excludes
`transfer(slot, Y)`. -/
theorem encap_verdicts : Encap (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)) ∧
    Encap (e3, reg2) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)) ∧
    ¬ Encap (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 1 7)) := by
  refine ⟨fun e he _ => ?_, fun e he _ => ?_, fun h => h ⟨4, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) ?_⟩
  · simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · simp only [reg2, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · decide

/-! ## Encapsulated traces and invariants -/

/-- Variant A as an encapsulated trace from the initial state with an empty registry (WC3 C22,
C23). -/
theorem traceA : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4 [],
     .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)] (eA, reg1) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) <|
  .cons encap_verdicts.1 (.kernel stepA_transfer) .nil

/-- Variant B as an encapsulated trace from the initial state with an empty registry (WC3 C22,
C23). -/
theorem traceB : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4 [],
     .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)] (eB, reg2) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.acquire step_acquire.1) <|
  .cons encap_verdicts.2.1 (.kernel stepB_transfer) .nil

/-- The trace up to `newMutex` (WC3 C13), encapsulated. -/
theorem traceMutex : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4 []] (e2, reg1) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) .nil

/-- Controller uniqueness (WC3 C21.4) holds for a registry of one entry. -/
theorem ctlUnique_single (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : CtlUnique L s [e] := by
  intro i j _ _ _ hi hj _ _ _ _
  have h1 : i < 1 := lt_of_getElem? hi
  have h2 : j < 1 := lt_of_getElem? hj
  omega

/-- Verdict (c), variant A (from `trace_inv`, `init_inv`, and `ctlUnique_single` for the
registry of one entry): after `transfer(M, M′)`, `KInvC` (with the auxiliaries of Spec 1) and
`SyncState` (`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline`) hold, and the entry is live. -/
theorem invA : KInvCA eA ∧ SyncState L0 eA reg1 ∧ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eA := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 est_ok L0
  obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := trace_inv ddK0 traceA hk (syncState_iff.1 hs).1
  exact ⟨hk', syncState_iff.2 ⟨hs', ctlUnique_single _ _ _⟩, by decide⟩

/-- Verdict (c), variant B (from `trace_inv`, `init_inv` and `ctlUnique_single`): after
`transfer(M, M′)`, `KInvC` (with the auxiliaries of Spec 1) and `SyncState` hold; the entry is
live and the grant 5 is still active and held by frame 0. -/
/-! ## `transfer(slot, Y)` without the exclusion -/

/-- WC3 S16, C22.3: without the transfer clause of `Encap`, `SyncInv` is not preserved: from `e2`
(reached by an encapsulated trace without transfer, so `KInvC` and `SyncState` hold),
`transfer(slot, Y)` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §63 re-indexed; `Encap` excludes it (WC3 C22.3);
after it, the kernel invariant `KInvCA` holds, the entry is live, `guarded` is held by `Y`, which
has no structural parent, `ControlOf` is undefined, and `SyncInv` (WC3 C21.3 with the positional
`ControlOf` of WC3 C12) fails. -/
theorem slot_transfer_breaks_control :
    KInvCA e2 ∧ SyncState L0 e2 reg1 ∧ opStepC K0 (.transfer 1 7) 0 e2 (.ok eC) ∧
    ¬ Encap (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 1 7)) ∧ KInvCA eC ∧
    (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eC ∧ (eC.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 7) ∧
    parentOf eC.P 7 = none ∧ ControlOf L0 eC ⟨4, none⟩ = none ∧ ¬ SyncInv L0 eC reg1 := by
  obtain ⟨hk0, hs0⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 est_ok L0
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := trace_inv_noTransfer ddK0 traceMutex (fun l hl => by
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hl
    rcases hl with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> trivial) hk0 hs0
  refine ⟨hk, hs, stepC_transfer, encap_verdicts.2.2,
    lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.transfer 1 7)) (st := (e2, reg1)) (st' := (eC, reg1))
      (.kernel stepC_transfer) hk, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h.control ⟨4, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)
  revert this; decide

/-! ## `transfer(M, M′)` onto a live mutex value (WC3 C12, C21.4, C22.3) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M` with fields `1` (`slot`) and `2` (`lock`), both
`Init`; `3` the root `T`, owned by `slot`; `4` the mutex value `M′` with fields `5` (`slot′`) and
`6` (`lock′`), both `Uninit`; `7` the root `T′`, owned by `slot′`. Root authorities: `0` of `M`,
`1` of `T` (held by `slot`), `2` of `M′`, `3` of `T′` (held by `slot′`). -/
def mst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 4, none, 0), false),
   ((some 4, none, 0), false), ((none, some 5, 0), true)]

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem mst_ok : StaticsOK mst := by decide

/-- Initial single-context state of `mst` (Spec 1 §47). -/
def m0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst)

/-- Registry after `newMutex(1)` and `newMutex(3)` (WC3 C13). -/
def regM : SyncReg := [⟨1, none⟩, ⟨3, none⟩]

/-- `transfer(M = 0, M′ = 4)` by context 0 (Spec 1 §63). -/
def m1 : SC := transferEffC m0 0 0 4

/-- `newMutex(1)` and `newMutex(3)` are enabled (WC3 C13, with C13.8: distinct controllers `lock`
and `lock′`), and `transfer(M, M′)` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §63 re-indexed, admitted by `Encap`
(WC3 C22.3: its source is `M`, not a place holding a `guarded`). -/
theorem merge_steps : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] m0 [] 0 1 (m0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧

# Spec 2, jalon 1 — passe corrective WC3.1

Branche `formal/spec2-m1`. Sources : WC3 (`ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC3_corrige.md`) amendée par « WC3.1 — Targeted Corrections » (C13, C21, C22.3, C15.3, C18.3, C5.3, « Formalization coverage »), non commitées ; Spec 1 `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`.

Commit : `6be4024`. Il est groupé : `Encap` prend désormais `L`, `SyncInv` passe à 9 champs et `Label` gagne `spawnVal`, ce qui casse tous les modules qui en dépendent. Le rapport fait l'objet d'un commit séparé.

Vérifications :

- `lake build` réussit, sans avertissement.
- Le `grep` d'`AGENTS.md` est vide ; aucun `noncomputable`.
- Audit `collectAxioms` sur les 795 théorèmes `Ern.Concurrency*` : aucun axiome hors `{propext, Quot.sound}`.

## 1. Résultat principal : T4 complet est faux sous `Encap` seul

L'obligation de WC3.1 (« Formalization coverage ») est la préservation de `SyncInv` complet et de `GrantDiscipline` par toute transition admise par `Encap`. Elle **n'est pas déchargeable** : O12 `endUse` (Spec 1 §69) casse l'invariant d'initialisation de WC3.1 C21, et `Encap` ne l'exclut pas. La règle qui habilite le pas est l'effet `ok` de §69 :

> The leaves of value `place` become `Uninit`; `place` remains usable as a place.

`endUseS` ne libère que les autorités tenues **dans** `place`. Deux cas laissent donc l'entrée vivante :

| Pas | Clause cassée | Théorème |
|---|---|---|
| `endUse(ctl)` | `ctlInit` | `EncapTraces.endUse_ctl_breaks_ctlInit` (`EncapTraces.lean:240`) : trace encapsulée `derive`, `store`, `newMutex`, `endUse(lock)` depuis l'état initial ; `KInvCA` tient, l'entrée est vivante, `lock` est `Uninit`, `SyncInv` est faux |
| `endUse(q)`, `q` partie stricte de `slot` | `slotInit` | `EncapTraces.endUse_slotPart_breaks_slotInit` (`:278`) : `slot = {a, b}` possède `T`, `guarded` est la racine de `T` ; `newMutex`, puis `endUse(a)` ; `a` est `Uninit`, l'entrée est vivante |

L'unicité des contrôleurs (C21.4) en dépend aussi, le long des traces. `EncapTraces.endUse_then_transfer_merges` (`:331`) en donne un exemple, tous les pas étant admis par `Encap` :

1. `newMutex` sur deux mutex `M₁` et `M₂` à `slot` structurés ;
2. `endUse` des deux feuilles de `slot₂`, puis de `lock₂` ;
3. `transfer(M₁, M₂)`, accepté par §63.3 puisque `M₂` n'a plus de feuille `Init`.

Les deux entrées, vivantes, ont alors le contrôleur `lock₂`.

**Clause minimale de C22 proposée** (non ajoutée à `Encap`) : définie comme `EndUseExcl` (`SyncInit.lean:21`).

> While an entry is live, the safe mutex abstraction does not expose `endUse` whose place is the controller leaf `ctl` or a strict structural subplace of `slot`.

- **Nécessité de chaque cas.** Elle est montrée par les deux contre-exemples ci-dessus.
- **Cas non exclus.** `endUse(slot)`, `endUse(M)` et `endUse` d'un englobant de `M` libèrent `guarded`, tenu dans la place : l'entrée meurt. `endUse` d'un possesseur de `M` tue `slot` (le nettoyage libère `guarded`).
- **Suffisance.** Elle est prouvée : voir T4 au §3.

La décision de conception reste ouverte, comme l'exige WC3.1.

## 2. Définitions modifiées

| Définition | Avant (WC3) | Après (WC3.1) | Clause |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slotOf` (`SyncLib.lean:144`) | — | place qui tient `guarded` | WC3 C12 |
| `SlotInit`, `CtlInit` (`:179`, `:185`) | — | feuilles structurelles de `slotOf` `Init` ; `ControlOf(e)` `Init` ; sur les entrées vivantes | WC3.1 C21 |
| `SyncInv` (`:190`) | 7 champs | 9 champs : `slotInit`, `ctlInit` ajoutés | WC3.1 C21 |
| `NewMutexPre` (`:234`) | 10 champs | 11 : `initM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False` | WC3.1 C13 |
| `TransferExcl` (`:363`, avec instance `Decidable`) | — | pour toute entrée vivante : `¬ partOf P src slot` (items 1 et 2) et `ControlOf ≠ some src` (item 3) | WC3.1 C22.3 |
| `Encap` (`:383`) | `Encap st`, transfert : `holder ≠ place src` | `Encap L st` ; transfert : `TransferExcl L st src` ; `.spawnVal` : `EncapVals`, chaque source à l'état de sa phase de transfert | WC3.1 C22.3, « Formalization coverage » |
| `Label`, `LStep` | 9 étiquettes | ajout de `.spawnVal c ps ls vs` et du constructeur `LStep.spawnVal` sur `SpawnValStep` | WC3.1 « Formalization coverage » |
| `ResetLockOk` (`:311`) | inchangée | docstring WC3.1 C18.3 ; le champ existant (`ControlOf` feuille utilisable, C21.3) y correspond | WC3.1 C18.3 |
| `DeriveSyncPre` (`Sync.lean`) | inchangée | docstrings : `authorized` est l'autorisation exclusive | WC3.1 C15.3 |
| `SpawnValPre.paramsAtYield` (`Transfer.lean`) | inchangée | docstring WC3.1 C5.3, qui coïncide avec la lecture de la passe précédente | WC3.1 C5.3 |

Écart au brief :

- **`initM`.** Le brief écrit `∀ l ∈ footprint s.P (mutexOf s g)`. `mutexOf` est une `Option`, d'où la forme `OptP … False`. Si `mutexOf` vaut `none`, `newMutex` est rejeté ; `control` le rejette déjà dans ce cas.

Énoncés changés par répercussion :

- **`lstep_preserves`.** Il prend `KInvCA st.1` au lieu de `WF3 st.1.flat`, car le cas `spawnVal` a besoin des états intermédiaires. Il prend aussi `hx : EndUseExcl L st lbl`.
- **`trace_inv`, `trace_preserves`, `encapsulated_inv`.** Ils portent sur `ProposedTrace` (`SyncInit.lean:970`) : chaque pas satisfait `Encap` et `EndUseExcl`. `ProposedTrace.encap` le ramène à une `EncapsulatedTrace` ; `ProposedTrace.of_encap` couvre les traces encapsulées sans `endUse`.
- **`transfer_preserves`** (version `SyncCore`) devient `transfer_core`, au niveau de l'effet, pour servir aussi aux phases du composite.

## 3. État de T4

- **`lstep_preserves`** (`SyncInit.lean:934`). Tout pas sous `Encap` et `EndUseExcl` préserve `SyncState`, c'est-à-dire `SyncInv` complet et `GrantDiscipline`. Cela inclut `transfer`, le composite par valeur et toutes les opérations noyau et de bibliothèque.
- **`trace_inv`, `trace_preserves`, `encapsulated_inv`** (`Reachable.lean:50`, `:61`, `:94`) : mêmes conclusions le long d'une `ProposedTrace`. `encapsulated_inv` part de l'état initial.
- **`init_inv`** : re-prouvé avec les 9 champs.
- **Sans `EndUseExcl`** : réfuté (§1).

Retirés, car rendus inutiles par les théorèmes complets : `Label.NotTransfer`, `lstep_ctlUnique`, `lstep_syncState`, `trace_syncState`, `trace_inv_noTransfer`, `encapsulated_inv_noTransfer`, `ctlUnique_single`, `merge_steps`. `SyncCore` reste, mais seulement comme décomposition interne des lemmes par opération de `SyncPreserve.lean` (`:57`), jamais en conclusion d'un théorème T4.

## 4. Inductivité de l'initialisation, par opération

Liste des opérations et des lemmes qui portent la preuve ; toutes préservent `slotInit` et `ctlInit` sous `SyncState` et `Encap`, sauf la ligne O12.

| Opération | `slotInit`, `ctlInit` | Lemme |
|---|---|---|
| O1 `derive`, O2 `split`, O3 `release`, O5 `depend`, O9 `read`, O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin`, O7 `exit`, O13 `free` | préservés : `I` inchangé, empreintes des places existantes inchangées | `opStep_init` (`SyncInit.lean:210`), `init_step` (`:311`), `facts_syncState` (`:353`) |
| O8 `store`, O10 `write`, O11 `writeShared` | préservés : seuls des passages à `Init` | idem |
| O6 `enter`, O14 `alloc` | préservés : places ajoutées `Uninit`, anciennes inchangées (`Arena.footprint_shapeP`) | idem |
| O4 `transfer` | préservés sous WC3.1 C22.3 : si `slot` est dans la source, `guarded` passe à `corr(slot)` et le contrôleur à `corr(ctl)`, dans la destination, devenue `Init` ; sinon `slot` et `ctl` sont hors de la source (arbre, C22.3) | `transfer_syncState` (`:591`) |
| **O12 `endUse`** | **brèches** : `endUse(ctl)`, `endUse` d'une partie stricte de `slot` (§1) ; préservés sous `EndUseExcl` | `endUse_syncState` (`:387`) |
| `spawn` | préservé | `spawn_init` (`:302`), `facts_syncState` |
| composite par valeur | préservé : création, puis transferts sous `EncapVals`, la cession commutant avec les transferts | `spawnVal_syncState` (`:891`) |
| `terminate`, `join` | préservés : `I` et empreintes inchangés | `lstep_preserves` |
| `deriveSync` brut | exclu par `Encap` (C22.2) | `deriveSync_excluded` |
| `newMutex` | préservé : `initM` couvre `slot ⊆ M` et `ctl ∈ footprint(M)` | `newMutex_syncState` (`:721`) |
| `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock` | préservés : `I` inchangé, mise à jour d'entrée à `guarded` constant | `acquire_syncState`, `unlock_syncState`, `resetLock_syncState` (`:762`, `:780`, `:802`) |

**Unicité des contrôleurs.** Elle est préservée par chaque pas depuis `SyncState`. Pour `transfer`, deux arguments :

- **Contrôleur hors de la destination.** Le contrôleur d'une entrée non déplacée est `Init` (`ctlInit`). §63.3 garantit que la destination n'a aucune feuille `Init`, donc ce contrôleur n'est pas dans la destination.
- **Contrôleurs déplacés distincts.** `corr` est injectif sur les parties de la source (`corr_inj`, `SyncInit.lean:130`, nouveau).

Le long des traces, elle ne tombe qu'après une brèche d'`endUse` (`endUse_then_transfer_merges`). La même clause proposée l'exclut.

## 5. Rejets et jumeaux

| Énoncé | Verdict | Jumeau |
|---|---|---|
| `newMutex_uninit_rejected` (`EncapTraces.lean:382`) | dans la configuration de l'ancien `transfer_merges_controllers`, `newMutex(1)` est accepté et `newMutex(3)` est rejeté par `initM` (`M′` `Uninit`) | — |
| `transfer_merges_controllers_false` (`:388`) | négation de l'ancien énoncé : la trace `newMutex(1)`, `newMutex(3)`, `transfer(M, M′)` n'est pas un `LRun` | — |
| `transfer_into_live_mutex_rejected` (`SyncInit.lean:1005`, général) | sous `SyncState`, un `transfer` dont la destination contient le mutex d'une entrée vivante est rejeté par §63.3 : son `ctl` est `Init` | `invA`, `invB` : `transfer(M, M′)` vers `M′` sans entrée est `ok`, et `SyncState` complet tient (`traceA` et `traceB` sont des `ProposedTrace`) |
| `ctl_transfer_breaks_ctlInit` (`EncapTraces.lean:219`, S16 étendu) | `transfer(lock, Y)` est `ok` dans le noyau et exclu par C22.3 item 3 ; sans l'exclusion, `ctlInit` est faux (`lock` `Moved`) | `controlAB` |
| `slot_transfer_breaks_control` (S16) | inchangé, re-prouvé ; exclu par C22.3 item 1 | `controlAB` |

`transfer_merges_controllers` est donc remplacé par la preuve de la négation de son ancien énoncé.

Traces existantes, verdicts inchangés :

- `mutex_trace`, `distinct_controllers_ok`, `shared_controller_rejected` et `s4_*` : leurs états satisfont déjà `initM`.
- `EncapTraces.est` : `slot` devient `Init` par le `store` qui précède `newMutex`.

## 6. Théorèmes inchangés, re-prouvés, ouverts

- **T1** (`syncAuthorized_false`, `conservative_deriveSync`, `Conservativity.lean`) : énoncés et preuves inchangés.
- **T5** (`realizability`) : énoncé inchangé ; la preuve compile sans modification, elle n'utilise que `SyncInv.guarded`.
- **T2** :
  - `lstep_kInvCA` (`Reachable.lean:26`) couvre le cas `spawnVal` (`spawnVal_preservesC`) ; énoncé inchangé.
  - `spawnVal_preservesC`, `deriveSync_preservesC` : inchangés.
- **Ouverts.** Aucun énoncé demandé n'est resté sans preuve ou réfutation. T4 sous `Encap` seul est réfuté (§1) ; sous `EndUseExcl`, il est prouvé.

## 7. Problèmes de WC3.1

### W1. C22 n'exclut pas `endUse`, alors que l'obligation de « Formalization coverage » l'exige

Exemple : `endUse(lock)` après `newMutex` (§1). Spec 1 §69 habilite le pas. La clause proposée est `EndUseExcl` (§1) ; la décision reste ouverte.

### W2. C18.3 : « the controller-validity requirements of C21 »

Depuis WC3.1, C21 contient aussi l'invariant d'initialisation de `ctl`. Le modèle garde la validité de C21.3 (feuille utilisable existante) et n'y ajoute pas `ctlInit`, qui n'est pas intitulé « controller validity ». Sous `SyncInv`, la différence est sans effet : `ctlInit` tient pour toute entrée vivante.

### W3. C22.3 et le composite par valeur : état d'évaluation de l'exclusion

« Même exclusion que transfer pour chaque source de vs » ne dit pas dans quel état comparer. Le modèle compare chaque source à l'état du début de sa phase de transfert (`EncapVals`), comme O4 dans C5.2.

La lecture « état avant le composite » donnerait les mêmes pas admis. Argument, non prouvé : une source ultérieure ne peut être une locale de l'enfant (le créateur n'y a aucun droit), et une ancienne place de `slot` déplacée est `Moved`, donc rejetée par §63.3.

## 8. Décisions de représentation

1. **`slotOf` et `SlotInit`.** « all structural leaves of its `guarded`-holding field `slot` » se lit comme les feuilles de `footprint(slotOf)`.
2. **`TransferExcl`.** Les items 1 et 2 de C22.3 sont réunis en `partOf P src slot` (`slot` lui-même ou une partie stricte).
3. **`EndUseExcl` et `ProposedTrace`.** La clause proposée est une hypothèse des théorèmes, hors d'`Encap` : WC3.1 interdit d'ajouter une restriction en silence.
4. **`lstep_preserves`.** Il prend `KInvCA` avant le pas : le composite a besoin de `WF3` à chaque phase, obtenu par `TransferPreserveAux.transfers_base`.
5. **Lemmes copiés.** `corr_leaf'` copie la preuve de `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.corr_leaf` ; `ctl_transfer_eq` reprend `ctl_transfer` de `SyncPreserve.lean` en identifiant le contrôleur après le pas.
6. **Lemmes de la Spec 1 réutilisés.** `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.kstep_fp` et `footprint_shapeP` sont importés (empreintes des places existantes) ; leurs axiomes sont dans l'audit.

## 9. Écarts avec la Spec 1

Aucune clause de la Spec 1 n'est modifiée. `EndUseExcl` ne restreint pas O12 : elle restreint ce que l'abstraction sûre expose, comme C22.1–C22.3. Les opérations noyau gardent leurs préconditions et issues.

Exemple : `endUse(lock)` après `newMutex` (§1). Spec 1 §69 habilite le pas. La clause proposée est `EndUseExcl` (§1) ; la décision reste ouverte.

### W2. C18.3 : « the controller-validity requirements of C21 »

Depuis WC3.1, C21 contient aussi l'invariant d'initialisation de `ctl`. Le modèle garde la validité de C21.3 (feuille utilisable existante) et n'y ajoute pas `ctlInit`, qui n'est pas intitulé « controller validity ». Sous `SyncInv`, la différence est sans effet : `ctlInit` tient pour toute entrée vivante.

### W3. C22.3 et le composite par valeur : état d'évaluation de l'exclusion

« Même exclusion que transfer pour chaque source de vs » ne dit pas dans quel état comparer. Le modèle compare chaque source à l'état du début de sa phase de transfert (`EncapVals`), comme O4 dans C5.2.

La lecture « état avant le composite » donnerait les mêmes pas admis. Argument, non prouvé : une source ultérieure ne peut être une locale de l'enfant (le créateur n'y a aucun droit), et une ancienne place de `slot` déplacée est `Moved`, donc rejetée par §63.3.

## 8. Décisions de représentation

1. **`slotOf` et `SlotInit`.** « all structural leaves of its `guarded`-holding field `slot` » se lit comme les feuilles de `footprint(slotOf)`.
2. **`TransferExcl`.** Les items 1 et 2 de C22.3 sont réunis en `partOf P src slot` (`slot` lui-même ou une partie stricte).
3. **`EndUseExcl` et `ProposedTrace`.** La clause proposée est une hypothèse des théorèmes, hors d'`Encap` : WC3.1 interdit d'ajouter une restriction en silence.
4. **`lstep_preserves`.** Il prend `KInvCA` avant le pas : le composite a besoin de `WF3` à chaque phase, obtenu par `TransferPreserveAux.transfers_base`.
5. **Lemmes copiés.** `corr_leaf'` copie la preuve de `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.corr_leaf` ; `ctl_transfer_eq` reprend `ctl_transfer` de `SyncPreserve.lean` en identifiant le contrôleur après le pas.
6. **Lemmes de la Spec 1 réutilisés.** `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.kstep_fp` et `footprint_shapeP` sont importés (empreintes des places existantes) ; leurs axiomes sont dans l'audit.

## 9. Écarts avec la Spec 1

Aucune clause de la Spec 1 n'est modifiée. `EndUseExcl` ne restreint pas O12 : elle restreint ce que l'abstraction sûre expose, comme C22.1–C22.3. Les opérations noyau gardent leurs préconditions et issues.

## Objet

C22.5 est maintenant une clause de la candidate. Intégrer la restriction `endUse` au contrat d'encapsulation formel, supprimer l'hypothèse provisoire, re-vérifier T4 sur `EncapsulatedTrace` seule, et produire l'index consolidé du jalon 1.

| `SyncInit.lean`, `Reachable.lean` | `lstep_preserves` sans l'hypothèse `hx` ; `trace_inv`, `trace_preserves`, `encapsulated_inv` sur `EncapsulatedTrace` | WC4 C23 |

Aucune autre définition ne change. Si l'intégration force un changement d'énoncé ailleurs, le rapporter.

1. **T4** : `lstep_preserves`, `trace_inv`, `trace_preserves`, `encapsulated_inv`, `init_inv` re-prouvés sous `Encap` seule, `transfer` et `spawnVal` compris.

**Partie A — passe de clôture** : définitions modifiées ; état de T4 ; exclusions et jumeaux ; théorèmes inchangés ; problèmes de WC4 trouvés ; écarts avec la Spec 1.
