101	    a.InitRange (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len ∧ Auth.read ≤ ac.auth
102	
103	/-- Kernel conditions of a raw typed write by `ac`: §16.1, §16.2 and §16.3. The conditions
104	§16.4–§16.6 are the parametric obligations of `WriteOblSpec`. -/
105	def CanWrite (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
106	  ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ Auth.write ≤ ac.auth
107	
108	/-- The kernel conditions of a read are decidable (§15). -/
109	instance (s : State) (ac : Access) : Decidable (CanRead s ac) :=
110	  match h : s.allocs ac.prov with
111	  | some a =>
112	    if hc : a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ a.InitRange (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len ∧
113	        Auth.read ≤ ac.auth then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc⟩
114	    else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ => hc (by rw [h] at hb; cases hb; exact hb')
115	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb
116	
117	/-- The kernel conditions of a write are decidable (§16). -/
118	instance (s : State) (ac : Access) : Decidable (CanWrite s ac) :=
119	  match h : s.allocs ac.prov with
120	  | some a =>
121	    if hc : a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ Auth.write ≤ ac.auth then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc⟩
122	    else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ => hc (by rw [h] at hb; cases hb; exact hb')
123	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb
124	
125	/-- Partial resolution of a means of access to a place (§11 ¶2): defined when the
126	provenance identifies a registered allocation, live or dead, that spatially contains the
127	access. It proves no right to read or write. -/
128	def Access.toPlace (s : State) (ac : Access) : Option Place :=
129	  match s.allocs ac.prov with
130	  | some a => if Spatial a ac then some ⟨ac.prov, ac.addr - a.base, ac.len⟩ else none
131	  | none => none
132	
133	/-- Characterization of resolution (§11 ¶2). -/
134	theorem toPlace_eq_some {s : State} {ac : Access} {p : Place} :
135	    ac.toPlace s = some p ↔
136	      ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ Spatial a ac ∧
137	        p = ⟨ac.prov, ac.addr - a.base, ac.len⟩ := by
138	  unfold Access.toPlace
139	  split
140	  · next a ha =>
141	    by_cases hs : Spatial a ac
142	    · simp [hs, ha, eq_comm]
143	    · simp [hs, ha]
144	  · next ha => simp [ha]
145	
146	/-- The `len` bytes of `a` from offset `off`: the value of a valid read (§20.2 ¶1). -/
147	def Alloc.bytesAt (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : List AByte :=
148	  (List.range len).map fun i => a.bytes (off + i)
149	
150	/-- The `len` written bytes from position `off` of the supplied representation `w`, each
151	initialized with its value and provenance (§16 ¶2, §16 ¶5). -/
152	def writtenBytes (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (off len : Nat) : List AByte :=
153	  (List.range len).map fun i => .init (w (off + i)).1 (w (off + i)).2
154	
155	/-- Effect of a valid write on storage (§16 ¶2, §10 ¶4): the bytes at offsets
156	`[off, off + len)` are replaced byte by byte by `w`, initialized with the supplied value and
157	provenance; other bytes are unchanged (§16 ¶3). -/
158	def Alloc.write (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : Alloc :=
159	  { a with bytes := fun j =>
160	      if off ≤ j ∧ j < off + len then .init (w (j - off)).1 (w (j - off)).2 else a.bytes j }
161	
162	/-- Effect of a valid write of `w` through `ac` on the state (§16 ¶2, §16 ¶3). -/
163	def State.write (s : State) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : State :=
164	  { s with allocs := fun i =>
165	      if i = ac.prov then (s.allocs i).map (fun a => a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w)
166	      else s.allocs i }
167	
168	/-- Conditions of a successful raw deallocation of `id` with presented authority `auth`
169	(§17.1, §17.2): live, deallocatable, and `auth` compatible with the recorded token under the
170	context relation `C` (§17 ¶2, §17 ¶4). -/
171	def CanDealloc (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (s : State) (id auth : Nat) : Prop :=
172	  ∃ a, s.allocs id = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ ∃ d, a.freeAuth = some d ∧ C auth d
173	
174	/-- Deallocation conditions are decidable when compatibility is (§17, §20.3 ¶3). -/
175	instance {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} [DecidableRel C] (s : State) (id auth : Nat) :
176	    Decidable (CanDealloc C s id auth) :=
177	  match h : s.allocs id with
178	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb
179	  | some a =>
180	    match hf : a.freeAuth with
181	    | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _, d, hd, _⟩ => by
182	        rw [h] at hb
183	        cases hb
184	        rw [hf] at hd
185	        cases hd
186	    | some d =>
187	      if hc : a.live = true ∧ C auth d then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc.1, d, hf, hc.2⟩
188	      else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hl, d', hd', hc'⟩ => hc (by
189	        rw [h] at hb
190	        cases hb
191	        rw [hf] at hd'
192	        cases hd'
193	        exact ⟨hl, hc'⟩)
194	
195	/-- Effect of a valid deallocation (§17 ¶3, §20.2 ¶2): `id` becomes dead and stays
196	registered (§13 ¶1). -/
197	def State.dealloc (s : State) (id : Nat) : State :=
198	  { s with allocs := fun i =>
199	      if i = id then (s.allocs i).map (fun a => { a with live := false }) else s.allocs i }
200	
201	/-- Effect of a valid raw creation (§9 ¶11, §13 ¶1, §20.2 ¶2): a live allocation under the
202	identity `s.next`, wholly uninitialized (§10 ¶5); the counter advances (§9 ¶7). -/
203	def State.alloc (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) : State :=
204	  { allocs := fun i =>
205	      if i = s.next then
206	        some { space, base, size, align, live := true, bytes := fun _ => .uninit, freeAuth }
207	      else s.allocs i
208	    next := s.next + 1 }
209	
210	/-- Half-open ranges `[b1, b1 + n1)` and `[b2, b2 + n2)` have an empty intersection (§9 ¶3). -/
211	def RangeDisjoint (b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat) : Prop :=
212	  ∀ x, b1 ≤ x → x < b1 + n1 → b2 ≤ x → x < b2 + n2 → False
213	
214	/-- Arithmetic form of range disjointness (§9 ¶3). -/
215	theorem rangeDisjoint_iff {b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat} :
216	    RangeDisjoint b1 n1 b2 n2 ↔ b1 + n1 ≤ b2 ∨ b2 + n2 ≤ b1 ∨ n1 = 0 ∨ n2 = 0 := by
217	  constructor
218	  · intro h
219	    rcases Nat.le_total b1 b2 with h12 | h12
220	    · by_cases hlt : b2 < b1 + n1
221	      · by_cases hn : 0 < n2
222	        · exact (h b2 h12 hlt (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega)).elim
223	        · omega
224	      · omega
225	    · by_cases hlt : b1 < b2 + n2
226	      · by_cases hn : 0 < n1
227	        · exact (h b1 (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega) h12 hlt).elim
228	        · omega
229	      · omega
230	  · intro h x h1 h2 h3 h4
231	    omega
232	
233	/-- Range disjointness is decidable (§9 ¶3). -/
234	instance (b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat) : Decidable (RangeDisjoint b1 n1 b2 n2) :=
235	  decidable_of_iff _ rangeDisjoint_iff.symm
236	
237	/-- Disjointness of live allocations in the same address space (§9 ¶3, §9 ¶8 b2). -/
238	def LiveDisjoint (s : State) : Prop :=
239	  ∀ i j a b, i ≠ j → s.allocs i = some a → s.allocs j = some b →
240	    a.live = true → b.live = true → a.space = b.space →
241	    RangeDisjoint a.base a.size b.base b.size
242	
243	/-- `n` is a power of two (§9 ¶1 b5, §9 ¶4). -/
244	def Pow2 (n : Nat) : Prop := ∃ k, n = 2 ^ k
245	
246	/-- Bounded form of `Pow2` (§9 ¶4). -/
247	theorem pow2_iff (n : Nat) : Pow2 n ↔ ∃ k, k < n + 1 ∧ n = 2 ^ k :=
248	  ⟨fun ⟨k, hk⟩ => ⟨k, by have := @Nat.lt_two_pow_self k; omega, hk⟩, fun ⟨k, _, hk⟩ => ⟨k, hk⟩⟩
249	
250	/-- `Pow2` is decidable (§9 ¶4). -/
251	instance (n : Nat) : Decidable (Pow2 n) :=
252	  decidable_of_iff _ (pow2_iff n).symm
253	
254	/-- Operation preconditions of raw creation in space `space` (§9 ¶11): fresh identity
255	`s.next`, strictly positive power-of-two alignment, aligned base, no overlap with any live
256	allocation of the same space. -/
257	def AllocPre (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) : Prop :=
258	  s.allocs s.next = none ∧ 0 < align ∧ Pow2 align ∧ base % align = 0 ∧
259	    ∀ i a, s.allocs i = some a → a.live = true → a.space = space →
260	      RangeDisjoint a.base a.size base size
261	
262	/-- The entry `o` does not overlap `[base, base + size)` in space `space`: absent, dead, of
263	another space, or disjoint (§9 ¶11). -/
264	def NoOverlap (space base size : Nat) : Option Alloc → Prop
265	  | some a => a.live = true → a.space = space → RangeDisjoint a.base a.size base size
266	  | none => True
267	
268	/-- `NoOverlap` is decidable (§9 ¶11). -/
269	instance (space base size : Nat) : (o : Option Alloc) → Decidable (NoOverlap space base size o)
270	  | some a => inferInstanceAs
271	      (Decidable (a.live = true → a.space = space → RangeDisjoint a.base a.size base size))
272	  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
273	
274	/-- Decidable form of `AllocPre`, checking overlap on identities below the counter only
275	(§9 ¶11, §20.3 ¶3). -/
276	def AllocPreDec (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) : Prop :=
277	  s.allocs s.next = none ∧ 0 < align ∧ Pow2 align ∧ base % align = 0 ∧
278	    ∀ i, i < s.next → NoOverlap space base size (s.allocs i)
279	
280	/-- `AllocPreDec` is decidable (§20.3 ¶3). -/
281	instance (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) :
282	    Decidable (AllocPreDec s space base size align) := by
283	  unfold AllocPreDec
284	  infer_instance
285	
286	/-- Under freshness, `AllocPreDec` is `AllocPre` (§9 ¶7, §9 ¶11). -/
287	theorem allocPreDec_iff {s : State} (hwf : WF s) {space base size align : Nat} :
288	    AllocPreDec s space base size align ↔ AllocPre s space base size align := by
289	  constructor
290	  · rintro ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, hd⟩
291	    refine ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, fun i a ha hl hsp => ?_⟩
292	    have hi : i < s.next := Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => by rw [hwf i hle] at ha; cases ha
293	    have := hd i hi
294	    rw [ha] at this
295	    exact this hl hsp
296	  · rintro ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, hd⟩
297	    refine ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, fun i _ => ?_⟩
298	    cases ha : s.allocs i with
299	    | none => trivial
300	    | some a => exact fun hl hsp => hd i a ha hl hsp
301	
302	/-- Alignment of every registered allocation, live or dead (§9 ¶4, §9 ¶8 b3). -/
303	def Aligned (s : State) : Prop :=
304	  ∀ i a, s.allocs i = some a → 0 < a.align ∧ Pow2 a.align ∧ a.base % a.align = 0
305	
306	/-- Admissible state (§9 ¶8): freshness, live disjointness, alignment. -/
307	structure Admissible (s : State) : Prop where
308	  wf : WF s
309	  disjoint : LiveDisjoint s
310	  aligned : Aligned s
311	
312	/-- The empty state: no allocation, counter `0` (§9 ¶9). -/
313	def State.empty : State := ⟨fun _ => none, 0⟩
314	
315	/-- The empty state is an admissible initial state (§9 ¶9). -/
316	theorem admissible_empty : Admissible State.empty :=
317	  ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => nomatch h), (fun _ _ h => nomatch h)⟩
318	
319	/-! ## Restrictive derivation (§14) -/
320	
321	/-- `ac'` is a restrictive derivation of `ac` (§14 ¶1): same provenance, address subrange,
322	authority at most that of the source. -/
323	def Derive (ac ac' : Access) : Prop :=
324	  ac.addr ≤ ac'.addr ∧ ac'.addr + ac'.len ≤ ac.addr + ac.len ∧
325	    ac'.prov = ac.prov ∧ ac'.auth ≤ ac.auth
326	
327	/-- A restrictive derivation preserves provenance (§14 ¶1 b1). -/
328	theorem derive_prov {ac ac' : Access} (hd : Derive ac ac') : ac'.prov = ac.prov :=
329	  hd.2.2.1
330	
331	/-- A restrictive derivation of an access contained in an allocation is contained in it
332	(§14 ¶1 b2, §15 ¶1). -/
333	theorem derive_spatial {ac ac' : Access} (hd : Derive ac ac') {a : Alloc}
334	    (hs : Spatial a ac) : Spatial a ac' := by
335	  obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩ := hd
336	  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hs
337	  exact ⟨Nat.le_trans h3 h1, Nat.le_trans h2 h4⟩
338	
339	/-- A restrictive derivation confers no greater authority (§14 ¶1 b3). -/
340	theorem derive_auth_le {ac ac' : Access} (hd : Derive ac ac') : ac'.auth ≤ ac.auth :=
341	  hd.2.2.2
342	
343	/-! ## Parametric obligations and outcomes (§15 ¶5, §16 ¶4, §20) -/
344	
345	/-- Read obligations not defined by the kernel, §15.4, §15.6, §15.7 (§15 ¶5): explicit
346	predicates of the execution context (§20.3 ¶1), depending on the state, the access and the
347	read type; `dec` is the part with a decision procedure, `stat` the part established
348	statically or by contract (§20.3 ¶2). -/
349	structure ReadOblSpec (Ty : Type) where
350	  dec : State → Access → Ty → Prop
351	  stat : State → Access → Ty → Prop
352	
353	/-- Read obligations with a decision instance for `dec`, as required by a computable
354	interpreter (§20.3 ¶3). -/
355	structure ReadObl (Ty : Type) extends toSpec : ReadOblSpec Ty where
356	  decInst : ∀ s ac t, Decidable (dec s ac t)
357	
358	attribute [instance] ReadObl.decInst
359	
360	/-- Write obligations not defined by the kernel, §16.4, §16.5, §16.6 (§16 ¶4): explicit
361	predicates of the execution context (§20.3 ¶1), depending on the state, the access, the
362	written type and the supplied representation; split into `dec` and `stat` (§20.3 ¶2). -/
363	structure WriteOblSpec (Ty : Type) where
364	  dec : State → Access → Ty → (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Prop
365	  stat : State → Access → Ty → (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Prop
366	
367	/-- Write obligations with a decision instance for `dec`, as required by a computable
368	interpreter (§20.3 ¶3). -/
369	structure WriteObl (Ty : Type) extends toSpec : WriteOblSpec Ty where
370	  decInst : ∀ s ac t w, Decidable (dec s ac t w)
371	
372	attribute [instance] WriteObl.decInst
373	
374	/-- Outcome of a raw state-transforming operation: `ok` with the new state, or `ub`, which
375	supplies no state (§20.1 ¶2, §1). -/
376	inductive Outcome where
377	  | ok (s : State)
378	  | ub
379	
380	/-- Outcome of a raw read: `ok` with the bytes read, or `ub` (§20.1 ¶2, §20.2 ¶1). -/
381	inductive ReadOutcome where
382	  | ok (v : List AByte)
383	  | ub
384	  deriving DecidableEq
385	
386	section Relations
387	
388	variable {Ty : Type}
389	
390	/-- Raw typed read of type `t` through `ac` (§15, §20.1, §20.2 ¶1): `ok` with the bytes of
391	the accessed range when the kernel conditions (`CanRead`) and both parts of the obligations
392	hold; `ub` otherwise, a violated static part included (§20.1 ¶2 b2). The state is
393	unchanged. -/
394	inductive ReadStep (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (s : State) :
395	    ReadOutcome → Prop where
396	  | ok {a : Alloc} : s.allocs ac.prov = some a → CanRead s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac t ∧ ObR.stat s ac t →
397	      ReadStep ObR ac t s (.ok (a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len))
398	  | ub : ¬ (CanRead s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac t ∧ ObR.stat s ac t) → ReadStep ObR ac t s .ub
399	
400	/-- Raw typed write of `w` at type `t` through `ac` (§16, §20.1, §20.2 ¶2): `ok` with the
401	effect `State.write` when the kernel conditions (`CanWrite`) and both parts of the
402	obligations hold; `ub` otherwise (§20.1 ¶2 b2). -/
403	inductive WriteStep (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty)
404	    (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State) : Outcome → Prop where
405	  | ok : CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac t w ∧ ObW.stat s ac t w →
406	      WriteStep ObW ac t w s (.ok (s.write ac w))
407	  | ub : ¬ (CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac t w ∧ ObW.stat s ac t w) → WriteStep ObW ac t w s .ub
408	
409	end Relations
410	
411	/-- Raw deallocation of `id` with presented authority `auth` (§17, §20.1, §20.2 ¶2): `ok`
412	with the effect `State.dealloc` when `CanDealloc`; `ub` otherwise. `C` needs no decision
413	instance (§20.3 ¶3). -/
414	inductive DeallocStep (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (id auth : Nat) (s : State) : Outcome → Prop where
415	  | ok : CanDealloc C s id auth → DeallocStep C id auth s (.ok (s.dealloc id))
416	  | ub : ¬ CanDealloc C s id auth → DeallocStep C id auth s .ub
417	
418	/-- Raw creation (§9 ¶11, §20.1, §20.2 ¶2): `ok` with the effect `State.alloc` when
419	`AllocPre`; `ub` otherwise. -/
420	inductive AllocStep (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State) :
421	    Outcome → Prop where
422	  | ok : AllocPre s space base size align →
423	      AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s (.ok (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth))
424	  | ub : ¬ AllocPre s space base size align → AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s .ub
425	
426	/-! ## Interpreters (§20.3 ¶3; `formal/DESIGN.md`, "Representation") -/
427	
428	section Interpreters
429	
430	variable {Ty : Type}
431	
432	/-- Interpreter of `ReadStep`: decides the kernel conditions and `dec`, takes the static
433	part `stat` as a proof argument (§20.3 ¶3), and returns the bytes read (§20.2 ¶1). -/
434	def read (ObR : ReadObl Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (s : State) (_hs : ObR.stat s ac t) :
435	    ReadOutcome :=
436	  match s.allocs ac.prov with
437	  | some a =>
438	    if CanRead s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac t then .ok (a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len) else .ub
439	  | none => .ub
440	
441	/-- Interpreter of `WriteStep`: decides the kernel conditions and `dec`, takes `stat` as a
442	proof argument (§20.3 ¶3). -/
443	def write (ObW : WriteObl Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State)
444	    (_hs : ObW.stat s ac t w) : Outcome :=
445	  if CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac t w then .ok (s.write ac w) else .ub
446	
447	end Interpreters
448	
449	/-- Interpreter of `DeallocStep`, given a decision instance for compatibility (§20.3 ¶3). -/
450	def dealloc (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (id auth : Nat) (s : State) : Outcome :=
451	  if CanDealloc C s id auth then .ok (s.dealloc id) else .ub
452	
453	/-- Interpreter of `AllocStep`, taking freshness `WF s` as a proof argument; it decides
454	`AllocPreDec`, which is `AllocPre` under `WF` (§9 ¶11, §20.3 ¶3). -/
455	def alloc (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State) (_hwf : WF s) :
456	    Outcome :=
457	  if AllocPreDec s space base size align then .ok (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth)
458	  else .ub
459	
460	/-! ## Executions (§9 ¶9, §20.1 ¶2, §20.3 ¶3) -/
461	
462	/-- Raw operations of the machine (§15, §16, §17, §9 ¶11, §20.1). -/
463	inductive Op (Ty : Type) where
464	  | read (ac : Access) (t : Ty)
465	  | write (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
466	  | dealloc (id auth : Nat)
467	  | alloc (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat)
468	
469	section Executions
470	
471	variable {Ty : Type}
472	
473	/-- `ok` transitions of the raw operations, with compatibility and obligations fixed by the
474	execution context (§20.1 ¶2, §20.3 ¶3). A read leaves the state unchanged (§20.2 ¶1). -/
475	inductive Step (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty) :
476	    Op Ty → State → State → Prop where
477	  | read {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State} {v : List AByte} :
478	      ReadStep ObR ac t s (.ok v) → Step C ObR ObW (.read ac t) s s
479	  | write {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s s' : State} :
480	      WriteStep ObW ac t w s (.ok s') → Step C ObR ObW (.write ac t w) s s'
481	  | dealloc {id auth : Nat} {s s' : State} :
482	      DeallocStep C id auth s (.ok s') → Step C ObR ObW (.dealloc id auth) s s'
483	  | alloc {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s s' : State} :
484	      AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s (.ok s') →
485	      Step C ObR ObW (.alloc space base size align freeAuth) s s'
486	
487	/-- Execution: a sequence of `ok` steps under one context (§20.3 ¶3). A `ub` step supplies
488	no state, so it never occurs inside an execution (§20.1 ¶2 b3). -/
489	inductive Exec (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty) :
490	    List (Op Ty) → State → State → Prop where
491	  | nil (s : State) : Exec C ObR ObW [] s s
492	  | cons {op : Op Ty} {ops : List (Op Ty)} {s s' s'' : State} :
493	      Step C ObR ObW op s s' → Exec C ObR ObW ops s' s'' → Exec C ObR ObW (op :: ops) s s''
494	
495	/-- `s` is reachable from the initial state `s₀`, which need not be empty (§9 ¶9). -/
496	def Reachable (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty)
497	    (s₀ s : State) : Prop :=
498	  ∃ ops, Exec C ObR ObW ops s₀ s
499	
500	/-- The operation neither writes through provenance `i` nor deallocates `i`. Used to state
501	the "absence of an intervening write or invalidation" of §16 ¶5 for allocation `i`; writes
502	through other provenances are allowed (non-interference, §16 ¶5). -/
503	def Op.KeepsAlloc (i : Nat) : Op Ty → Prop
504	  | .read _ _ => True
505	  | .write ac _ _ => ac.prov ≠ i
506	  | .dealloc id _ => id ≠ i
507	  | .alloc .. => True
508	
509	end Executions
510	
511	/-! ## Outcome characterizations, determinism, totality (§20.1) -/
512	
513	section Theorems
514	
515	variable {Ty : Type}
516	
517	/-- `ok` outcome of a raw read (§15, §20.1 ¶2 b1, §20.2 ¶1). -/
518	theorem ReadStep_ok_iff {ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State}
519	    {v : List AByte} :
520	    ReadStep ObR ac t s (.ok v) ↔ (CanRead s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac t ∧ ObR.stat s ac t) ∧
521	      ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ v = a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len :=
522	  ⟨fun h => by cases h with | ok ha h => exact ⟨h, _, ha, rfl⟩,
523	   fun ⟨h, _, ha, e⟩ => by subst e; exact .ok ha h⟩
524	
525	/-- `ok` outcome of a raw write (§16, §20.1 ¶2 b1). -/
526	theorem WriteStep_ok_iff {ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty}
527	    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s s' : State} :
528	    WriteStep ObW ac t w s (.ok s') ↔
529	      (CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac t w ∧ ObW.stat s ac t w) ∧ s' = s.write ac w :=
530	  ⟨fun h => by cases h with | ok h => exact ⟨h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => by subst e; exact .ok h⟩
531	
532	/-- `ok` outcome of a raw deallocation (§17, §20.1 ¶2 b1). -/
533	theorem DeallocStep_ok_iff {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {id auth : Nat} {s s' : State} :
534	    DeallocStep C id auth s (.ok s') ↔ CanDealloc C s id auth ∧ s' = s.dealloc id :=
535	  ⟨fun h => by cases h with | ok h => exact ⟨h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => by subst e; exact .ok h⟩
536	
537	/-- `ok` outcome of a raw creation (§9 ¶11, §20.1 ¶2 b1). -/
538	theorem AllocStep_ok_iff {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s s' : State} :
539	    AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s (.ok s') ↔
540	      AllocPre s space base size align ∧ s' = s.alloc space base size align freeAuth :=
541	  ⟨fun h => by cases h with | ok h => exact ⟨h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => by subst e; exact .ok h⟩
542	
543	/-- A raw read has at most one outcome (§20.1 ¶3). -/
544	theorem ReadStep_det {ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State}
545	    {o₁ o₂ : ReadOutcome} (h₁ : ReadStep ObR ac t s o₁) (h₂ : ReadStep ObR ac t s o₂) :
546	    o₁ = o₂ := by
547	  cases h₁ with
548	  | ok ha _ =>
549	    cases h₂ with
550	    | ok hb _ => rw [ha] at hb; cases hb; rfl
551	    | ub => contradiction
552	  | ub => cases h₂ with
553	    | ok => contradiction
554	    | ub => rfl
555	
556	/-- A raw write has at most one outcome (§20.1 ¶3). -/
557	theorem WriteStep_det {ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty}
558	    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s : State} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome}
559	    (h₁ : WriteStep ObW ac t w s o₁) (h₂ : WriteStep ObW ac t w s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
560	  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction
561	
562	/-- A raw deallocation has at most one outcome (§20.1 ¶3). -/
563	theorem DeallocStep_det {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {id auth : Nat} {s : State}
564	    {o₁ o₂ : Outcome} (h₁ : DeallocStep C id auth s o₁) (h₂ : DeallocStep C id auth s o₂) :
565	    o₁ = o₂ := by
566	  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction
567	
568	/-- A raw creation has at most one outcome (§20.1 ¶3). -/
569	theorem AllocStep_det {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s : State}
570	    {o₁ o₂ : Outcome} (h₁ : AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o₁)
571	    (h₂ : AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
572	  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction
573	
574	/-- Totality of the raw read on every state (§20.1 ¶3), in the constructive form
575	`¬¬∃`, classically equivalent to `∃`; `stat` has no decision procedure. -/
576	theorem ReadStep_total (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (s : State) :
577	    ¬¬ ∃ o, ReadStep ObR ac t s o :=
578	  fun hn => hn ⟨.ub, .ub fun h => let ⟨_, ha, _⟩ := h.1; hn ⟨_, .ok ha h⟩⟩
579	
580	/-- Totality of the raw write on every state (§20.1 ¶3), constructive form `¬¬∃`. -/
581	theorem WriteStep_total (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty)
582	    (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State) : ¬¬ ∃ o, WriteStep ObW ac t w s o :=
583	  fun hn => hn ⟨.ub, .ub fun h => hn ⟨_, .ok h⟩⟩
584	
585	/-- Totality of the raw deallocation on every state (§20.1 ¶3), constructive form `¬¬∃`;
586	`C` has no decision procedure. -/
587	theorem DeallocStep_total (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (id auth : Nat) (s : State) :
588	    ¬¬ ∃ o, DeallocStep C id auth s o :=
589	  fun hn => hn ⟨.ub, .ub fun h => hn ⟨_, .ok h⟩⟩
590	
591	/-- Totality of the raw creation on every state (§20.1 ¶3), constructive form `¬¬∃`;
592	`AllocPre` quantifies over every identity. -/
593	theorem AllocStep_total (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State) :
594	    ¬¬ ∃ o, AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o :=
595	  fun hn => hn ⟨.ub, .ub fun h => hn ⟨_, .ok h⟩⟩
596	
597	/-! ## Agreement of the interpreters with the relations (§20.3 ¶3) -/
598	
599	/-- Soundness of `read`: its result is an outcome of `ReadStep` (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
600	theorem read_sound {ObR : ReadObl Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State}
601	    {hs : ObR.stat s ac t} {o : ReadOutcome} (h : read ObR ac t s hs = o) :
602	    ReadStep ObR.toSpec ac t s o := by
603	  subst h
604	  unfold read
605	  split
606	  · next a ha =>
607	    split
608	    · next hc => exact .ok ha ⟨hc.1, hc.2, hs⟩
609	    · next hc => exact .ub fun ⟨h1, h2, _⟩ => hc ⟨h1, h2⟩
610	  · next ha => exact .ub fun ⟨⟨b, hb, _⟩, _⟩ => by rw [ha] at hb; cases hb
611	
612	/-- Completeness of `read`: every outcome of `ReadStep` is the result of `read`, for every
613	proof of the static part (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
614	theorem read_complete {ObR : ReadObl Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State}
615	    {o : ReadOutcome} (h : ReadStep ObR.toSpec ac t s o) (hs : ObR.stat s ac t) :
616	    read ObR ac t s hs = o := by
617	  unfold read
618	  cases h with
619	  | ok ha hc =>
620	    split
621	    · next b hb =>
622	      rw [ha] at hb
623	      cases hb
624	      exact ite_eq_left ⟨hc.1, hc.2.1⟩
625	    · next hb => rw [ha] at hb; cases hb
626	  | ub hc =>
627	    split
628	    · exact ite_eq_right fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => hc ⟨h1, h2, hs⟩
629	    · rfl
630	
631	/-- Soundness of `write` (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
632	theorem write_sound {ObW : WriteObl Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat}
633	    {s : State} {hs : ObW.stat s ac t w} {o : Outcome} (h : write ObW ac t w s hs = o) :
634	    WriteStep ObW.toSpec ac t w s o := by
635	  subst h
636	  unfold write
637	  split
638	  · next hc => exact .ok ⟨hc.1, hc.2, hs⟩
639	  · next hc => exact .ub fun ⟨h1, h2, _⟩ => hc ⟨h1, h2⟩
640	
641	/-- Completeness of `write`, for every proof of the static part (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
642	theorem write_complete {ObW : WriteObl Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty}
643	    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s : State} {o : Outcome}
644	    (h : WriteStep ObW.toSpec ac t w s o) (hs : ObW.stat s ac t w) :
645	    write ObW ac t w s hs = o := by
646	  unfold write
647	  cases h with
648	  | ok h => exact ite_eq_left ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
649	  | ub h => exact ite_eq_right fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => h ⟨h1, h2, hs⟩
650	
651	end Theorems
652	
653	/-- Soundness of `dealloc` (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
654	theorem dealloc_sound {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} [DecidableRel C] {id auth : Nat} {s : State}
655	    {o : Outcome} (h : dealloc C id auth s = o) : DeallocStep C id auth s o := by
656	  subst h
657	  unfold dealloc
658	  split
659	  · next hc => exact .ok hc
660	  · next hc => exact .ub hc
661	
662	/-- Completeness of `dealloc` (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
663	theorem dealloc_complete {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} [DecidableRel C] {id auth : Nat} {s : State}
664	    {o : Outcome} (h : DeallocStep C id auth s o) : dealloc C id auth s = o := by
665	  unfold dealloc
666	  cases h with
667	  | ok h => exact ite_eq_left h
668	  | ub h => exact ite_eq_right h
669	
670	/-- Soundness of `alloc` on states satisfying `WF` (§9 ¶11, §20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
671	theorem alloc_sound {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s : State}
672	    {hwf : WF s} {o : Outcome} (h : alloc space base size align freeAuth s hwf = o) :
673	    AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o := by
674	  subst h
675	  unfold alloc
676	  split
677	  · next hc => exact .ok ((allocPreDec_iff hwf).1 hc)
678	  · next hc => exact .ub (mt (allocPreDec_iff hwf).2 hc)
679	
680	/-- Completeness of `alloc`, for every proof of `WF` (§9 ¶11, §20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
681	theorem alloc_complete {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s : State}
682	    {o : Outcome} (h : AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o) (hwf : WF s) :
683	    alloc space base size align freeAuth s hwf = o := by
684	  unfold alloc
685	  cases h with
686	  | ok h => exact ite_eq_left ((allocPreDec_iff hwf).2 h)
687	  | ub h => exact ite_eq_right (mt (allocPreDec_iff hwf).1 h)
688	
689	section Domain
690	
691	variable {Ty : Type}
692	
693	/-- On the interpreter's domain the raw read has an outcome, computed by `read` (§20.1 ¶3). -/
694	theorem ReadStep_total_on (ObR : ReadObl Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (s : State)
695	    (hs : ObR.stat s ac t) : ∃ o, ReadStep ObR.toSpec ac t s o :=
696	  ⟨_, read_sound (hs := hs) rfl⟩
697	
698	/-- On the interpreter's domain the raw write has an outcome, computed by `write`
699	(§20.1 ¶3). -/
700	theorem WriteStep_total_on (ObW : WriteObl Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty)
701	    (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State) (hs : ObW.stat s ac t w) :
702	    ∃ o, WriteStep ObW.toSpec ac t w s o :=
703	  ⟨_, write_sound (hs := hs) rfl⟩
704	
705	end Domain
706	
707	/-- With decidable compatibility the raw deallocation has an outcome, computed by
708	`dealloc` (§20.1 ¶3). -/
709	theorem DeallocStep_total_on (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (id auth : Nat)
710	    (s : State) : ∃ o, DeallocStep C id auth s o :=
711	  ⟨_, dealloc_sound rfl⟩
712	
713	/-- On states satisfying `WF` the raw creation has an outcome, computed by `alloc`
714	(§20.1 ¶3). -/
715	theorem AllocStep_total_on (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State)
716	    (hwf : WF s) : ∃ o, AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o :=
717	  ⟨_, alloc_sound (hwf := hwf) rfl⟩
718	
719	/-! ## Effects: frame and invariants (§9, §13, §16 ¶2–¶3, §17 ¶3, §20.2 ¶2) -/
720	
721	/-- Entry of the written allocation after the write effect (§16 ¶2). -/
722	theorem State.write_allocs_self (s : State) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
723	    (s.write ac w).allocs ac.prov =
724	      (s.allocs ac.prov).map (fun a => a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w) := by
725	  dsimp only [State.write]
726	  exact ite_eq_left rfl
727	
728	/-- Entry of the deallocated allocation after the deallocation effect (§17 ¶3). -/
729	theorem State.dealloc_allocs_self (s : State) (id : Nat) :
730	    (s.dealloc id).allocs id = (s.allocs id).map (fun a => { a with live := false }) := by
731	  dsimp only [State.dealloc]
732	  exact ite_eq_left rfl
733	
734	/-- Entry of the new allocation after the creation effect (§9 ¶11, §10 ¶5). -/
735	theorem State.alloc_allocs_self (s : State) (space base size align : Nat)
736	    (freeAuth : Option Nat) :
737	    (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth).allocs s.next =
738	      some { space, base, size, align, live := true, bytes := fun _ => .uninit, freeAuth } := by
739	  dsimp only [State.alloc]
740	  exact ite_eq_left rfl
741	
742	/-- Inside the written range, offset `off + i` holds the `i`-th written byte with its value
743	and provenance (§16 ¶2). -/
744	theorem Alloc.write_bytes_in (a : Alloc) {off len : Nat} (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
745	    {i : Nat} (hi : i < len) : (a.write off len w).bytes (off + i) = .init (w i).1 (w i).2 := by
746	  simp only [Alloc.write]
747	  rw [ite_eq_left ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ _, Nat.add_lt_add_left hi _⟩, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
748	
749	/-- Outside the written range, bytes are unchanged (§16 ¶3). -/
750	theorem Alloc.write_bytes_out (a : Alloc) {off len : Nat} (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
751	    {j : Nat} (hj : ¬ (off ≤ j ∧ j < off + len)) : (a.write off len w).bytes j = a.bytes j := by
752	  simp only [Alloc.write]
753	  exact ite_eq_right hj
754	
755	/-- Freshness is preserved by the write effect (§9 ¶7, §13 ¶3). -/
756	theorem write_wf {s : State} (hwf : WF s) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
757	    WF (s.write ac w) := by
758	  intro i hi
759	  simp only [State.write, hwf i hi]
760	  split <;> rfl
761	
762	/-- Freshness is preserved by the deallocation effect (§9 ¶7, §13 ¶3). -/
763	theorem dealloc_wf {s : State} (hwf : WF s) (id : Nat) : WF (s.dealloc id) := by
764	  intro i hi
765	  simp only [State.dealloc, hwf i hi]
766	  split <;> rfl
767	
768	/-- Freshness is preserved by the creation effect (§9 ¶7, §13 ¶1). -/
769	theorem alloc_wf {s : State} (hwf : WF s) (space base size align : Nat)
770	    (freeAuth : Option Nat) : WF (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth) := by
771	  intro i hi
772	  have hi' : s.next + 1 ≤ i := hi
773	  have hne : i ≠ s.next := fun e => by rw [e] at hi'; exact Nat.not_succ_le_self _ hi'
774	  simp only [State.alloc]
775	  rw [ite_eq_right hne]
776	  exact hwf i (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi')
777	
778	/-- A step that makes no allocation live and keeps space, base and extent of every
779	allocation that stays live preserves live disjointness (§9 ¶3). -/
780	theorem LiveDisjoint.of_fields {s s' : State} (hd : LiveDisjoint s)
781	    (h : ∀ i a, s'.allocs i = some a → a.live = true →
782	      ∃ a₀, s.allocs i = some a₀ ∧ a₀.live = true ∧ a₀.space = a.space ∧
783	        a₀.base = a.base ∧ a₀.size = a.size) :
784	    LiveDisjoint s' := by
785	  intro i j a b hij ha hb hla hlb hsp
786	  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hla₀, hs₁, hb₁, hz₁⟩ := h i a ha hla
787	  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀, hlb₀, hs₂, hb₂, hz₂⟩ := h j b hb hlb
788	  have := hd i j a₀ b₀ hij ha₀ hb₀ hla₀ hlb₀ (by rw [hs₁, hs₂, hsp])
789	  rw [hb₁, hz₁, hb₂, hz₂] at this
790	  exact this
791	
792	/-- Live disjointness is preserved by the write effect (§9 ¶3). -/
793	theorem liveDisjoint_write {s : State} (hd : LiveDisjoint s) (ac : Access)
794	    (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : LiveDisjoint (s.write ac w) :=
795	  hd.of_fields fun i a ha hla => by
796	    simp only [State.write] at ha
797	    split at ha
798	    · obtain ⟨a₀, h₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ha
799	      exact ⟨a₀, h₀, hla, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
800	    · exact ⟨a, ha, hla, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
801	
802	/-- Live disjointness is preserved by the deallocation effect (§9 ¶3). -/
803	theorem liveDisjoint_dealloc {s : State} (hd : LiveDisjoint s) (id : Nat) :
804	    LiveDisjoint (s.dealloc id) :=
805	  hd.of_fields fun i a ha hla => by
806	    simp only [State.dealloc] at ha
807	    split at ha
808	    · obtain ⟨a₀, -, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ha
809	      exact nomatch hla
810	    · exact ⟨a, ha, hla, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
811	
812	/-- Live disjointness is preserved by a creation satisfying its preconditions (§9 ¶3,
813	§9 ¶11). -/
814	theorem liveDisjoint_alloc {s : State} (hd : LiveDisjoint s) {space base size align : Nat}
815	    (hp : AllocPre s space base size align) (freeAuth : Option Nat) :
816	    LiveDisjoint (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth) := by
817	  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hdis⟩ := hp
818	  intro i j a b hij ha hb hla hlb hsp
819	  simp only [State.alloc] at ha hb
820	  by_cases hi : i = s.next <;> by_cases hj : j = s.next
821	  · exact absurd (hi.trans hj.symm) hij
822	  · rw [ite_eq_left hi] at ha
823	    rw [ite_eq_right hj] at hb
824	    cases ha
825	    exact fun x h1 h2 h3 h4 => hdis j b hb hlb hsp.symm x h3 h4 h1 h2
826	  · rw [ite_eq_right hi] at ha
827	    rw [ite_eq_left hj] at hb
828	    cases hb
829	    exact hdis i a ha hla hsp
830	  · rw [ite_eq_right hi] at ha
831	    rw [ite_eq_right hj] at hb
832	    exact hd i j a b hij ha hb hla hlb hsp
833	
834	/-- Alignment is preserved by the write effect (§9 ¶4). -/
835	theorem aligned_write {s : State} (h : Aligned s) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
836	    Aligned (s.write ac w) := by
837	  intro i a ha
838	  simp only [State.write] at ha
839	  split at ha
840	  · obtain ⟨a₀, h₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ha
841	    exact h i a₀ h₀
842	  · exact h i a ha
843	
844	/-- Alignment is preserved by the deallocation effect (§9 ¶4). -/
845	theorem aligned_dealloc {s : State} (h : Aligned s) (id : Nat) : Aligned (s.dealloc id) := by
846	  intro i a ha
847	  simp only [State.dealloc] at ha
848	  split at ha
849	  · obtain ⟨a₀, h₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ha
850	    exact h i a₀ h₀
851	  · exact h i a ha
852	
853	/-- Alignment is preserved by a creation satisfying its preconditions (§9 ¶4, §9 ¶11). -/
854	theorem aligned_alloc {s : State} (h : Aligned s) {space base size align : Nat}

/-!
# Elementary memory machine (spec v0.1, Parts II–III, §8–§20)

Source: `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`. Citations: `§N.k` is numbered item `k`
of section `N`; `§N ¶p` is the `p`-th paragraph of section `N`, a list belonging to the
paragraph that introduces it.

* State, allocations, bytes, places and accesses (§9–§12).
* Effects of valid operations: `State.write`, `State.dealloc`, `State.alloc`.
* Raw operations as transition relations with `ok`/`ub` outcomes, stated on every state
  (§20.1): `ReadStep`, `WriteStep`, `DeallocStep`, `AllocStep`. Typed reads and writes carry
  a type argument of an opaque type `Ty`; their unspecified obligations are explicit
  parameters split into a decidable part `dec` and a static part `stat` (§20.3).
* Interpreters `read`, `write`, `dealloc`, `alloc`, computable, with the static part as a
  proof argument (§20.3 ¶3), agreeing with the relations in both directions.
* Executions `Exec` (sequences of `ok` steps) from any initial state (§9 ¶9).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Machine

/-! ## State and accesses (Part II) -/

/-- Elementary access authority of a means of access (§12 ¶1, §12 ¶4). -/
inductive Auth where
  | read
  | write
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- The elementary authority order `read ≤ write`, reflexive (§12 ¶4). -/
instance : LE Auth := ⟨fun a b => a = .read ∨ b = .write⟩

/-- The elementary authority order is decidable (§12 ¶4). -/
instance (a b : Auth) : Decidable (a ≤ b) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (a = .read ∨ b = .write))

/-- Abstract byte: uninitialized, or initialized with an 8-bit value and an optional
provenance represented by an allocation identity (§10 ¶1–¶3). -/
inductive AByte where
  | uninit
  | init (val : UInt8) (prov : Option Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Abstract allocation (§9 ¶1). Its identity is its key in `State.allocs`. `bytes` is
indexed by offset from `base`; offsets outside `[0, size)` are reached by no permitted
access (`Spatial`). `freeAuth = some d` records the deallocation token `d` of a
deallocatable allocation (§9 ¶1 b8, §17 ¶4); `none` marks a non-deallocatable one. -/
structure Alloc where
  space : Nat
  base : Nat
  size : Nat
  align : Nat
  live : Bool
  bytes : Nat → AByte
  freeAuth : Option Nat

/-- Place of the minimal kernel: allocation identity, offset and length (§11 ¶1). -/
structure Place where
  alloc : Nat
  off : Nat
  len : Nat

/-- Means of access: address, provenance (an allocation identity), length and elementary
access authority (§12 ¶1, §12 ¶2). -/
structure Access where
  addr : Nat
  prov : Nat
  len : Nat
  auth : Auth

/-- Abstract state: registered allocations by identity, live or dead, and the counter `next`
representing the freshness discipline (§9 ¶7, §13 ¶1). -/
structure State where
  allocs : Nat → Option Alloc
  next : Nat

/-- Well-formedness of identities and freshness: no identity at or above the counter is
registered (§9 ¶7, §9 ¶8 b1). -/
def WF (s : State) : Prop := ∀ i, s.next ≤ i → s.allocs i = none

/-- Spatial containment of an access in an allocation (§15 ¶1; used by §15.2 and §16.2). -/
def Spatial (a : Alloc) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  a.base ≤ ac.addr ∧ ac.addr + ac.len ≤ a.base + a.size

/-- Spatial containment is decidable (§15 ¶1). -/
instance (a : Alloc) (ac : Access) : Decidable (Spatial a ac) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (a.base ≤ ac.addr ∧ ac.addr + ac.len ≤ a.base + a.size))

/-- The `len` bytes from offset `off` are initialized (§15.3, read as: every byte of the
accessed range). -/
def Alloc.InitRange (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i < len → a.bytes (off + i) ≠ .uninit

/-- Initialization of a range is decidable (§15.3). -/
instance (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : Decidable (a.InitRange off len) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ i, i < len → a.bytes (off + i) ≠ .uninit))

/-- Kernel conditions of a raw typed read by `ac`: §15.1, §15.2, §15.3 and §15.5. The
conditions §15.4, §15.6 and §15.7 are the parametric obligations of `ReadOblSpec`. -/
def CanRead (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧
    a.InitRange (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len ∧ Auth.read ≤ ac.auth

/-- Kernel conditions of a raw typed write by `ac`: §16.1, §16.2 and §16.3. The conditions
§16.4–§16.6 are the parametric obligations of `WriteOblSpec`. -/
def CanWrite (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ Auth.write ≤ ac.auth

/-- The kernel conditions of a read are decidable (§15). -/
instance (s : State) (ac : Access) : Decidable (CanRead s ac) :=
  match h : s.allocs ac.prov with
  | some a =>
    if hc : a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ a.InitRange (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len ∧
        Auth.read ≤ ac.auth then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ => hc (by rw [h] at hb; cases hb; exact hb')
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb

/-- The kernel conditions of a write are decidable (§16). -/
instance (s : State) (ac : Access) : Decidable (CanWrite s ac) :=
  match h : s.allocs ac.prov with
  | some a =>
    if hc : a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ Auth.write ≤ ac.auth then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ => hc (by rw [h] at hb; cases hb; exact hb')
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb

/-- Partial resolution of a means of access to a place (§11 ¶2): defined when the
provenance identifies a registered allocation, live or dead, that spatially contains the
access. It proves no right to read or write. -/
def Access.toPlace (s : State) (ac : Access) : Option Place :=
  match s.allocs ac.prov with
  | some a => if Spatial a ac then some ⟨ac.prov, ac.addr - a.base, ac.len⟩ else none
  | none => none

/-- Characterization of resolution (§11 ¶2). -/
theorem toPlace_eq_some {s : State} {ac : Access} {p : Place} :
    ac.toPlace s = some p ↔
      ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ Spatial a ac ∧
        p = ⟨ac.prov, ac.addr - a.base, ac.len⟩ := by
  unfold Access.toPlace
  split
  · next a ha =>
    by_cases hs : Spatial a ac
    · simp [hs, ha, eq_comm]
    · simp [hs, ha]
  · next ha => simp [ha]

/-- The `len` bytes of `a` from offset `off`: the value of a valid read (§20.2 ¶1). -/
def Alloc.bytesAt (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : List AByte :=
  (List.range len).map fun i => a.bytes (off + i)

/-- The `len` written bytes from position `off` of the supplied representation `w`, each
initialized with its value and provenance (§16 ¶2, §16 ¶5). -/
def writtenBytes (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (off len : Nat) : List AByte :=
  (List.range len).map fun i => .init (w (off + i)).1 (w (off + i)).2

/-- Effect of a valid write on storage (§16 ¶2, §10 ¶4): the bytes at offsets
`[off, off + len)` are replaced byte by byte by `w`, initialized with the supplied value and
provenance; other bytes are unchanged (§16 ¶3). -/
def Alloc.write (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : Alloc :=
  { a with bytes := fun j =>
      if off ≤ j ∧ j < off + len then .init (w (j - off)).1 (w (j - off)).2 else a.bytes j }

/-- Effect of a valid write of `w` through `ac` on the state (§16 ¶2, §16 ¶3). -/
def State.write (s : State) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : State :=
  { s with allocs := fun i =>
      if i = ac.prov then (s.allocs i).map (fun a => a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w)
      else s.allocs i }

/-- Conditions of a successful raw deallocation of `id` with presented authority `auth`
(§17.1, §17.2): live, deallocatable, and `auth` compatible with the recorded token under the
context relation `C` (§17 ¶2, §17 ¶4). -/
def CanDealloc (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (s : State) (id auth : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, s.allocs id = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ ∃ d, a.freeAuth = some d ∧ C auth d

/-- Deallocation conditions are decidable when compatibility is (§17, §20.3 ¶3). -/
instance {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} [DecidableRel C] (s : State) (id auth : Nat) :
    Decidable (CanDealloc C s id auth) :=
  match h : s.allocs id with
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb
  | some a =>
    match hf : a.freeAuth with
    | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _, d, hd, _⟩ => by
        rw [h] at hb
        cases hb
        rw [hf] at hd
        cases hd
    | some d =>
      if hc : a.live = true ∧ C auth d then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc.1, d, hf, hc.2⟩
      else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hl, d', hd', hc'⟩ => hc (by
        rw [h] at hb
        cases hb
        rw [hf] at hd'
        cases hd'
        exact ⟨hl, hc'⟩)

/-- Effect of a valid deallocation (§17 ¶3, §20.2 ¶2): `id` becomes dead and stays
registered (§13 ¶1). -/
def State.dealloc (s : State) (id : Nat) : State :=
  { s with allocs := fun i =>
      if i = id then (s.allocs i).map (fun a => { a with live := false }) else s.allocs i }

/-- Effect of a valid raw creation (§9 ¶11, §13 ¶1, §20.2 ¶2): a live allocation under the
identity `s.next`, wholly uninitialized (§10 ¶5); the counter advances (§9 ¶7). -/
def State.alloc (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) : State :=
  { allocs := fun i =>
      if i = s.next then
        some { space, base, size, align, live := true, bytes := fun _ => .uninit, freeAuth }
      else s.allocs i
    next := s.next + 1 }

/-- Half-open ranges `[b1, b1 + n1)` and `[b2, b2 + n2)` have an empty intersection (§9 ¶3). -/
def RangeDisjoint (b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, b1 ≤ x → x < b1 + n1 → b2 ≤ x → x < b2 + n2 → False

/-- Arithmetic form of range disjointness (§9 ¶3). -/
theorem rangeDisjoint_iff {b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat} :
    RangeDisjoint b1 n1 b2 n2 ↔ b1 + n1 ≤ b2 ∨ b2 + n2 ≤ b1 ∨ n1 = 0 ∨ n2 = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases Nat.le_total b1 b2 with h12 | h12
    · by_cases hlt : b2 < b1 + n1
      · by_cases hn : 0 < n2
        · exact (h b2 h12 hlt (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega)).elim
        · omega
      · omega
    · by_cases hlt : b1 < b2 + n2
      · by_cases hn : 0 < n1
        · exact (h b1 (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega) h12 hlt).elim
        · omega
      · omega
  · intro h x h1 h2 h3 h4
    omega

/-- Range disjointness is decidable (§9 ¶3). -/
instance (b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat) : Decidable (RangeDisjoint b1 n1 b2 n2) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ rangeDisjoint_iff.symm

/-- Disjointness of live allocations in the same address space (§9 ¶3, §9 ¶8 b2). -/
def LiveDisjoint (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j a b, i ≠ j → s.allocs i = some a → s.allocs j = some b →
    a.live = true → b.live = true → a.space = b.space →
    RangeDisjoint a.base a.size b.base b.size

/-- `n` is a power of two (§9 ¶1 b5, §9 ¶4). -/
def Pow2 (n : Nat) : Prop := ∃ k, n = 2 ^ k

/-- Bounded form of `Pow2` (§9 ¶4). -/
theorem pow2_iff (n : Nat) : Pow2 n ↔ ∃ k, k < n + 1 ∧ n = 2 ^ k :=
  ⟨fun ⟨k, hk⟩ => ⟨k, by have := @Nat.lt_two_pow_self k; omega, hk⟩, fun ⟨k, _, hk⟩ => ⟨k, hk⟩⟩

/-- `Pow2` is decidable (§9 ¶4). -/
instance (n : Nat) : Decidable (Pow2 n) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ (pow2_iff n).symm

/-- Operation preconditions of raw creation in space `space` (§9 ¶11): fresh identity
`s.next`, strictly positive power-of-two alignment, aligned base, no overlap with any live
allocation of the same space. -/
def AllocPre (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.allocs s.next = none ∧ 0 < align ∧ Pow2 align ∧ base % align = 0 ∧
    ∀ i a, s.allocs i = some a → a.live = true → a.space = space →
      RangeDisjoint a.base a.size base size

/-- The entry `o` does not overlap `[base, base + size)` in space `space`: absent, dead, of
another space, or disjoint (§9 ¶11). -/
def NoOverlap (space base size : Nat) : Option Alloc → Prop
  | some a => a.live = true → a.space = space → RangeDisjoint a.base a.size base size
  | none => True

/-- `NoOverlap` is decidable (§9 ¶11). -/
instance (space base size : Nat) : (o : Option Alloc) → Decidable (NoOverlap space base size o)
  | some a => inferInstanceAs
      (Decidable (a.live = true → a.space = space → RangeDisjoint a.base a.size base size))
  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)

/-- Decidable form of `AllocPre`, checking overlap on identities below the counter only
(§9 ¶11, §20.3 ¶3). -/
def AllocPreDec (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.allocs s.next = none ∧ 0 < align ∧ Pow2 align ∧ base % align = 0 ∧
    ∀ i, i < s.next → NoOverlap space base size (s.allocs i)

/-- `AllocPreDec` is decidable (§20.3 ¶3). -/
instance (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) :
    Decidable (AllocPreDec s space base size align) := by
  unfold AllocPreDec
  infer_instance

/-- Under freshness, `AllocPreDec` is `AllocPre` (§9 ¶7, §9 ¶11). -/
theorem allocPreDec_iff {s : State} (hwf : WF s) {space base size align : Nat} :
    AllocPreDec s space base size align ↔ AllocPre s space base size align := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, hd⟩
    refine ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, fun i a ha hl hsp => ?_⟩
    have hi : i < s.next := Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => by rw [hwf i hle] at ha; cases ha
    have := hd i hi
    rw [ha] at this
    exact this hl hsp
  · rintro ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, hd⟩
    refine ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, fun i _ => ?_⟩
    cases ha : s.allocs i with
    | none => trivial
    | some a => exact fun hl hsp => hd i a ha hl hsp

/-- Alignment of every registered allocation, live or dead (§9 ¶4, §9 ¶8 b3). -/
def Aligned (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, s.allocs i = some a → 0 < a.align ∧ Pow2 a.align ∧ a.base % a.align = 0

/-- Admissible state (§9 ¶8): freshness, live disjointness, alignment. -/
structure Admissible (s : State) : Prop where
  wf : WF s
  disjoint : LiveDisjoint s
  aligned : Aligned s

/-- The empty state: no allocation, counter `0` (§9 ¶9). -/
def State.empty : State := ⟨fun _ => none, 0⟩

/-- The empty state is an admissible initial state (§9 ¶9). -/
theorem admissible_empty : Admissible State.empty :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => nomatch h), (fun _ _ h => nomatch h)⟩

/-! ## Restrictive derivation (§14) -/

/-- `ac'` is a restrictive derivation of `ac` (§14 ¶1): same provenance, address subrange,
authority at most that of the source. -/
def Derive (ac ac' : Access) : Prop :=
  ac.addr ≤ ac'.addr ∧ ac'.addr + ac'.len ≤ ac.addr + ac.len ∧
    ac'.prov = ac.prov ∧ ac'.auth ≤ ac.auth

/-- A restrictive derivation preserves provenance (§14 ¶1 b1). -/
theorem derive_prov {ac ac' : Access} (hd : Derive ac ac') : ac'.prov = ac.prov :=
  hd.2.2.1

/-- A restrictive derivation of an access contained in an allocation is contained in it
(§14 ¶1 b2, §15 ¶1). -/
theorem derive_spatial {ac ac' : Access} (hd : Derive ac ac') {a : Alloc}
    (hs : Spatial a ac) : Spatial a ac' := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩ := hd
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨Nat.le_trans h3 h1, Nat.le_trans h2 h4⟩

/-- A restrictive derivation confers no greater authority (§14 ¶1 b3). -/
theorem derive_auth_le {ac ac' : Access} (hd : Derive ac ac') : ac'.auth ≤ ac.auth :=
  hd.2.2.2

/-! ## Parametric obligations and outcomes (§15 ¶5, §16 ¶4, §20) -/

/-- Read obligations not defined by the kernel, §15.4, §15.6, §15.7 (§15 ¶5): explicit
predicates of the execution context (§20.3 ¶1), depending on the state, the access and the
read type; `dec` is the part with a decision procedure, `stat` the part established
statically or by contract (§20.3 ¶2). -/
structure ReadOblSpec (Ty : Type) where
  dec : State → Access → Ty → Prop
  stat : State → Access → Ty → Prop

/-- Read obligations with a decision instance for `dec`, as required by a computable
interpreter (§20.3 ¶3). -/
structure ReadObl (Ty : Type) extends toSpec : ReadOblSpec Ty where
  decInst : ∀ s ac t, Decidable (dec s ac t)

attribute [instance] ReadObl.decInst

/-- Write obligations not defined by the kernel, §16.4, §16.5, §16.6 (§16 ¶4): explicit
predicates of the execution context (§20.3 ¶1), depending on the state, the access, the
written type and the supplied representation; split into `dec` and `stat` (§20.3 ¶2). -/
structure WriteOblSpec (Ty : Type) where
  dec : State → Access → Ty → (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Prop
  stat : State → Access → Ty → (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Prop

/-- Write obligations with a decision instance for `dec`, as required by a computable
interpreter (§20.3 ¶3). -/
structure WriteObl (Ty : Type) extends toSpec : WriteOblSpec Ty where
  decInst : ∀ s ac t w, Decidable (dec s ac t w)

attribute [instance] WriteObl.decInst

/-- Outcome of a raw state-transforming operation: `ok` with the new state, or `ub`, which
supplies no state (§20.1 ¶2, §1). -/
inductive Outcome where
  | ok (s : State)
  | ub

/-- Outcome of a raw read: `ok` with the bytes read, or `ub` (§20.1 ¶2, §20.2 ¶1). -/
inductive ReadOutcome where
  | ok (v : List AByte)
  | ub
  deriving DecidableEq

section Relations

variable {Ty : Type}

/-- Raw typed read of type `t` through `ac` (§15, §20.1, §20.2 ¶1): `ok` with the bytes of
the accessed range when the kernel conditions (`CanRead`) and both parts of the obligations
hold; `ub` otherwise, a violated static part included (§20.1 ¶2 b2). The state is
unchanged. -/
inductive ReadStep (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (s : State) :
    ReadOutcome → Prop where
  | ok {a : Alloc} : s.allocs ac.prov = some a → CanRead s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac t ∧ ObR.stat s ac t →
      ReadStep ObR ac t s (.ok (a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len))
  | ub : ¬ (CanRead s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac t ∧ ObR.stat s ac t) → ReadStep ObR ac t s .ub

/-- Raw typed write of `w` at type `t` through `ac` (§16, §20.1, §20.2 ¶2): `ok` with the
effect `State.write` when the kernel conditions (`CanWrite`) and both parts of the
obligations hold; `ub` otherwise (§20.1 ¶2 b2). -/
inductive WriteStep (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty)
    (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State) : Outcome → Prop where
  | ok : CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac t w ∧ ObW.stat s ac t w →
      WriteStep ObW ac t w s (.ok (s.write ac w))
  | ub : ¬ (CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac t w ∧ ObW.stat s ac t w) → WriteStep ObW ac t w s .ub

end Relations

/-- Raw deallocation of `id` with presented authority `auth` (§17, §20.1, §20.2 ¶2): `ok`
with the effect `State.dealloc` when `CanDealloc`; `ub` otherwise. `C` needs no decision
instance (§20.3 ¶3). -/
inductive DeallocStep (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (id auth : Nat) (s : State) : Outcome → Prop where
  | ok : CanDealloc C s id auth → DeallocStep C id auth s (.ok (s.dealloc id))
  | ub : ¬ CanDealloc C s id auth → DeallocStep C id auth s .ub

/-- Raw creation (§9 ¶11, §20.1, §20.2 ¶2): `ok` with the effect `State.alloc` when
`AllocPre`; `ub` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State) :
    Outcome → Prop where
  | ok : AllocPre s space base size align →
      AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s (.ok (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth))
  | ub : ¬ AllocPre s space base size align → AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s .ub

/-! ## Interpreters (§20.3 ¶3; `formal/DESIGN.md`, "Representation") -/

section Interpreters

variable {Ty : Type}

/-- Interpreter of `ReadStep`: decides the kernel conditions and `dec`, takes the static
part `stat` as a proof argument (§20.3 ¶3), and returns the bytes read (§20.2 ¶1). -/
def read (ObR : ReadObl Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (s : State) (_hs : ObR.stat s ac t) :
    ReadOutcome :=
  match s.allocs ac.prov with
  | some a =>
    if CanRead s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac t then .ok (a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len) else .ub
  | none => .ub

/-- Interpreter of `WriteStep`: decides the kernel conditions and `dec`, takes `stat` as a
proof argument (§20.3 ¶3). -/
def write (ObW : WriteObl Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State)
    (_hs : ObW.stat s ac t w) : Outcome :=
  if CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac t w then .ok (s.write ac w) else .ub

end Interpreters

/-- Interpreter of `DeallocStep`, given a decision instance for compatibility (§20.3 ¶3). -/
def dealloc (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (id auth : Nat) (s : State) : Outcome :=
  if CanDealloc C s id auth then .ok (s.dealloc id) else .ub

/-- Interpreter of `AllocStep`, taking freshness `WF s` as a proof argument; it decides
`AllocPreDec`, which is `AllocPre` under `WF` (§9 ¶11, §20.3 ¶3). -/
def alloc (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State) (_hwf : WF s) :
    Outcome :=
  if AllocPreDec s space base size align then .ok (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth)
  else .ub

/-! ## Executions (§9 ¶9, §20.1 ¶2, §20.3 ¶3) -/

/-- Raw operations of the machine (§15, §16, §17, §9 ¶11, §20.1). -/
inductive Op (Ty : Type) where
  | read (ac : Access) (t : Ty)
  | write (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
  | dealloc (id auth : Nat)
  | alloc (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat)

section Executions

variable {Ty : Type}

/-- `ok` transitions of the raw operations, with compatibility and obligations fixed by the
execution context (§20.1 ¶2, §20.3 ¶3). A read leaves the state unchanged (§20.2 ¶1). -/
inductive Step (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty) :
    Op Ty → State → State → Prop where
  | read {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State} {v : List AByte} :
      ReadStep ObR ac t s (.ok v) → Step C ObR ObW (.read ac t) s s
  | write {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s s' : State} :
      WriteStep ObW ac t w s (.ok s') → Step C ObR ObW (.write ac t w) s s'
  | dealloc {id auth : Nat} {s s' : State} :
      DeallocStep C id auth s (.ok s') → Step C ObR ObW (.dealloc id auth) s s'
  | alloc {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s s' : State} :
      AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s (.ok s') →
      Step C ObR ObW (.alloc space base size align freeAuth) s s'

/-- Execution: a sequence of `ok` steps under one context (§20.3 ¶3). A `ub` step supplies
no state, so it never occurs inside an execution (§20.1 ¶2 b3). -/
inductive Exec (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty) :
    List (Op Ty) → State → State → Prop where
  | nil (s : State) : Exec C ObR ObW [] s s
  | cons {op : Op Ty} {ops : List (Op Ty)} {s s' s'' : State} :
      Step C ObR ObW op s s' → Exec C ObR ObW ops s' s'' → Exec C ObR ObW (op :: ops) s s''

/-- `s` is reachable from the initial state `s₀`, which need not be empty (§9 ¶9). -/
def Reachable (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty)
    (s₀ s : State) : Prop :=
  ∃ ops, Exec C ObR ObW ops s₀ s

/-- The operation neither writes through provenance `i` nor deallocates `i`. Used to state
the "absence of an intervening write or invalidation" of §16 ¶5 for allocation `i`; writes
through other provenances are allowed (non-interference, §16 ¶5). -/
def Op.KeepsAlloc (i : Nat) : Op Ty → Prop
  | .read _ _ => True
  | .write ac _ _ => ac.prov ≠ i
  | .dealloc id _ => id ≠ i
  | .alloc .. => True

end Executions

/-! ## Outcome characterizations, determinism, totality (§20.1) -/

section Theorems

variable {Ty : Type}

/-- `ok` outcome of a raw read (§15, §20.1 ¶2 b1, §20.2 ¶1). -/
theorem ReadStep_ok_iff {ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State}
    {v : List AByte} :
    ReadStep ObR ac t s (.ok v) ↔ (CanRead s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac t ∧ ObR.stat s ac t) ∧
      ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ v = a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h with | ok ha h => exact ⟨h, _, ha, rfl⟩,
   fun ⟨h, _, ha, e⟩ => by subst e; exact .ok ha h⟩

/-- `ok` outcome of a raw write (§16, §20.1 ¶2 b1). -/
theorem WriteStep_ok_iff {ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty}
    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s s' : State} :
    WriteStep ObW ac t w s (.ok s') ↔
      (CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac t w ∧ ObW.stat s ac t w) ∧ s' = s.write ac w :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h with | ok h => exact ⟨h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => by subst e; exact .ok h⟩

/-- `ok` outcome of a raw deallocation (§17, §20.1 ¶2 b1). -/
theorem DeallocStep_ok_iff {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {id auth : Nat} {s s' : State} :
    DeallocStep C id auth s (.ok s') ↔ CanDealloc C s id auth ∧ s' = s.dealloc id :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h with | ok h => exact ⟨h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => by subst e; exact .ok h⟩

/-- `ok` outcome of a raw creation (§9 ¶11, §20.1 ¶2 b1). -/
theorem AllocStep_ok_iff {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s s' : State} :
    AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s (.ok s') ↔
      AllocPre s space base size align ∧ s' = s.alloc space base size align freeAuth :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h with | ok h => exact ⟨h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => by subst e; exact .ok h⟩

/-- A raw read has at most one outcome (§20.1 ¶3). -/
theorem ReadStep_det {ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State}
    {o₁ o₂ : ReadOutcome} (h₁ : ReadStep ObR ac t s o₁) (h₂ : ReadStep ObR ac t s o₂) :
    o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ with
  | ok ha _ =>
    cases h₂ with
    | ok hb _ => rw [ha] at hb; cases hb; rfl
    | ub => contradiction
  | ub => cases h₂ with
    | ok => contradiction
    | ub => rfl

/-- A raw write has at most one outcome (§20.1 ¶3). -/
theorem WriteStep_det {ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty}
    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s : State} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome}
    (h₁ : WriteStep ObW ac t w s o₁) (h₂ : WriteStep ObW ac t w s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- A raw deallocation has at most one outcome (§20.1 ¶3). -/
theorem DeallocStep_det {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {id auth : Nat} {s : State}
    {o₁ o₂ : Outcome} (h₁ : DeallocStep C id auth s o₁) (h₂ : DeallocStep C id auth s o₂) :
    o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- A raw creation has at most one outcome (§20.1 ¶3). -/
theorem AllocStep_det {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s : State}
    {o₁ o₂ : Outcome} (h₁ : AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o₁)
    (h₂ : AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- Totality of the raw read on every state (§20.1 ¶3), in the constructive form
`¬¬∃`, classically equivalent to `∃`; `stat` has no decision procedure. -/
theorem ReadStep_total (ObR : ReadOblSpec Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (s : State) :
    ¬¬ ∃ o, ReadStep ObR ac t s o :=
  fun hn => hn ⟨.ub, .ub fun h => let ⟨_, ha, _⟩ := h.1; hn ⟨_, .ok ha h⟩⟩

/-- Totality of the raw write on every state (§20.1 ¶3), constructive form `¬¬∃`. -/
theorem WriteStep_total (ObW : WriteOblSpec Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty)
    (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State) : ¬¬ ∃ o, WriteStep ObW ac t w s o :=
  fun hn => hn ⟨.ub, .ub fun h => hn ⟨_, .ok h⟩⟩

/-- Totality of the raw deallocation on every state (§20.1 ¶3), constructive form `¬¬∃`;
`C` has no decision procedure. -/
theorem DeallocStep_total (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (id auth : Nat) (s : State) :
    ¬¬ ∃ o, DeallocStep C id auth s o :=
  fun hn => hn ⟨.ub, .ub fun h => hn ⟨_, .ok h⟩⟩

/-- Totality of the raw creation on every state (§20.1 ¶3), constructive form `¬¬∃`;
`AllocPre` quantifies over every identity. -/
theorem AllocStep_total (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State) :
    ¬¬ ∃ o, AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o :=
  fun hn => hn ⟨.ub, .ub fun h => hn ⟨_, .ok h⟩⟩

/-! ## Agreement of the interpreters with the relations (§20.3 ¶3) -/

/-- Soundness of `read`: its result is an outcome of `ReadStep` (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem read_sound {ObR : ReadObl Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State}
    {hs : ObR.stat s ac t} {o : ReadOutcome} (h : read ObR ac t s hs = o) :
    ReadStep ObR.toSpec ac t s o := by
  subst h
  unfold read
  split
  · next a ha =>
    split
    · next hc => exact .ok ha ⟨hc.1, hc.2, hs⟩
    · next hc => exact .ub fun ⟨h1, h2, _⟩ => hc ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · next ha => exact .ub fun ⟨⟨b, hb, _⟩, _⟩ => by rw [ha] at hb; cases hb

/-- Completeness of `read`: every outcome of `ReadStep` is the result of `read`, for every
proof of the static part (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem read_complete {ObR : ReadObl Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {s : State}
    {o : ReadOutcome} (h : ReadStep ObR.toSpec ac t s o) (hs : ObR.stat s ac t) :
    read ObR ac t s hs = o := by
  unfold read
  cases h with
  | ok ha hc =>
    split
    · next b hb =>
      rw [ha] at hb
      cases hb
      exact ite_eq_left ⟨hc.1, hc.2.1⟩
    · next hb => rw [ha] at hb; cases hb
  | ub hc =>
    split
    · exact ite_eq_right fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => hc ⟨h1, h2, hs⟩
    · rfl

/-- Soundness of `write` (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem write_sound {ObW : WriteObl Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty} {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat}
    {s : State} {hs : ObW.stat s ac t w} {o : Outcome} (h : write ObW ac t w s hs = o) :
    WriteStep ObW.toSpec ac t w s o := by
  subst h
  unfold write
  split
  · next hc => exact .ok ⟨hc.1, hc.2, hs⟩
  · next hc => exact .ub fun ⟨h1, h2, _⟩ => hc ⟨h1, h2⟩

/-- Completeness of `write`, for every proof of the static part (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem write_complete {ObW : WriteObl Ty} {ac : Access} {t : Ty}
    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s : State} {o : Outcome}
    (h : WriteStep ObW.toSpec ac t w s o) (hs : ObW.stat s ac t w) :
    write ObW ac t w s hs = o := by
  unfold write
  cases h with
  | ok h => exact ite_eq_left ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
  | ub h => exact ite_eq_right fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => h ⟨h1, h2, hs⟩

end Theorems

/-- Soundness of `dealloc` (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem dealloc_sound {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} [DecidableRel C] {id auth : Nat} {s : State}
    {o : Outcome} (h : dealloc C id auth s = o) : DeallocStep C id auth s o := by
  subst h
  unfold dealloc
  split
  · next hc => exact .ok hc
  · next hc => exact .ub hc

/-- Completeness of `dealloc` (§20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem dealloc_complete {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} [DecidableRel C] {id auth : Nat} {s : State}
    {o : Outcome} (h : DeallocStep C id auth s o) : dealloc C id auth s = o := by
  unfold dealloc
  cases h with
  | ok h => exact ite_eq_left h
  | ub h => exact ite_eq_right h

/-- Soundness of `alloc` on states satisfying `WF` (§9 ¶11, §20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem alloc_sound {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s : State}
    {hwf : WF s} {o : Outcome} (h : alloc space base size align freeAuth s hwf = o) :
    AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o := by
  subst h
  unfold alloc
  split
  · next hc => exact .ok ((allocPreDec_iff hwf).1 hc)
  · next hc => exact .ub (mt (allocPreDec_iff hwf).2 hc)

/-- Completeness of `alloc`, for every proof of `WF` (§9 ¶11, §20.1, §20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem alloc_complete {space base size align : Nat} {freeAuth : Option Nat} {s : State}
    {o : Outcome} (h : AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o) (hwf : WF s) :
    alloc space base size align freeAuth s hwf = o := by
  unfold alloc
  cases h with
  | ok h => exact ite_eq_left ((allocPreDec_iff hwf).2 h)
  | ub h => exact ite_eq_right (mt (allocPreDec_iff hwf).1 h)

section Domain

variable {Ty : Type}

/-- On the interpreter's domain the raw read has an outcome, computed by `read` (§20.1 ¶3). -/
theorem ReadStep_total_on (ObR : ReadObl Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty) (s : State)
    (hs : ObR.stat s ac t) : ∃ o, ReadStep ObR.toSpec ac t s o :=
  ⟨_, read_sound (hs := hs) rfl⟩

/-- On the interpreter's domain the raw write has an outcome, computed by `write`
(§20.1 ¶3). -/
theorem WriteStep_total_on (ObW : WriteObl Ty) (ac : Access) (t : Ty)
    (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State) (hs : ObW.stat s ac t w) :
    ∃ o, WriteStep ObW.toSpec ac t w s o :=
  ⟨_, write_sound (hs := hs) rfl⟩

end Domain

/-- With decidable compatibility the raw deallocation has an outcome, computed by
`dealloc` (§20.1 ¶3). -/
theorem DeallocStep_total_on (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (id auth : Nat)
    (s : State) : ∃ o, DeallocStep C id auth s o :=
  ⟨_, dealloc_sound rfl⟩

/-- On states satisfying `WF` the raw creation has an outcome, computed by `alloc`
(§20.1 ¶3). -/
theorem AllocStep_total_on (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State)
    (hwf : WF s) : ∃ o, AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s o :=
  ⟨_, alloc_sound (hwf := hwf) rfl⟩

/-! ## Effects: frame and invariants (§9, §13, §16 ¶2–¶3, §17 ¶3, §20.2 ¶2) -/

/-- Entry of the written allocation after the write effect (§16 ¶2). -/
theorem State.write_allocs_self (s : State) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
    (s.write ac w).allocs ac.prov =
      (s.allocs ac.prov).map (fun a => a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w) := by
  dsimp only [State.write]
  exact ite_eq_left rfl

/-- Entry of the deallocated allocation after the deallocation effect (§17 ¶3). -/
theorem State.dealloc_allocs_self (s : State) (id : Nat) :
    (s.dealloc id).allocs id = (s.allocs id).map (fun a => { a with live := false }) := by
  dsimp only [State.dealloc]
  exact ite_eq_left rfl

/-- Entry of the new allocation after the creation effect (§9 ¶11, §10 ¶5). -/
theorem State.alloc_allocs_self (s : State) (space base size align : Nat)
    (freeAuth : Option Nat) :
    (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth).allocs s.next =
      some { space, base, size, align, live := true, bytes := fun _ => .uninit, freeAuth } := by
  dsimp only [State.alloc]
  exact ite_eq_left rfl

/-- Inside the written range, offset `off + i` holds the `i`-th written byte with its value
and provenance (§16 ¶2). -/
theorem Alloc.write_bytes_in (a : Alloc) {off len : Nat} (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    {i : Nat} (hi : i < len) : (a.write off len w).bytes (off + i) = .init (w i).1 (w i).2 := by
  simp only [Alloc.write]
  rw [ite_eq_left ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ _, Nat.add_lt_add_left hi _⟩, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

/-- Outside the written range, bytes are unchanged (§16 ¶3). -/
theorem Alloc.write_bytes_out (a : Alloc) {off len : Nat} (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    {j : Nat} (hj : ¬ (off ≤ j ∧ j < off + len)) : (a.write off len w).bytes j = a.bytes j := by
  simp only [Alloc.write]
  exact ite_eq_right hj

/-- Freshness is preserved by the write effect (§9 ¶7, §13 ¶3). -/
theorem write_wf {s : State} (hwf : WF s) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
    WF (s.write ac w) := by
  intro i hi
  simp only [State.write, hwf i hi]
  split <;> rfl

/-- Freshness is preserved by the deallocation effect (§9 ¶7, §13 ¶3). -/
theorem dealloc_wf {s : State} (hwf : WF s) (id : Nat) : WF (s.dealloc id) := by
  intro i hi
  simp only [State.dealloc, hwf i hi]
  split <;> rfl

/-- Freshness is preserved by the creation effect (§9 ¶7, §13 ¶1). -/
theorem alloc_wf {s : State} (hwf : WF s) (space base size align : Nat)
    (freeAuth : Option Nat) : WF (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth) := by
  intro i hi
  have hi' : s.next + 1 ≤ i := hi
  have hne : i ≠ s.next := fun e => by rw [e] at hi'; exact Nat.not_succ_le_self _ hi'
  simp only [State.alloc]
  rw [ite_eq_right hne]
  exact hwf i (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi')

/-- A step that makes no allocation live and keeps space, base and extent of every
allocation that stays live preserves live disjointness (§9 ¶3). -/
theorem LiveDisjoint.of_fields {s s' : State} (hd : LiveDisjoint s)
    (h : ∀ i a, s'.allocs i = some a → a.live = true →
      ∃ a₀, s.allocs i = some a₀ ∧ a₀.live = true ∧ a₀.space = a.space ∧
        a₀.base = a.base ∧ a₀.size = a.size) :
    LiveDisjoint s' := by
  intro i j a b hij ha hb hla hlb hsp
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hla₀, hs₁, hb₁, hz₁⟩ := h i a ha hla
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀, hlb₀, hs₂, hb₂, hz₂⟩ := h j b hb hlb
  have := hd i j a₀ b₀ hij ha₀ hb₀ hla₀ hlb₀ (by rw [hs₁, hs₂, hsp])
  rw [hb₁, hz₁, hb₂, hz₂] at this
  exact this

/-- Live disjointness is preserved by the write effect (§9 ¶3). -/
theorem liveDisjoint_write {s : State} (hd : LiveDisjoint s) (ac : Access)
    (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : LiveDisjoint (s.write ac w) :=
  hd.of_fields fun i a ha hla => by
    simp only [State.write] at ha
    split at ha
    · obtain ⟨a₀, h₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ha
      exact ⟨a₀, h₀, hla, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨a, ha, hla, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Live disjointness is preserved by the deallocation effect (§9 ¶3). -/
theorem liveDisjoint_dealloc {s : State} (hd : LiveDisjoint s) (id : Nat) :
    LiveDisjoint (s.dealloc id) :=
  hd.of_fields fun i a ha hla => by
    simp only [State.dealloc] at ha
    split at ha
    · obtain ⟨a₀, -, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ha
      exact nomatch hla
    · exact ⟨a, ha, hla, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Live disjointness is preserved by a creation satisfying its preconditions (§9 ¶3,
§9 ¶11). -/
theorem liveDisjoint_alloc {s : State} (hd : LiveDisjoint s) {space base size align : Nat}
    (hp : AllocPre s space base size align) (freeAuth : Option Nat) :
    LiveDisjoint (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth) := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hdis⟩ := hp
  intro i j a b hij ha hb hla hlb hsp
  simp only [State.alloc] at ha hb
  by_cases hi : i = s.next <;> by_cases hj : j = s.next
  · exact absurd (hi.trans hj.symm) hij
  · rw [ite_eq_left hi] at ha
    rw [ite_eq_right hj] at hb
    cases ha
    exact fun x h1 h2 h3 h4 => hdis j b hb hlb hsp.symm x h3 h4 h1 h2
  · rw [ite_eq_right hi] at ha
    rw [ite_eq_left hj] at hb
    cases hb
    exact hdis i a ha hla hsp
  · rw [ite_eq_right hi] at ha
    rw [ite_eq_right hj] at hb
    exact hd i j a b hij ha hb hla hlb hsp

/-- Alignment is preserved by the write effect (§9 ¶4). -/
theorem aligned_write {s : State} (h : Aligned s) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
    Aligned (s.write ac w) := by
  intro i a ha
  simp only [State.write] at ha
  split at ha
  · obtain ⟨a₀, h₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ha
    exact h i a₀ h₀
  · exact h i a ha

/-- Alignment is preserved by the deallocation effect (§9 ¶4). -/
theorem aligned_dealloc {s : State} (h : Aligned s) (id : Nat) : Aligned (s.dealloc id) := by
  intro i a ha
  simp only [State.dealloc] at ha
  split at ha
  · obtain ⟨a₀, h₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ha
    exact h i a₀ h₀
  · exact h i a ha

/-- Alignment is preserved by a creation satisfying its preconditions (§9 ¶4, §9 ¶11). -/
theorem aligned_alloc {s : State} (h : Aligned s) {space base size align : Nat}

1258	    · rintro ⟨b, hb, hl', hs', hi', hau⟩

1266	        show (a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w).bytes (ac'.addr - a.base + i) ≠ .uninit

1269	    · obtain ⟨⟨⟨b, hb, -, hs', -⟩, -⟩, b₁, hb₁, rfl⟩ := ReadStep_ok_iff.1 h

1277	  · have he : (s.write ac w).allocs ac'.prov = s.allocs ac'.prov := by
1278	      simp only [State.write]
1279	      exact ite_eq_right hp
1280	    refine ⟨by unfold CanRead; rw [he], fun R t' v v' h h' => ?_⟩
1281	    obtain ⟨-, b₁, hb₁, rfl⟩ := ReadStep_ok_iff.1 h

1288

1296	  { dec := fun _ _ _ => True, stat := fun _ _ _ => True, decInst := fun _ _ _ => instDecidableTrue }
