(hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
    (had : ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length = ad)
    (hsz : (π.L dst).len = π.pe.size)
    (henc : PtrEncAt π.pe ad
      (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length))) :
    π.pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst) = ad ∧
    (∀ n, n < (π.L dst).len → (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst n).2 =
      some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)) ∧
    ∀ l ∈ region,
      (π.L l).alloc = anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length ∧
      AllocP s2 (π.L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (π.L l).off + (π.L l).len ≤ al.size := by
  rw [issue_ops hE]
  cases hs with
  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' _ _ hsp hst =>
  rw [hE] at hE'
  cases hE'
  have e₁ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2
  subst e₁
  have h := pointer_sound_store (Ty := Ty) (ty := π.ty) (r6_split hR hsp)
    (split_preserves_wf3 hw hsp) (split_preserves_noDangling hnd hsp) hst had hsz henc
  have hafp : (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]).afp L.kern.A.length = region := by
    simp [S3.afp, split_block]
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, fun l hl => h.2.2.1 l (by rw [hafp]; exact hl)⟩

/-- `issue_pointer_sound` on library-reachable states (§82.7, §82.3, §77, §57): without invariant
hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
theorem issue_pointer_sound_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty}
    {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {s2 : Machine.State} {ad : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hL : LReach k statics L) (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E)
    (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
    (had : ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length = ad)
    (hsz : (π.L dst).len = π.pe.size)
    (henc : PtrEncAt π.pe ad
      (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length))) :
    π.pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst) = ad ∧
    (∀ n, n < (π.L dst).len → (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst n).2 =
      some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)) ∧
    ∀ l ∈ region,
      (π.L l).alloc = anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length ∧
      AllocP s2 (π.L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (π.L l).off + (π.L l).len ≤ al.size :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hL.ng.reachable
  issue_pointer_sound hE hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hs had hsz henc

/-- The raw operations of the derived `reset` (§78, Part XIV): `derive` and `release` realize
none (§60, §62: no storage is created or deallocated). -/
theorem reset_ops {Ty : Type} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState} {i : Nat} {s2 : Machine.State} :
    lopsOf π (.reset i) L s2 = [] := by
  simp only [lopsOf, kexp]
  split <;> rfl

/-- R1, R2, R4, R6 for the derived `reset` (§78, Part XIV, §82.5, §82.7): no raw operation (no
read, no write; the storage stays allocated, §17 "logical invalidation"); `Repr` and `LiveCover`
hold after it as before it. -/
theorem arena_reset {Ty : Type} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hs : ResetD i L (.ok L')) :
    lopsOf π (.reset i) L s2 = [] ∧
    (Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2 → Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern s2) ∧
    (LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 → LiveCover π.L L'.kern s2) := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hd hrl _ =>
  refine ⟨reset_ops, fun hR => r6_release (r6_derive hR hd) hrl, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
  unfold LiveCover
  intro hlc j y hy ya l hl
  dsimp only at hy ⊢
  rw [← resetKEff_eq] at hy ⊢
  have hA : (resetKEff L.kern E).A = L.kern.A ++
      [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint L.kern.P E.storage, .frame L.kern.top, false⟩] := rfl
  rw [hA] at hy
  show l < L.kern.P.length ∧ isLeaf L.kern.P l ∧ _
  by_cases hj : j < L.kern.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at hy
    exact hlc j y hy ya l hl
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy
    cases h0 : j - L.kern.A.length with
    | zero => rw [h0] at hy; simp at hy; rw [← hy] at ya; cases ya
    | succ n => rw [h0] at hy; simp at hy

/-- `derive` at `Modify` of `src` on one region gives the preconditions of `split` of `src` on
that region (§60, §61): the forward direction of `Arena.derive_iff_split`, which needs no
invariant. -/
private theorem splitPre_of_derivePre (k : K) {s : S3} {src : Nat} {R : List Nat}
    (hd : DerivePre s src R .modify) : SplitPre k s src [R] := by
  have hm : ∀ p ∈ R, effective s src p = some .modify :=
    fun p hp => allows_modify_iff.1 (hd.modeOK p hp)
  refine ⟨hd.active, hd.exercisable, ?_, ?_, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, ?_⟩
  · intro r hr p hp; rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp; exact hm p hp
  · intro r hr p hp; rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp
    exact ⟨hd.within p hp, by rw [hm p hp]; simp⟩
  · intro r hr p hp j _ hdx
    rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp
    unfold DistribExcl at hdx
    cases hj : s.A[j]? with
    | none => rw [hj] at hdx; exact hdx
    | some y =>
      rw [hj] at hdx; obtain ⟨ya, hanc, hpy, hmy⟩ := hdx
      exact effective_ne_modify_of_desc hj ya hpy hanc hmy (hm p hp)

/-- `reset` through `split` (Part XIV: "through `derive` or `split`"; §60, §61, §62): the
derivation of an `ok` reset may be performed by `split` of `internal` on the storage, whose
preconditions follow from those of the accepted `derive` (`splitPre_of_derivePre`): `split` then
`release` reach the same kernel state, and realize no raw operation either. No invariant
hypothesis. -/
theorem reset_split {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
    {E : ArenaEntry} {s2 : Machine.State} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E)
    (hs : ResetD i L (.ok L')) :
    KPath k L.kern [(.split E.internal [footprint L.kern.P E.storage], L.kern),
      (.release L.kern.A.length, splitEff L.kern E.internal [footprint L.kern.P E.storage])]
      L'.kern ∧
    ktrace π [(.split E.internal [footprint L.kern.P E.storage], L.kern),
      (.release L.kern.A.length, splitEff L.kern E.internal [footprint L.kern.P E.storage])]
      s2 = [] := by
  refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
  cases hs with
  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' hd hrl _ =>
  rw [hE] at hE'
  cases hE'
  obtain ⟨hdp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
  exact .cons (.ok (splitPre_of_derivePre k hdp)) (.cons hrl (.nil _))

/-! ## Library runs in the memory machine (§82 preamble, §82.7) -/

/-- Library runs from `LState.init statics` translated into the memory machine, with the contract
`K`, the deallocation compatibility `C`, the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` and the parameters `π` fixed
once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82, §82.7): the initial state with the creations and writes of the
statics (as `SimRun.init`); then each `ok` library step, kernel steps and arena operations
interleaved, under the obligations of its kernel steps, followed by the raw operations of its
kernel steps. No invariant is assumed on the states of the run: they are library-reachable
(`LSimRun.lreach`), so the kernel invariant holds on them (§57, `Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
inductive LSimRun {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (statics : Statics) (π : Params Ty) :
    LState → Machine.State → Prop where
  | init : StaticsOK statics →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →
      LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (LState.init statics) (minit π statics)
  | step {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} {s2 : Machine.State} : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2 →
      LOpStep k lop L L' → KObl k C ObR ObW π (kexp lop L) s2 →
      LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L' (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2))

/-- A kernel simulation run extends along a kernel sequence under the obligations of its steps
(§82 preamble). -/
theorem simRun_path {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 s3' : S3}
    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') :
    ∀ {s2 : Machine.State}, SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2 →
      KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2 → SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro s2 h _; exact h
  | cons h _ ih =>
    intro s2 hs hob
    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
    have := ih (SimRun.step hs h hob₁) hob₂
    simp only [ktrace]
    rw [run_append]
    exact this

/-- §82.7 (realization by O1–O16): every translated library run is a translated kernel run of its
kernel steps, with the same parameters, reaching the same kernel and memory states. -/
theorem LSimRun.simRun {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L.kern s2 := by
  induction h with
  | init hst hlay hob => exact SimRun.init hst hlay hob
  | step _ hs hob ih => exact simRun_path (kexp_path hs) ih hob

/-- The library states of a translated library run are library-reachable (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
theorem LSimRun.lreach {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) : LReach k statics L := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs _ ih => exact .step ih hs.lstep

/-- Simulation of library runs (§82 preamble, §82.7, §9 ¶9): under `DDSound(K)` (§80), for every
translated library run, the memory state is reached from the empty state by an execution of `ok`
raw steps, it is related to the kernel state by `Repr`, and the library state is
library-reachable. -/
theorem lsimulation {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hπ : ParamsOK C π)
    (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    (∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty s2) ∧
      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2 ∧ LReach k statics L := by
  obtain ⟨hex, hR, -⟩ := simulation hdd hπ h.simRun
  exact ⟨hex, hR, h.lreach⟩

/-- R4 along library runs (§82.5, §54, §57): under `DDSound(K)` (§80), in every state of a
translated library run, every leaf covered by an active authority has a live allocation
containing its range. -/
theorem lsim_r4 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hπ : ParamsOK C π)
    (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) : LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 :=
  have hs := lsimulation hdd hπ h
  liveCover_reachable hdd h.simRun.staticsOK hs.2.2.ng.reachable hs.2.1

/-! ## No access after invalidation (§82.7, §78, §86) -/

/-- Labelled library runs (Part XIV, §82.7): each library operation listed with the library
state it starts from. -/
inductive LPath (k : K) : LState → List (LOp × LState) → LState → Prop where
  | nil (L : LState) : LPath k L [] L
  | cons {lop : LOp} {L L₁ L' : LState} {t : List (LOp × LState)} :
      LOpStep k lop L L₁ → LPath k L₁ t L' → LPath k L ((lop, L) :: t) L'

/-- The kernel steps of a labelled library run, in order (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
def ltrace : List (LOp × LState) → List (KOp × S3)
  | [] => []
  | (lop, L) :: t => kexp lop L ++ ltrace t

/-- Kernel steps of composed labelled runs (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
theorem ltrace_append (t t' : List (LOp × LState)) : ltrace (t ++ t') = ltrace t ++ ltrace t' := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p t ih =>
    obtain ⟨lop, L⟩ := p
    simp only [List.cons_append, ltrace, ih, List.append_assoc]

/-- Extension of a labelled library run by one step (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
theorem LPath.snoc {k : K} {L₀ L L' : LState} {t : List (LOp × LState)} {lop : LOp}
    (hp : LPath k L₀ t L) (hs : LOpStep k lop L L') : LPath k L₀ (t ++ [(lop, L)]) L' := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => exact .cons hs (.nil _)
  | cons h _ ih => exact .cons h (ih hs)

/-- The continuation of a labelled library run after one of its steps (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
theorem LPath.split {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L₂ : LState} {t₂ : List (LOp × LState)} :
    ∀ (t₁ : List (LOp × LState)) {L₀ : LState}, LPath k L₀ (t₁ ++ (lop, L) :: t₂) L₂ →
      ∃ L₁, LOpStep k lop L L₁ ∧ LPath k L₁ t₂ L₂
  | [], _, h => by
    cases h with
    | cons hs hp => exact ⟨_, hs, hp⟩
  | (_, _) :: t₁, _, h => by
    cases h with
    | cons _ hp => exact LPath.split t₁ hp

/-- The machine trace of a translated library run is the trace of its kernel steps (§82.7): the
run is a labelled library run from the initial library state, and its memory state is reached
from the initial memory state by the raw operations of its kernel steps, in order. -/
theorem LSimRun.trace {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    ∃ t, LPath k (LState.init statics) t L ∧
      s2 = run (minit π statics) (ktrace π (ltrace t) (minit π statics)) := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact ⟨[], .nil _, rfl⟩
  | step _ hs _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, hp, rfl⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨_, hp.snoc hs, ?_⟩
    rw [ltrace_append, ktrace_append, run_append]
    simp only [ltrace, List.append_nil]
    rfl

/-- The authority that a kernel step uses as a means of access (§82.7): the authority through
which `read`, `write` and `writeShared` access leaves (§66.2, §67.1, §68.2), the authority whose
reference `store` writes (§65, §82.3), and the source from which `derive` and `split` create new
means of access (§60.1, §61.1). The other operations use none. -/
def usedAuth : KOp → Option Nat
  | .read a _ => some a
  | .write a _ _ => some a
  | .writeShared a _ _ => some a
  | .store a _ => some a
  | .derive src _ _ => some src
  | .split src _ => some src
  | _ => none

/-- An authority exercisable at some mode is active (§43). -/
theorem active_of_exercisable {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : s.ExercisableAt a m) :
    s.Active a := by
  cases h with
  | base hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩
  | held hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩

/-- A kernel step uses only an active authority (§60.1, §61.1, §65.1, §66.2, §67.1, §68.2). -/
theorem usedAuth_active {k : K} {op : KOp} {s s' : S3} {j : Nat} (h : OpStep k op s s')
    (hv : usedAuth op = some j) : s.Active j := by
  cases op with
  | read a ls =>
    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact active_of_exercisable (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.exercisable
  | write a ls w =>
    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact active_of_exercisable (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.exercisable
  | writeShared a ls w =>
    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact active_of_exercisable (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.exercisable
  | store a p =>
    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
    have hd := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at hd
    split at hd
    · exact ⟨_, ‹_›, hd.1⟩
    · exact hd.elim
  | derive src r m =>
    obtain rfl : src = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.active
  | split src rs =>
    obtain rfl : src = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.active
  | transfer => cases hv
  | release => cases hv
  | depend => cases hv
  | enter => cases hv
  | exit => cases hv
  | pin => cases hv
  | unpin => cases hv
  | endUse => cases hv
  | free => cases hv
  | alloc => cases hv

/-- Along a labelled library run whose start keeps the authorities of `s₀`, no kernel step uses
an authority of `s₀` that is inactive in `s₀` (§42, §58: authorities are never reactivated). -/
theorem lpath_unused {k : K} {s₀ : S3} {j : Nat} (hj : j < s₀.A.length) (hd : ¬ s₀.Active j)
    {L L₂ : LState} {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hp : LPath k L t L₂) :
    AKeep s₀ L.kern → ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro _ q hq; cases hq
  | cons hs _ ih =>
    intro hk q hq hv
    simp only [ltrace, List.mem_append] at hq
    rcases hq with hq | hq
    · obtain ⟨hk', s₁, hst⟩ := (kexp_path hs).mem q hq
      exact hd ((hk.trans hk').active_back (usedAuth_active hst hv) hj)
    · exact ih (hk.trans (lstep_akeep hs.lstep)) q hq hv

/-- No access after invalidation (§82.7, §78, §86): after a legal `reset` of entry `i`, along
every continuation of the library run, no kernel step reads, writes or writes in shared mode
through, stores, or derives or splits from an authority derived from `internal` that covered a
leaf of the administered storage; so none of the raw operations of the continuation realizes an
access through it. -/
theorem reset_no_access {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁))
    (hp : LPath k L₁ t L₂) {j : Nat} (hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs j)
    (hc : ∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P E.storage) :
    ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
  have hjL : j < L.kern.A.length := by
    obtain ⟨l, hl, -⟩ := hc
    cases hlj : L.kern.A[j]? with
    | none => simp [S3.afp, hlj] at hl
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hlj
  exact lpath_unused ((lstep_akeep (k := k) (.reset hr)).lt hjL) (reset_ends_covering hE hr hj hc)
    hp (akeep_of_eq rfl)

/-- No access through an issued block after a legal reset of its arena (§82.7, §78, §86): for a
live entry satisfying `EntryInv`, after a legal `reset`, along every continuation of the library
run, no kernel step uses a block issued before the reset on a nonempty region. -/
theorem reset_no_access_issued {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hinv : EntryInv L.kern E)
    (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁)) (hp : LPath k L₁ t L₂) :
    ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.1 ≠ [] → ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some e.2 := by
  intro e he hne
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hlt, hf, -⟩ := hinv.2 e he
  have hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs e.2 := by
    unfold S3.ancs
    rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]) hlt]
    exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hne
  exact reset_no_access hE hr hp hj ⟨l, by simp [S3.afp, hy, hf, hl], hinv.1.issuedIn e he l hl⟩

/-- `reset_no_access_issued` on library-reachable states (§82.7, §78, §86, §57): without the
hypothesis `EntryInv`, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). The entry is live (§78.1,
through §60.1) and satisfies `EntryInv` there (`Arena.lReachNG_inv`). -/
theorem reset_no_access_issued_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L L₁ L₂ : LState} (hL : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat}
    {E : ArenaEntry} {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E)
    (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁)) (hp : LPath k L₁ t L₂) :
    ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.1 ≠ [] → ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some e.2 := by
  have hlive : Live L.kern E := by
    cases hr with
    | @ok E' _ _ hE' hd _ _ =>
      rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
      exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).1.active
  exact reset_no_access_issued hE
    ((lReachNG_inv hdd hst hL.ng E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE)).2 hlive) hr hp

/-- §82.7 for translated library runs: the kernel steps of the derived operations are realized
by O1–O16 without reintroducing access after invalidation. The run is a labelled library run from
the initial library state; its memory state is reached from the initial memory state by the raw
operations of its kernel steps (the machine trace of the run is the trace of its kernel steps);
and after every legal `reset` in the run, no kernel step of the continuation uses an authority
derived from `internal` that covered a leaf of the administered storage, so no raw operation of
the continuation is an access through it.

The metadata (`available`, `issued`) is not realized: it is library state with no machine
realization in this model, so the "metadata" part of §82.7 is not covered. This is a reading,
recorded, not settled by the spec: §46 puts the entries in the library's abstract state, separate
from `S₃`, and §81 leaves the representation of library metadata to Spec 11; §36, §71.2 and §76.5
(with the last paragraph of §77) instead speak of metadata kept in storage (`SharedMutable`
storage updated by `writeShared`, provider metadata, the leaves of the arena value), which would
require raw writes realizing each metadata update. -/
theorem arena_realized {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    ∃ t, LPath k (LState.init statics) t L ∧
      s2 = run (minit π statics) (ktrace π (ltrace t) (minit π statics)) ∧
      ∀ t₁ t₂ L₀ i E, t = t₁ ++ (.reset i, L₀) :: t₂ → L₀.arenas[i]? = some E →
        ∀ j, E.internal ∈ L₀.kern.ancs j →
          (∃ l ∈ L₀.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L₀.kern.P E.storage) →
          ∀ q ∈ ltrace t₂, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
  obtain ⟨t, hp, hs⟩ := h.trace
  refine ⟨t, hp, hs, ?_⟩
  rintro t₁ t₂ L₀ i E rfl hE j hj hc
  obtain ⟨L₁, hr, hp₂⟩ := LPath.split t₁ hp
  exact reset_no_access hE hr hp₂ hj hc

/-! ## A concrete library run (non-vacuity; §82.7, Part XIV) -/

section Dec

variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
  {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
  (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] (π : Params Ty)

/-- Decidability of the obligations of a kernel sequence (§20.3, §82). -/
instance kOblDec : (t : List (KOp × S3)) → (s2 : Machine.State) →
    Decidable (KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2)
  | [], _ => isTrue trivial
  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 =>
    @instDecidableAnd _ _ (stepOblDec k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) (kOblDec t _)

end Dec

namespace Runs

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.Runs

/-- Memory state after the library operations `t`, each listed with the library state it starts
from, from the memory state `m` (§82.7). -/
def lrunM {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) : List (LOp × LState) → Machine.State → Machine.State
  | [], m => m
  | (lop, L) :: t, m => lrunM π t (run m (lopsOf π lop L m))

/-- The memory state after library operations is reached by the raw operations of their kernel
steps (§82.7). -/
theorem lrunM_eq {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) :
    ∀ (t : List (LOp × LState)) (m : Machine.State), lrunM π t m = run m (ktrace π (ltrace t) m)
  | [], _ => rfl
  | (lop, L) :: t, m => by
    rw [lrunM, lrunM_eq π t, ltrace, ktrace_append, run_append]
    rfl

/-- A library run through every derived arena operation (Part XIV, §76–§78; the states of
`Arena.Witness`): `derive(1, [1], Modify)` and `store(3, 0)` prepare `internal` 3 held by the arena
value 0; `newArena(1, 3)`; `issue(0, [1], 2)` (block 4 stored into 2); `write(4, [1])`;
`endUse(2)`; `reset(0)`; `issue(0, [1], 2)` again (block 6). -/
def tA : List (LOp × LState) :=
  [(.kernel (.derive 1 [1] .modify), Witness.w0), (.kernel (.store 3 0), Witness.w1),
   (.newArena [] 1 3, Witness.w2), (.issue 0 [1] 2, Witness.w3),
   (.kernel (.write 4 [1] wv), Witness.r4), (.kernel (.endUse 2), Witness.r5),
   (.reset 0, Witness.r6), (.issue 0 [1] 2, Witness.r7)]

/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once (§82): the test layout of the three static places. -/
def πA : Params Unit := piOf (S3.init st).P []

/-- Final memory state of the run (§82.7). -/
def finA : Machine.State := lrunM πA tA (minit πA st)

/-- The run is a translated library run (§82.7, non-vacuity of `LSimRun`): each step is an `ok`
library step and its kernel steps satisfy their obligations under the fixed parameters. -/
theorem runA_lsim : LSimRun K0 (· = ·) obR obW st πA Witness.r8 finA := by
  have h0 : LSimRun K0 (· = ·) obR obW st πA Witness.w0 (minit πA st) :=
    .init (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have h1 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.derive 1 [1] .modify)) (L' := Witness.w1) h0
    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
  have h2 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.store 3 0)) (L' := Witness.w2) h1
    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
  have h3 := LSimRun.step (lop := .newArena [] 1 3) (L' := Witness.w3) h2 (.ok (by decide))
    (by decide)
  have h4 := LSimRun.step (lop := .issue 0 [1] 2) (L' := Witness.r4) h3
    (IssueD.ok (E := Witness.wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (.ok (by decide))) (by decide)
  have h5 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.write 4 [1] wv)) (L' := Witness.r5) h4
    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
  have h6 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.endUse 2)) (L' := Witness.r6) h5
    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
  have h7 := LSimRun.step (lop := .reset 0) (L' := Witness.r7) h6
    (ResetD.ok (E := Witness.rE) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide))
    (by decide)
  exact LSimRun.step (lop := .issue 0 [1] 2) (L' := Witness.r8) h7
    (IssueD.ok (E := Witness.rE') (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (.ok (by decide))) (by decide)

/-- Non-vacuity of the library simulation (§82.7, §82.3): the run is translated into an execution
of `ok` raw steps from the empty state, `Repr` holds at its end, the final library state is
library-reachable, and the machine trace is the trace of the kernel steps. The reference written
into the arena value 0 and the one written into the destination 2 by the second issue decode to
the address of the storage leaf 1, which is nonzero and whose allocation is live. The range of
leaf 1 still holds the bytes written through block 4 before the `reset`: reissued in block 6, the
leaf keeps its bytes in the memory machine (v0.1 §86: reissuance modifies neither the bytes,
`issue_keeps_bytes`, nor the initialization state, `Arena.issue_keeps_init`; see
`Arena.Witness.reissue_reads_former_value`). -/
theorem runA_sim :
    ((∃ ops, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW ops Machine.State.empty finA) ∧
      Refinement.Repr πA.L πA.rtok Witness.r8.kern finA ∧ LReach K0 st Witness.r8) ∧
    finA = run (minit πA st) (ktrace πA (ltrace tA) (minit πA st)) ∧
    decodedAt πA finA 0 = leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ∧ decodedAt πA finA 2 = leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ∧
    leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ≠ 0 ∧ (finA.allocs (πA.L 1).alloc).map (·.live) = some true ∧
    ∀ n < 8, bytesOf finA πA.L 1 n = wv 1 n :=
  ⟨lsimulation (fun _ _ h => h.elim) (piOf_ok _ []) runA_lsim, lrunM_eq _ _ _, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

end Runs

end Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main
2	
3	/-!
4	# Concurrent authority machine: state, frames, invariants
5	
6	Exploratory formalization of the concurrent state `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` of the working
7	candidate `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC4.md` (WC4 C1–C3, C20) on top of the frozen kernel of
8	`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (Spec 1 §38–§45, §49–§57).
9	
10	* contexts with lifecycle states, local stacks and the parent of their initial frame (WC4 C1–C3);
11	* globally live frames, current frame of a context, extended parent relation `parC` and
12	  `ancestorC` (WC4 C3);
13	* the `S3` seen by an executing context (`SC.view`, WC4 C2: current frame = top of its stack,
14	  liveness = globally live frames), the kernel components alone (`SC.flat`), and the projection
15	  `SC.toS3` on single-context states (WC4 C24);
16	* `ConcurrentWF`, `Inv3C`, `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC`, `NoOrphanC` (WC4 C20; Spec 1 §44,
17	  §49–§57 re-indexed);
18	* membership congruence: the kernel invariants of Spec 1 that read the stack only through
19	  membership agree on every view (WC4 C2).
20	-/
21	
22	namespace Ern.Concurrency
23	
24	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
25	
26	/-! ## State (WC4 C1–C3) -/
27	
28	/-- Lifecycle state of an execution context (WC4 C2, C7, C8): live, or completed. -/
29	inductive Life where
30	  | live
31	  | done
32	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
33	
34	/-- Execution context (WC4 C1–C3): its local frame stack, current frame first; its lifecycle
35	state; the parent of its initial frame (`none` for the initial context, whose initial frame is
36	the base frame of Spec 1 §39). -/
37	structure Ctx where
38	  stack : List Nat
39	  life : Life
40	  parent : Option Nat
41	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
42	
43	/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC4 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
44	stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
45	meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
46	structure SC where
47	  C : List Ctx
48	  nF : Nat
49	  P : List Place
50	  I : Nat → InitSt
51	  A : List Authority
52	  D : Nat → List Nat
53	  dead : Nat → Bool
54	  pins : List PinOb
55	
56	/-- Context `c` is live (WC4 C2). -/
57	def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False
58	
59	/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC4 C2). -/
60	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance
61	
62	/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC4 C2, C3). -/
63	def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
64	  match s.C[c]? with
65	  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
66	  | none => []
67	
68	/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC4 C3). -/
69	def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)
70	
71	/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC4 C2). -/
72	def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk
73	
74	/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC4 C2:
75	references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
76	def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
77	  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
78	    pins := s.pins }
79	
80	/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC4 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
81	frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. It is the `S₃`
82	view of WC4 C2 (candidate P1) on which `K.Satisfiable` of an `alloc` executed by `c` is evaluated
83	(`alloc_ok_satisfiable`, `alloc_fail_unsatisfiable`). -/
84	def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
85	  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c) }
86	
87	/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC4 C2). -/
88	def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
89	  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }
90	
91	/-! ## Single-context states (WC4 C24) -/
92	
93	/-- Single-context state (WC4 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
94	parent. -/
95	def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]
96	
97	/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC4 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
98	def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
99	  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
100	    pins := s.pins }
101	
102	/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC4 C24). -/
103	def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
104	  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
105	    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }
106	
107	/-! ## Extended frame-parent relation and ancestry (WC4 C3) -/
108	
109	/-- Parent of frame `f` within a stack whose initial frame has parent `par`: the next frame of
110	the stack, or `par` for the initial frame; `none` if `f` is not in the stack (WC4 C3; Spec 1
111	§39). -/
112	def parIn (par : Option Nat) (f : Nat) : List Nat → Option Nat
113	  | [] => none
114	  | a :: rest => if a = f then rest.head?.or par else parIn par f rest
115	
116	/-- The live context whose stack contains `f` (WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique). -/
117	def SC.ctxOf (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
118	  (List.range s.C.length).find? fun c => (s.stk c).contains f
119	
120	/-- Extended frame-parent relation `parC` (WC4 C3): the parent of a live frame, following the
121	links across contexts; `none` for the base frame and for frames that are not live. -/
122	def SC.parC (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
123	  (s.ctxOf f).bind fun c => parIn (s.ctxParent c) f (s.stk c)
124	
125	/-- Extended `ancestor_C(f₁, f₂)` (WC4 C3; Spec 1 §39): `f₂` is live and `f₁` is `f₂` or one of
126	its ancestors along `parC`. Chains follow links to smaller identities (Spec 1 §49, last
127	paragraph: identity order represents well-foundedness, required by `FramesC.parent`). -/
128	def SC.ancestorC (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop :=
129	  f₂ ∈ s.frames ∧ (f₁ = f₂ ∨ f₁ ∈ chain s.parC f₂)
130	
131	/-- Decidability of `ancestorC` (WC4 C3). -/
132	instance (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (s.ancestorC f₁ f₂) := by
133	  unfold SC.ancestorC; infer_instance
134	
135	/-! ## Anchor order on the extended ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §54 re-indexed; WC4 C2, C3) -/
136	
137	/-- Spec 1 §44 re-indexed (WC4 C2, C3): the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is
138	`fd` or one of its ancestors along `ancestorC`. -/
139	def EffAnchorOKC (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
140	  OptP (s.A[s.flat.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.flat.hframe z.holder)
141	    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => s.ancestorC g f) False) False) False
142	
143	/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOKC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
144	instance (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOKC s x fd) := by
145	  unfold EffAnchorOKC; infer_instance
146	
147	/-- `AnchorOrder` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable
148	place `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of `x` is an `ancestorC` of the frame of `q`. -/
149	def AnchorOrderC (s : SC) : Prop :=
150	  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)
151	
152	/-- `AnchorOrderC` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for Spec 1 §44). -/
153	theorem anchorOrderC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderC s ↔
154	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q,
155	      EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q) :=
156	  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩
157	
158	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
159	instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderC s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderC_iff.symm
160	
161	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): the rule of `AnchorOrderC` for every
162	active authority held by a usable place `q`. -/
163	def AnchorOrderHeldC (s : SC) : Prop :=
164	  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
165	    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)
166	
167	/-- `AnchorOrderHeldC` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure
168	for Spec 1 §44). -/
169	theorem anchorOrderHeldC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderHeldC s ↔
170	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
171	      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
172	        EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)) True := by
173	  constructor
174	  · intro h q _ hq x _
175	    unfold OptP; split
176	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
177	    · trivial
178	  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
179	    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
180	    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh
181	
182	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeldC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
183	instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeldC s) :=
184	  decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeldC_iff.symm
185	
186	/-! ## Invariants (WC4 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49–§57 re-indexed) -/
187	
188	/-- Frame structure of `S_C` (WC4 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed: "the stack" read as the
189	globally live frames). -/
190	structure FramesC (s : SC) : Prop where
191	  /-- WC4 C3: the initial context, context 0, is live and its initial frame, the base frame of
192	  Spec 1 §39, has no parent. -/
193	  initial : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False
194	  /-- WC4 C3: every live context has a nonempty local stack. -/
195	  nonempty : ∀ c, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []
196	  /-- WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique; Spec 1 §49.1: duplicate-free. -/
197	  nodup : s.frames.Nodup
198	  /-- Spec 1 §49.1: every frame has a valid identity (below `nF`). -/
199	  bound : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF
200	  /-- WC4 C3: the initial frame of a non-initial live context has a parent (the frame that
201	  created the context, or its reparenting target, WC4 C6). -/
202	  rooted : ∀ c, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none
203	  /-- Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed, WC4 C3: the parent of a live frame is live; the parent precedes
204	  its child, which represents well-foundedness (Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/
205	  parent : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, ∀ g, s.parC f = some g → g ∈ s.frames ∧ g < f
206	
207	/-- `ConcurrentWF` (WC4 C20): the frame structure of `FramesC` and `WF3` (Spec 1 §49.1–§49.8)
208	read with "the stack" as the globally live frames. -/
209	def ConcurrentWF (s : SC) : Prop := FramesC s ∧ WF3 s.flat
210	
211	/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` re-indexed (Spec 1 §50–§53, §57; WC4 C2): `I4` reads `Read3Pre`, which
212	depends on the current frame, so it is required for every executing context. -/
213	def Inv3baseC (s : SC) : Prop :=
214	  I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ ∀ c, I4 (s.view c)
215	
216	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` re-indexed (Spec 1 §57; WC4 C2). -/
217	def Inv3C (s : SC) : Prop := Inv3baseC s ∧ AnchorOrderC s ∧ NoDangling s.flat
218	
219	/-- `NoOrphan` re-indexed (Spec 1 §54; WC4 C2): chains start at a globally live frame. -/
220	def NoOrphanC (s : SC) : Prop := NoOrphan s.flat
221	
222	/-- The kernel invariant of Spec 1 §57 re-indexed (WC4 C20, C23):
223	`ConcurrentWF ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
224	def KInvC (s : SC) : Prop := ConcurrentWF s ∧ Inv3C s ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s ∧ NoOrphanC s
225	
226	/-! ## Views: membership and current frame (WC4 C2) -/
227	
228	/-- Unfolding of `stk` (WC4 C2). -/
229	theorem SC.stk_of {s : SC} {c : Nat} {x : Ctx} (h : s.C[c]? = some x) (hl : x.life = .live) :
230	    s.stk c = x.stack := by simp [SC.stk, h, hl]
231	
232	/-- A context with a nonempty stack is live (WC4 C2). -/
233	theorem SC.live_of_stk {s : SC} {c : Nat} (h : s.stk c ≠ []) : s.Live c := by
234	  unfold SC.stk at h; unfold SC.Live
235	  split at h
236	  · rename_i x hx; rw [hx]; simp only [OptP]; split at h
237	    · assumption
238	    · exact absurd rfl h
239	  · exact absurd rfl h
240	
241	/-- A frame of a stack is globally live (WC4 C2). -/
242	theorem SC.mem_frames_of {s : SC} {c f : Nat} (h : f ∈ s.stk c) : f ∈ s.frames := by
243	  have hc : c < s.C.length := by
244	    unfold SC.stk at h; split at h
245	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
246	    · simp at h
247	  exact List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨c, List.mem_range.2 hc, h⟩
248	
249	/-- Globally live frames are the frames of some stack (WC4 C2). -/
250	theorem SC.mem_frames {s : SC} {f : Nat} : f ∈ s.frames ↔ ∃ c, f ∈ s.stk c := by
251	  constructor
252	  · intro h; obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 h; exact ⟨c, hc⟩
253	  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; exact SC.mem_frames_of hc
254	
255	/-- The view of a context lists exactly the globally live frames (WC4 C2). -/
256	theorem SC.mem_view_F {s : SC} {c f : Nat} : f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.frames := by
257	  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat, List.mem_append, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
258	  constructor
259	  · rintro (h | ⟨h, -⟩)
260	    · exact SC.mem_frames_of h
261	    · exact h
262	  · intro h
263	    by_cases hc : f ∈ s.stk c
264	    · exact .inl hc
265	    · exact .inr ⟨h, hc⟩
266	
267	/-- A block of a duplicate-free concatenation is duplicate-free (WC4 C3). -/
268	theorem nodup_of_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} :
269	    ∀ {l : List α} {a : α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → a ∈ l → (f a).Nodup
270	  | b :: l, a, h, ha => by
271	    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
272	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha
273	    · exact (List.nodup_append.1 h).1
274	    · exact nodup_of_flatMap (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.1 ha
275	
276	/-- Two blocks of a duplicate-free concatenation share no element (WC4 C3: frame identities are
277	globally unique). -/
278	theorem disjoint_of_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} :
279	    ∀ {l : List α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → l.Nodup → ∀ {a a' : α} {x : β}, a ∈ l → a' ∈ l →
280	      x ∈ f a → x ∈ f a' → a = a'
281	  | b :: l, h, hl, a, a', x, ha, ha', hx, hx' => by
282	    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
283	    obtain ⟨-, h₂, h₃⟩ := List.nodup_append.1 h
284	    have hl' := (List.nodup_cons.1 hl).2
285	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with e₁ | h₁ <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha' with e₂ | h₂'
286	    · rw [e₁, e₂]
287	    · subst e₁; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a', h₂', hx'⟩))
288	    · subst e₂; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx' x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a, h₁, hx⟩))
289	    · exact disjoint_of_flatMap h₂ hl' h₁ h₂' hx hx'
290	
291	/-- The stack of a context is duplicate-free when the live frames are (WC4 C3). -/
292	theorem SC.stk_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.stk c).Nodup := by
293	  by_cases hc : c < s.C.length
294	  · exact nodup_of_flatMap hnd (List.mem_range.2 hc)
295	  · simp [SC.stk, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (Nat.le_of_not_lt hc)]
296	
297	/-- The view of a context is duplicate-free when the live frames are (WC4 C3). -/
298	theorem SC.view_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.view c).F.Nodup := by
299	  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat]
300	  refine List.nodup_append.2 ⟨SC.stk_nodup hnd c, hnd.sublist (List.filter_sublist ..),
301	    fun a ha b hb e => ?_⟩
302	  subst e
303	  simp only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at hb
304	  exact hb.2 ha
305	
306	/-- The current frame of the view of `c` is the top of the stack of `c` (WC4 C2). -/
307	theorem SC.view_top {s : SC} {c f : Nat} {rest : List Nat} (h : s.stk c = f :: rest) :
308	    (s.view c).top = f := by
309	  simp [SC.view, S3.top, h]
310	
311	/-! ## Membership congruence (WC4 C2)
312	
313	The clauses of `WF3`, `I1`–`I3`, `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (Spec 1 §49–§54) read the stack only
314	through membership; they agree on states that differ only by the order of the stack. -/
315	
316	section Congr
317	
318	variable {t : S3} {F' : Frames}
319	
320	/-- Usability depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §40). -/
321	theorem usable_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) {q : Nat} :
322	    ({ t with F := F' } : S3).Usable q ↔ t.Usable q :=
323	  ⟨S3.Usable.mono (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).1 h)
324	    (fun _ h => h),
325	   S3.Usable.mono (s' := t) (s := { t with F := F' }) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).2 h)
326	    (fun _ h => h)⟩
327	
328	/-- Holder liveness depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §49.8). -/
329	theorem holderLive_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (h : Holder) :
330	    HolderLive ({ t with F := F' } : S3) h ↔ HolderLive t h := by
331	  cases h with
332	  | frame f => exact hF f
333	  | place p => exact usable_mem_congr hF
334	
335	/-- `WF3` depends on the stack only through membership, duplicate-freedom and nonemptiness
336	(Spec 1 §49). -/
337	theorem wf3_mem_congr (hw : WF3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (hnd : F'.Nodup)
338	    (hne : F' ≠ []) : WF3 { t with F := F' } where
339	  frames := ⟨hne, hnd, fun f hf => hw.frames.2.2 f ((hF f).1 hf)⟩
340	  places := hw.places
341	  owners := ⟨hw.owners.1, hw.owners.2.1, fun q hq => by
342	    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hw.owners.2.2 q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)
343	    exact ⟨f, (FrameOf.congr (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl).2 hf, (hF f).2 hfF⟩⟩
344	  footprints := hw.footprints
345	  origins := hw.origins
346	  rootChain := hw.rootChain
347	  rootHeld := fun r hr hu => hw.rootHeld r hr ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hu)
348	  holders := fun a y hy ya => (holderLive_mem_congr hF _).2 (hw.holders a y hy ya)
349	
350	/-- `I3` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §52). -/
351	theorem i3_mem_congr (h : I3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) : I3 { t with F := F' } :=
352	  fun q hq x hx => h q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq) x hx
353	
354	/-- `NoDangling` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §54). -/
355	theorem noDangling_mem_congr (h : NoDangling t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) :
356	    NoDangling { t with F := F' } :=
357	  fun j y hy ya q hq => h j y hy ya q fun hu => hq ((usable_mem_congr hF).2 hu)
358	
359	end Congr
360	
361	/-- The view of a context is the flat state with a reordered stack (WC4 C2). -/
362	theorem SC.view_eq (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
363	    s.view c = { s.flat with F := (s.view c).F } := rfl
364	
365	/-- `WF3` of the flat state carries to every view (WC4 C2). -/
366	theorem SC.wf3_view {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c : Nat} :
367	    WF3 (s.view c) := by
368	  rw [SC.view_eq]
369	  refine wf3_mem_congr hw (fun f => SC.mem_view_F) (SC.view_nodup hfr.nodup c) ?_
370	  intro he
371	  have h0 := hfr.initial
372	  unfold OptP at h0; split at h0
373	  · rename_i x hx
374	    have hs := hfr.nonempty 0 (by simp [SC.Live, hx, OptP, h0.1])
375	    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hs
376	    have := (SC.mem_view_F (c := c)).2 (SC.mem_frames_of hf)
377	    rw [he] at this; simp at this
378	  · exact h0.elim
379	
380	/-- `WF3` of a view carries to the flat state (WC4 C2). -/
381	theorem SC.wf3_flat_of_view {s : SC} {c : Nat} (hw : WF3 (s.view c)) (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) :
382	    WF3 s.flat := by
383	  have := wf3_mem_congr (t := s.view c) (F' := s.frames) hw
384	    (fun f => SC.mem_view_F.symm) hnd (fun he => by
385	      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hw.frames.1
386	      have := SC.mem_view_F.1 hf; rw [he] at this; simp at this)
387	  exact this
388	
389	end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Concurrent authority machine: state, frames, invariants

Exploratory formalization of the concurrent state `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` of the working
candidate `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC4.md` (WC4 C1–C3, C20) on top of the frozen kernel of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (Spec 1 §38–§45, §49–§57).

* contexts with lifecycle states, local stacks and the parent of their initial frame (WC4 C1–C3);
* globally live frames, current frame of a context, extended parent relation `parC` and
  `ancestorC` (WC4 C3);
* the `S3` seen by an executing context (`SC.view`, WC4 C2: current frame = top of its stack,
  liveness = globally live frames), the kernel components alone (`SC.flat`), and the projection
  `SC.toS3` on single-context states (WC4 C24);
* `ConcurrentWF`, `Inv3C`, `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC`, `NoOrphanC` (WC4 C20; Spec 1 §44,
  §49–§57 re-indexed);
* membership congruence: the kernel invariants of Spec 1 that read the stack only through
  membership agree on every view (WC4 C2).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## State (WC4 C1–C3) -/

/-- Lifecycle state of an execution context (WC4 C2, C7, C8): live, or completed. -/
inductive Life where
  | live
  | done
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Execution context (WC4 C1–C3): its local frame stack, current frame first; its lifecycle
state; the parent of its initial frame (`none` for the initial context, whose initial frame is
the base frame of Spec 1 §39). -/
structure Ctx where
  stack : List Nat
  life : Life
  parent : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC4 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
structure SC where
  C : List Ctx
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Context `c` is live (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False

/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC4 C2). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance

/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC4 C2, C3). -/
def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
  match s.C[c]? with
  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
  | none => []

/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC4 C3). -/
def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk

/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC4 C2:
references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC4 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. It is the `S₃`
view of WC4 C2 (candidate P1) on which `K.Satisfiable` of an `alloc` executed by `c` is evaluated
(`alloc_ok_satisfiable`, `alloc_fail_unsatisfiable`). -/
def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c) }

/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Single-context states (WC4 C24) -/

/-- Single-context state (WC4 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
parent. -/
def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]

/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC4 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC4 C24). -/
def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Extended frame-parent relation and ancestry (WC4 C3) -/

/-- Parent of frame `f` within a stack whose initial frame has parent `par`: the next frame of
the stack, or `par` for the initial frame; `none` if `f` is not in the stack (WC4 C3; Spec 1
§39). -/
def parIn (par : Option Nat) (f : Nat) : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | a :: rest => if a = f then rest.head?.or par else parIn par f rest

/-- The live context whose stack contains `f` (WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique). -/
def SC.ctxOf (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (List.range s.C.length).find? fun c => (s.stk c).contains f

/-- Extended frame-parent relation `parC` (WC4 C3): the parent of a live frame, following the
links across contexts; `none` for the base frame and for frames that are not live. -/
def SC.parC (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (s.ctxOf f).bind fun c => parIn (s.ctxParent c) f (s.stk c)

/-- Extended `ancestor_C(f₁, f₂)` (WC4 C3; Spec 1 §39): `f₂` is live and `f₁` is `f₂` or one of
its ancestors along `parC`. Chains follow links to smaller identities (Spec 1 §49, last
paragraph: identity order represents well-foundedness, required by `FramesC.parent`). -/
def SC.ancestorC (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop :=
  f₂ ∈ s.frames ∧ (f₁ = f₂ ∨ f₁ ∈ chain s.parC f₂)

/-- Decidability of `ancestorC` (WC4 C3). -/
instance (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (s.ancestorC f₁ f₂) := by
  unfold SC.ancestorC; infer_instance

/-! ## Anchor order on the extended ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §54 re-indexed; WC4 C2, C3) -/

/-- Spec 1 §44 re-indexed (WC4 C2, C3): the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is
`fd` or one of its ancestors along `ancestorC`. -/
def EffAnchorOKC (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.flat.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.flat.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => s.ancestorC g f) False) False) False

/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOKC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOKC s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOKC; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable
place `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of `x` is an `ancestorC` of the frame of `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderC` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for Spec 1 §44). -/
theorem anchorOrderC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderC s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q,
      EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderC s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderC_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): the rule of `AnchorOrderC` for every
active authority held by a usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeldC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeldC` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure
for Spec 1 §44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeldC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderHeldC s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeldC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeldC s) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeldC_iff.symm

/-! ## Invariants (WC4 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49–§57 re-indexed) -/

/-- Frame structure of `S_C` (WC4 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed: "the stack" read as the
globally live frames). -/
structure FramesC (s : SC) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C3: the initial context, context 0, is live and its initial frame, the base frame of
  Spec 1 §39, has no parent. -/
  initial : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False
  /-- WC4 C3: every live context has a nonempty local stack. -/
  nonempty : ∀ c, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique; Spec 1 §49.1: duplicate-free. -/
  nodup : s.frames.Nodup
  /-- Spec 1 §49.1: every frame has a valid identity (below `nF`). -/
  bound : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF
  /-- WC4 C3: the initial frame of a non-initial live context has a parent (the frame that
  created the context, or its reparenting target, WC4 C6). -/
  rooted : ∀ c, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed, WC4 C3: the parent of a live frame is live; the parent precedes
  its child, which represents well-foundedness (Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/
  parent : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, ∀ g, s.parC f = some g → g ∈ s.frames ∧ g < f

/-- `ConcurrentWF` (WC4 C20): the frame structure of `FramesC` and `WF3` (Spec 1 §49.1–§49.8)
read with "the stack" as the globally live frames. -/
def ConcurrentWF (s : SC) : Prop := FramesC s ∧ WF3 s.flat

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` re-indexed (Spec 1 §50–§53, §57; WC4 C2): `I4` reads `Read3Pre`, which
depends on the current frame, so it is required for every executing context. -/
def Inv3baseC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ ∀ c, I4 (s.view c)

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` re-indexed (Spec 1 §57; WC4 C2). -/
def Inv3C (s : SC) : Prop := Inv3baseC s ∧ AnchorOrderC s ∧ NoDangling s.flat

/-- `NoOrphan` re-indexed (Spec 1 §54; WC4 C2): chains start at a globally live frame. -/
def NoOrphanC (s : SC) : Prop := NoOrphan s.flat

/-- The kernel invariant of Spec 1 §57 re-indexed (WC4 C20, C23):
`ConcurrentWF ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
def KInvC (s : SC) : Prop := ConcurrentWF s ∧ Inv3C s ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s ∧ NoOrphanC s

/-! ## Views: membership and current frame (WC4 C2) -/

/-- Unfolding of `stk` (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.stk_of {s : SC} {c : Nat} {x : Ctx} (h : s.C[c]? = some x) (hl : x.life = .live) :
    s.stk c = x.stack := by simp [SC.stk, h, hl]

/-- A context with a nonempty stack is live (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.live_of_stk {s : SC} {c : Nat} (h : s.stk c ≠ []) : s.Live c := by
  unfold SC.stk at h; unfold SC.Live
  split at h
  · rename_i x hx; rw [hx]; simp only [OptP]; split at h
    · assumption
    · exact absurd rfl h
  · exact absurd rfl h

/-- A frame of a stack is globally live (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.mem_frames_of {s : SC} {c f : Nat} (h : f ∈ s.stk c) : f ∈ s.frames := by
  have hc : c < s.C.length := by
    unfold SC.stk at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · simp at h
  exact List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨c, List.mem_range.2 hc, h⟩

/-- Globally live frames are the frames of some stack (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.mem_frames {s : SC} {f : Nat} : f ∈ s.frames ↔ ∃ c, f ∈ s.stk c := by
  constructor
  · intro h; obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 h; exact ⟨c, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; exact SC.mem_frames_of hc

/-- The view of a context lists exactly the globally live frames (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.mem_view_F {s : SC} {c f : Nat} : f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.frames := by
  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat, List.mem_append, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨h, -⟩)
    · exact SC.mem_frames_of h
    · exact h
  · intro h
    by_cases hc : f ∈ s.stk c
    · exact .inl hc
    · exact .inr ⟨h, hc⟩

/-- A block of a duplicate-free concatenation is duplicate-free (WC4 C3). -/
theorem nodup_of_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} :
    ∀ {l : List α} {a : α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → a ∈ l → (f a).Nodup
  | b :: l, a, h, ha => by
    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha
    · exact (List.nodup_append.1 h).1
    · exact nodup_of_flatMap (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.1 ha

/-- Two blocks of a duplicate-free concatenation share no element (WC4 C3: frame identities are
globally unique). -/
theorem disjoint_of_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → l.Nodup → ∀ {a a' : α} {x : β}, a ∈ l → a' ∈ l →
      x ∈ f a → x ∈ f a' → a = a'
  | b :: l, h, hl, a, a', x, ha, ha', hx, hx' => by
    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
    obtain ⟨-, h₂, h₃⟩ := List.nodup_append.1 h
    have hl' := (List.nodup_cons.1 hl).2
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with e₁ | h₁ <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha' with e₂ | h₂'
    · rw [e₁, e₂]
    · subst e₁; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a', h₂', hx'⟩))
    · subst e₂; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx' x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a, h₁, hx⟩))
    · exact disjoint_of_flatMap h₂ hl' h₁ h₂' hx hx'

theorem SC.stk_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.stk c).Nodup := by
  by_cases hc : c < s.C.length
  · exact nodup_of_flatMap hnd (List.mem_range.2 hc)
  · simp [SC.stk, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (Nat.le_of_not_lt hc)]

/-- The view of a context is duplicate-free when the live frames are (WC4 C3). -/
theorem SC.view_nodup {s : SC} (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (c : Nat) : (s.view c).F.Nodup := by
  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat]
  refine List.nodup_append.2 ⟨SC.stk_nodup hnd c, hnd.sublist (List.filter_sublist ..),
    fun a ha b hb e => ?_⟩
  subst e
  simp only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at hb
  exact hb.2 ha

theorem SC.view_top {s : SC} {c f : Nat} {rest : List Nat} (h : s.stk c = f :: rest) :

/-! ## Membership congruence (WC4 C2)

The clauses of `WF3`, `I1`–`I3`, `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (Spec 1 §49–§54) read the stack only
through membership; they agree on states that differ only by the order of the stack. -/

section Congr

variable {t : S3} {F' : Frames}

/-- Usability depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem usable_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) {q : Nat} :
    ({ t with F := F' } : S3).Usable q ↔ t.Usable q :=
  ⟨S3.Usable.mono (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).1 h)
    (fun _ h => h),
   S3.Usable.mono (s' := t) (s := { t with F := F' }) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).2 h)
    (fun _ h => h)⟩

/-- Holder liveness depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §49.8). -/
theorem holderLive_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (h : Holder) :
    HolderLive ({ t with F := F' } : S3) h ↔ HolderLive t h := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => exact hF f
  | place p => exact usable_mem_congr hF

/-- `WF3` depends on the stack only through membership, duplicate-freedom and nonemptiness
(Spec 1 §49). -/
theorem wf3_mem_congr (hw : WF3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (hnd : F'.Nodup)
    (hne : F' ≠ []) : WF3 { t with F := F' } where
  frames := ⟨hne, hnd, fun f hf => hw.frames.2.2 f ((hF f).1 hf)⟩
  places := hw.places
  owners := ⟨hw.owners.1, hw.owners.2.1, fun q hq => by
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hw.owners.2.2 q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)
    exact ⟨f, (FrameOf.congr (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl).2 hf, (hF f).2 hfF⟩⟩
  footprints := hw.footprints
  origins := hw.origins
  rootChain := hw.rootChain
  rootHeld := fun r hr hu => hw.rootHeld r hr ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hu)
  holders := fun a y hy ya => (holderLive_mem_congr hF _).2 (hw.holders a y hy ya)

/-- `I3` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §52). -/
theorem i3_mem_congr (h : I3 t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) : I3 { t with F := F' } :=
  fun q hq x hx => h q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq) x hx

/-- `NoDangling` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §54). -/
theorem noDangling_mem_congr (h : NoDangling t) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) :
    NoDangling { t with F := F' } :=
  fun j y hy ya q hq => h j y hy ya q fun hu => hq ((usable_mem_congr hF).2 hu)

end Congr

/-- The view of a context is the flat state with a reordered stack (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.view_eq (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
    s.view c = { s.flat with F := (s.view c).F } := rfl

/-- `WF3` of the flat state carries to every view (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.wf3_view {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) {c : Nat} :
    WF3 (s.view c) := by
  rw [SC.view_eq]
  refine wf3_mem_congr hw (fun f => SC.mem_view_F) (SC.view_nodup hfr.nodup c) ?_
  intro he
  have h0 := hfr.initial
  unfold OptP at h0; split at h0
  · rename_i x hx
    have hs := hfr.nonempty 0 (by simp [SC.Live, hx, OptP, h0.1])
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hs
    have := (SC.mem_view_F (c := c)).2 (SC.mem_frames_of hf)
    rw [he] at this; simp at this
  · exact h0.elim

/-- `WF3` of a view carries to the flat state (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.wf3_flat_of_view {s : SC} {c : Nat} (hw : WF3 (s.view c)) (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) :
    WF3 s.flat := by
  have := wf3_mem_congr (t := s.view c) (F' := s.frames) hw
    (fun f => SC.mem_view_F.symm) hnd (fun he => by
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hw.frames.1
      have := SC.mem_view_F.1 hf; rw [he] at this; simp at this)
  exact this

end Ern.Concurrency

1	import Ern.Concurrency.Context
2	
3	/-!
4	# Concurrent authority machine: inherited operations and frame transitions
5	
6	* the kernel operations O1–O16 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (§60–§75)
7	  executed by a live context `c` (WC4 C2): every operation reads the view of `c` (current frame =
8	  top of its stack, liveness = globally live frames); the clauses that read `ancestor` (§63.6,
9	  §63.7, §64.3, §65.4, §65.5, §72.4, §73.5) read `ancestorC` instead; O6 pushes the new frame on
10	  the stack of `c`; O7 is `exitFrameC` (WC4 C6: O7 and the reparenting of the context-initial
11	  frames whose parent is the exiting frame);
12	* `spawn` (WC4 C4, modeled on Spec 1 §72), `terminate` (WC4 C7, Spec 1 §73 on the initial frame
13	  of a non-initial context), `join` (WC4 C8);
14	* `CStep`, the union of their `ok` transitions.
15	
16	Waiting (`join` on a live context) has no outcome: the transition is not enabled (WC4 C8).
17	-/
18	
19	namespace Ern.Concurrency
20	
21	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
22	
23	/-! ## Outcomes (Spec 1 §58) -/
24	
25	/-- Image of an outcome (Spec 1 §58). -/
26	def omap {σ τ : Type} (f : σ → τ) : Outcome3 σ → Outcome3 τ
27	  | .ok s => .ok (f s)
28	  | .reject => .reject
29	  | .fail => .fail
30	
31	/-! ## Operations that do not read `ancestor` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC4 C2) -/
32	
33	/-- An operation of Spec 1 that reads neither `ancestor` nor the stack beyond its top and its
34	membership, run by context `c` on its view and written back (WC4 C2). The context must be live;
35	otherwise the operation has no outcome. -/
36	def ViewStep (R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (c : Nat) (s : SC) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
37	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, R (s.view c) o₃ ∧ o = omap s.set o₃
38	
39	/-! ## O4 `transfer` re-indexed (Spec 1 §63) -/
40	
41	/-- Effect of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect, WC4 C2). -/

43	
44	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed, WC4 C2): the clauses of
45	`TransferPre` on the view of `c`, with §63.6 and §63.7 read on `ancestorC`. -/
46	structure TransferPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : Prop where
47	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
48	  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
49	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
50	  dstUsable : (s.view c).Usable dst
51	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
52	  srcRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify src
53	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
54	  dstRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst
55	  /-- Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
56	  sameShape : SameShape (s.view c).P src dst
57	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
58	  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init
59	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
60	  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init
61	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
62	  disjoint : ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst
63	  /-- Spec 1 §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source,
64	  except some authority grounding the `Modify` right over the source and its origin chain. -/
65	  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
66	    ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
67	      RightChain (s.view c) g j
68	  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
69	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false
70	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
71	  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x
72	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
73	  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst)
74	  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
75	  `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
76	  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
77	    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
78	      OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
79	        y.holder = .place q →
80	          EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
81	            ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True
82	  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
83	  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst
84	  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
85	  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst

89	    Decidable (TransferPreC k s c src dst) :=
90	  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable src ∧ (s.view c).Usable dst ∧
91	    HasRight (s.view c) .modify src ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst ∧
92	    SameShape (s.view c).P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init) ∧
93	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst ∧
94	    (∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
95	      ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
96	        RightChain (s.view c) g j) ∧
97	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false) ∧
98	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
99	    AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst) ∧
100	    (∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
101	      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
102	        OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
103	          y.holder = .place q →
104	            EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
105	              ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧

109	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>

192	  callerLive : s.stk c ≠ []
193	  /-- Spec 1 §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
194	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
195	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False

209	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧

214	/-! ## O7 re-indexed: `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73; WC4 C6) -/

216	/-- Reparenting (WC4 C6 effect): every live context whose initial frame has parent `f` gets the
217	parent `p`. -/
218	def reparent (C : List Ctx) (f p : Nat) : List Ctx :=
219	  C.map fun x => if x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = some f then { x with parent := some p } else x
220	
221	/-- Effect of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 effect; WC4 C6 effect): the effect of Spec 1 on

223	is popped, its caller `p` becomes current again, and the context-initial frames whose parent is
224	`f` are reparented to `p`; the other ancestry links are unchanged (WC4 C6 effect). -/
225	def exitEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
226	  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
227	    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := x.stack.tail })
228	      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) }
229

231	transposed, O7.2–O7.5 on the global state). The surviving frames are the other globally live
232	frames. -/

234	  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed (WC4 C6, first paragraph): the current frame of `c` is not the

239	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
240	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
241	  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
242	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
243	    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
244	  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
245	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
246	    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
247	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
248	  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
249	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c)

251	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73). -/
252	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (ExitPreC k s c) :=
253	  decidable_of_iff ((s.stk c).tail ≠ [] ∧
254	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
255	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
256	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
257	      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
258	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
259	      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
260	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧

264	/-! ## The inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a context (WC4 C2) -/
265	
266	/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation O1–O16 executed by context `c` (Spec 1 §60–§75
267	re-indexed, WC4 C2). Operations reading `ancestor` or changing the stack have their re-indexed
268	preconditions and effects; the others run on the view of `c`. A context that is not live executes
269	nothing. -/
270	def opStepC (k : K) : KernelOp → Nat → SC → Outcome3 SC → Prop
271	  | .transfer src dst, c, s, o =>
272	    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TransferPreC k s c src dst) (transferEffC s c src dst) o
273	  | .depend q x, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DependPreC s c q x) (dependEffC s c q x) o
274	  | .store a p, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (StorePreC s c a p) (storeEffC s c a p) o
275	  | .enter ps ls, c, s, o =>
276	    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (EnterPreC s c ps ls) (enterEffC s c ps ls) o
277	  | .exit, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (ExitPreC k s c) (exitEffC s c) o
278	  | op, c, s, o => ViewStep (op.Step k) c s o
279	
280	/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): the `K.Satisfiable` obligation of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c`
281	is evaluated on the view of `c`: an `ok` outcome entails it. -/
282	theorem alloc_ok_satisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s s' : SC}
283	    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s (.ok s')) : k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
284	  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
285	  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
286	  cases hR with
287	  | ok _ hsat => exact hsat
288	  | fail => cases ho
289	  | reject => cases ho
290	
291	/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): a `fail` outcome of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c` entails that
292	`K.Satisfiable` fails on the view of `c`. -/
293	theorem alloc_fail_unsatisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s : SC}
294	    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s .fail) : ¬ k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
295	  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
296	  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
297	  cases hR with
298	  | ok => cases ho
299	  | fail _ hsat => exact hsat
300	  | reject => cases ho

302	/-! ## `spawn` (WC4 C4, on Spec 1 §72) -/
303	
304	/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose
305	stack is the fresh frame `nF`, parented to the creating frame; the locals of the new frame and
306	their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
307	view of `c`. -/
308	def spawnEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
309	  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
310	    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }
311	
312	/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC4 C4.1–C4.5): the clauses of `EnterPre`
313	(Spec 1 §72, `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops`) re-indexed as in `EnterPreC`, with O6.3 read from the
314	current frame of the new context. C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication)
315	hold by construction of `spawnEff`; C4.6 concerns `spawn` with a value
316	(`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`); the preservation obligations of WC4 C4 are theorems, not
317	preconditions. -/
318	structure SpawnPre (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
319	  /-- WC4 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
320	  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
321	  /-- WC4 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
322	  the creating frame. -/
323	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
324	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
325	  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
326	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
327	  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of the
328	  new context. -/
329	  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
330	  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
331	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)
332	
333	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC4 C4). -/
334	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
335	    Decidable (SpawnPre s c ps ls) :=
336	  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
337	      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
338	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
339	    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
340	    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
341	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
342	
343	/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/

347	/-! ## `terminate` (WC4 C7, on Spec 1 §73) -/

352	`f` are reparented to the parent of `f` (WC4 C7, C6 effect). -/

364	  /-- WC4 C7: the nested call frames have ended; only the initial frame remains. -/
365	  initialOnly : (s.stk c).length = 1
366	  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed: the initial frame has a surviving parent. -/
367	  hasParent : OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False

371	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
372	  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
373	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
374	    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
375	  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
376	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
377	    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
378	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
379	  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
380	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c)
