383	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (TermPre k s c) :=
384	  decidable_of_iff (c ≠ 0 ∧ (s.stk c).length = 1 ∧
385	    OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False ∧
386	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
387	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
388	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
389	      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧

392	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
393	    AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c))
394	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
395	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

397	/-- `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
398	def TermStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
399	  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TermPre k s c) (termEffC s c) o

401	/-! ## `join` (WC4 C8) -/
402	
403	/-- `join d` executed by `c` (WC4 C8): `reject` when `d` is unknown to the execution (no context
404	has identity `d`, identities being the indices of `C`); `ok` with the state unchanged when `d` has
405	the completed lifecycle state; no outcome while `d` is live (WC4 C8: awaiting completion is not an
406	`Outcome3` result). -/
407	inductive JoinStep (s : SC) (c d : Nat) : Outcome3 SC → Prop where
408	  | ok : s.Live c → OptP (s.C[d]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False → JoinStep s c d (.ok s)
409	  | reject : s.Live c → s.C[d]? = none → JoinStep s c d .reject

411	/-! ## Concurrent kernel steps -/
412	
413	/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel without synchronization (WC4 C2, C4, C6–C8):
414	an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by a context, `spawn`, `terminate` or `join`. -/
415	inductive CStep (k : K) : SC → SC → Prop where
416	  | kernel {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} : opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
417	  | spawn {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
418	      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
419	  | terminate {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} : TermStep k s c (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
420	  | join {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} : JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
421	
422	end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Context

/-!
# Concurrent authority machine: inherited operations and frame transitions

* the kernel operations O1–O16 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (§60–§75)
  executed by a live context `c` (WC4 C2): every operation reads the view of `c` (current frame =
  top of its stack, liveness = globally live frames); the clauses that read `ancestor` (§63.6,
  §63.7, §64.3, §65.4, §65.5, §72.4, §73.5) read `ancestorC` instead; O6 pushes the new frame on
  the stack of `c`; O7 is `exitFrameC` (WC4 C6: O7 and the reparenting of the context-initial
  frames whose parent is the exiting frame);
* `spawn` (WC4 C4, modeled on Spec 1 §72), `terminate` (WC4 C7, Spec 1 §73 on the initial frame
  of a non-initial context), `join` (WC4 C8);
* `CStep`, the union of their `ok` transitions.

Waiting (`join` on a live context) has no outcome: the transition is not enabled (WC4 C8).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Outcomes (Spec 1 §58) -/

/-- Image of an outcome (Spec 1 §58). -/
def omap {σ τ : Type} (f : σ → τ) : Outcome3 σ → Outcome3 τ
  | .ok s => .ok (f s)
  | .reject => .reject
  | .fail => .fail

/-! ## Operations that do not read `ancestor` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC4 C2) -/

/-- An operation of Spec 1 that reads neither `ancestor` nor the stack beyond its top and its
membership, run by context `c` on its view and written back (WC4 C2). The context must be live;
otherwise the operation has no outcome. -/
def ViewStep (R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (c : Nat) (s : SC) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, R (s.view c) o₃ ∧ o = omap s.set o₃

/-! ## O4 `transfer` re-indexed (Spec 1 §63) -/

/-- Effect of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def transferEffC (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : SC := s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed, WC4 C2): the clauses of
`TransferPre` on the view of `c`, with §63.6 and §63.7 read on `ancestorC`. -/
structure TransferPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : (s.view c).Usable dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify src
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape (s.view c).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source,
  except some authority grounding the `Modify` right over the source and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
      RightChain (s.view c) g j
  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst)
  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
  `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
        y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
            ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPreC k s c src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable src ∧ (s.view c).Usable dst ∧
    HasRight (s.view c) .modify src ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst ∧
    SameShape (s.view c).P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
        RightChain (s.view c) g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
    AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
          y.holder = .place q →
            EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
              ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst ∧ (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-! ## O5 `depend` re-indexed (Spec 1 §64) -/

/-- Effect of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def dependEffC (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : SC := s.set (dependEff (s.view c) q x)

/-- Preconditions of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure DependPreC (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §64.1: `result` is usable. -/
  usable : (s.view c).Usable q
  /-- Spec 1 §64.1: exercisable `Modify` over `result`. -/
  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify q
  /-- Spec 1 §64.2: `anchor` is active. -/
  anchorActive : (s.view c).Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §64.3 re-indexed: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an
  `ancestorC` of it. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s x ((s.view c).pframe q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64). -/
instance (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPreC s c q x) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable q ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify q ∧ (s.view c).Active x ∧
    EffAnchorOKC s x ((s.view c).pframe q))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-! ## O8 `store` re-indexed (Spec 1 §65) -/

/-- Effect of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def storeEffC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : SC := s.set (storeEff (s.view c) a p)

/-- Preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure StorePreC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : (s.view c).Usable p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf (s.view c).P p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
    OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- Spec 1 §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
      l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q
  /-- Spec 1 §65.4 re-indexed: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`)
  relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p)
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65). -/
instance (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePreC s c a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False ∧ (s.view c).Usable p ∧ isLeaf (s.view c).P p ∧
    HasRight (s.view c) .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
      OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
        l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` re-indexed (Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 effect, WC4 C2): the effect of Spec 1 on
the view of `c`; the new frame `nF` is pushed on the stack of `c`. -/
def enterEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := s.nF :: x.stack } }

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure EnterPreC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed: the calling frame, the current frame of `c`, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- Spec 1 §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- Spec 1 §72.3 re-indexed: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state, for the
  executing context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p
  /-- Spec 1 §72.4 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (EnterPreC s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-! ## O7 re-indexed: `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73; WC4 C6) -/

/-- Reparenting (WC4 C6 effect): every live context whose initial frame has parent `f` gets the
parent `p`. -/
def reparent (C : List Ctx) (f p : Nat) : List Ctx :=
  C.map fun x => if x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = some f then { x with parent := some p } else x

/-- Effect of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 effect; WC4 C6 effect): the effect of Spec 1 on
the view of `c`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; the top `f` of the stack of `c`
is popped, its caller `p` becomes current again, and the context-initial frames whose parent is
`f` are reparented to `p`; the other ancestry links are unchanged (WC4 C6 effect). -/
def exitEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := x.stack.tail })
      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 re-indexed; WC4 C6, C6.1: O7.1
transposed, O7.2–O7.5 on the global state). The surviving frames are the other globally live
frames. -/
structure ExitPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed (WC4 C6, first paragraph): the current frame of `c` is not the
  initial frame of its context and has a surviving caller in its stack. -/
  hasCaller : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []
  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (ExitPreC k s c) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.stk c).tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-! ## The inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a context (WC4 C2) -/

/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation O1–O16 executed by context `c` (Spec 1 §60–§75
re-indexed, WC4 C2). Operations reading `ancestor` or changing the stack have their re-indexed
preconditions and effects; the others run on the view of `c`. A context that is not live executes
nothing. -/
def opStepC (k : K) : KernelOp → Nat → SC → Outcome3 SC → Prop
  | .transfer src dst, c, s, o =>
    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TransferPreC k s c src dst) (transferEffC s c src dst) o
  | .depend q x, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DependPreC s c q x) (dependEffC s c q x) o
  | .store a p, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (StorePreC s c a p) (storeEffC s c a p) o
  | .enter ps ls, c, s, o =>
    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (EnterPreC s c ps ls) (enterEffC s c ps ls) o
  | .exit, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (ExitPreC k s c) (exitEffC s c) o
  | op, c, s, o => ViewStep (op.Step k) c s o

/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): the `K.Satisfiable` obligation of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c`
is evaluated on the view of `c`: an `ok` outcome entails it. -/
theorem alloc_ok_satisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s s' : SC}
    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s (.ok s')) : k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
  cases hR with
  | ok _ hsat => exact hsat
  | fail => cases ho
  | reject => cases ho

/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): a `fail` outcome of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c` entails that
`K.Satisfiable` fails on the view of `c`. -/
theorem alloc_fail_unsatisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s : SC}
    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s .fail) : ¬ k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
  cases hR with
  | ok => cases ho
  | fail _ hsat => exact hsat
  | reject => cases ho

/-! ## `spawn` (WC4 C4, on Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose
stack is the fresh frame `nF`, parented to the creating frame; the locals of the new frame and
their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
view of `c`. -/
def spawnEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }

/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC4 C4.1–C4.5): the clauses of `EnterPre`
(Spec 1 §72, `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops`) re-indexed as in `EnterPreC`, with O6.3 read from the
current frame of the new context. C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication)
hold by construction of `spawnEff`; C4.6 concerns `spawn` with a value
(`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`); the preservation obligations of WC4 C4 are theorems, not
preconditions. -/
structure SpawnPre (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC4 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
  the creating frame. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of the
  new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC4 C4). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (SpawnPre s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def SpawnStep (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnPre s c ps ls) (spawnEff s c ps ls) o

/-! ## `terminate` (WC4 C7, on Spec 1 §73) -/

/-- Effect of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`
for its initial frame `f`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; `c` leaves the
live-context set with the completed lifecycle state; the context-initial frames whose parent is
`f` are reparented to the parent of `f` (WC4 C7, C6 effect). -/
def termEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := [], life := .done })
      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) }

/-- Preconditions of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7: the O7 validity requirements applied to
the initial frame of a terminating non-initial context, after its nested call frames have
ended). -/
structure TermPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C7: a non-initial context (WC4 C3: the base frame never exits). -/
  nonInitial : c ≠ 0
  /-- WC4 C7: the nested call frames have ended; only the initial frame remains. -/
  initialOnly : (s.stk c).length = 1
  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed: the initial frame has a surviving parent. -/
  hasParent : OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False
  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `terminate` (WC4 C7). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (TermPre k s c) :=
  decidable_of_iff (c ≠ 0 ∧ (s.stk c).length = 1 ∧
    OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def TermStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TermPre k s c) (termEffC s c) o

/-! ## `join` (WC4 C8) -/

/-- `join d` executed by `c` (WC4 C8): `reject` when `d` is unknown to the execution (no context
has identity `d`, identities being the indices of `C`); `ok` with the state unchanged when `d` has
the completed lifecycle state; no outcome while `d` is live (WC4 C8: awaiting completion is not an
`Outcome3` result). -/
inductive JoinStep (s : SC) (c d : Nat) : Outcome3 SC → Prop where
  | ok : s.Live c → OptP (s.C[d]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False → JoinStep s c d (.ok s)
  | reject : s.Live c → s.C[d]? = none → JoinStep s c d .reject

/-! ## Concurrent kernel steps -/

/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel without synchronization (WC4 C2, C4, C6–C8):
an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by a context, `spawn`, `terminate` or `join`. -/
inductive CStep (k : K) : SC → SC → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} : opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | spawn {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | terminate {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} : TermStep k s c (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
  | join {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} : JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → CStep k s s'

end Ern.Concurrency

1	import Ern.Concurrency.Sync
2	import Ern.Concurrency.Transfer
3	
4	/-!
5	# Reference synchronization library
6	
7	Library state separate from `S_C` (WC4 C2, C12), on the pattern of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (Spec
8	1 §46, §55, §56):
9	
10	* the registry of `SyncEntry { guarded, grant }` (WC4 C12), liveness of an entry, the positional
11	  `ControlOf` relationship (WC4 C12) for declared field positions `MutexLayout`;
12	* `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.1–C21.7) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22);
13	* the library instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized` on the registry (WC4 C14.1–C14.3), and the
14	  contract obligation `SyncSound` of WC4 C14 ("cannot be used outside the corresponding valid
15	  synchronization contract");
16	* derived operations `newMutex` (C13), `acquire` (C16), `unlock` (C17), `resetLock` (C18);
17	* labelled library steps, the by-value composite included (WC4 C23), runs, and the encapsulation
18	  hypothesis `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22.1–C22.3, C22.5; C23), a predicate on runs, never a
19	  precondition of a kernel operation.
20	-/
21	
22	namespace Ern.Concurrency
23	
24	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
25	
26	/-! ## Registry (WC4 C12) -/
27	
28	/-- Synchronization entry (WC4 C12): the protected authority `guarded` and the recorded grant. -/
29	structure SyncEntry where
30	  guarded : Nat
31	  grant : Option Nat
32	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
33	
34	/-- Synchronization registry (WC4 C12), library state separate from `S_C`. -/
35	abbrev SyncReg := List SyncEntry
36	
37	/-- Declared field positions of the reference mutex value (WC4 C12: "at its declared field
38	position", `guardedField`, `controlField`): the position of the field holding `guarded` and that of the controller, among the
39	ordered children of the mutex value. -/
40	structure MutexLayout where
41	  guardedField : Nat
42	  controlField : Nat
43	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
44	
45	/-- An entry is live exactly while `guarded` is active (WC4 C12). -/
46	def SyncEntry.Live (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop := s.flat.Active e.guarded
47	
48	/-- Decidability of liveness of an entry (WC4 C12). -/
49	instance (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Decidable (e.Live s) := by
50	  unfold SyncEntry.Live; infer_instance
51	
52	/-- Positional `ControlOf` (WC4 C12): `guarded` is held by the field `h` at position
53	`guardedField` of the mutex value `m` (the structural parent of `h`); the controller is the child
54	of `m` at position `controlField`. -/
55	def ControlOf (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Option Nat :=
56	  match (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) with
57	  | some (Holder.place h) =>
58	    match parentOf s.P h with
59	    | some m =>
60	      if (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some h then (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? else none
61	    | none => none
62	  | _ => none
63	
64	/-- The `S3` whose current frame is `f` (WC4 C14: `SyncAuthorized` names the requesting frame;
65	Spec 1 §43 reads the stack only through its top and membership). -/
66	def SC.viewAt (s : SC) (f : Nat) : S3 :=
67	  { s.flat with F := f :: s.frames.filter fun g => decide (g ≠ f) }
68	
69	/-- WC4 C14.3: the frame `f` has effective and exercisable access to `ControlOf(e)` under the
70	condition of Spec 1 §68.2: some authority exercisable by `f` in a mode at least `Observe` has a
71	present effective mode on the controller. -/
72	def CtrlRight (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
73	  OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length,
74	    (s.viewAt f).ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ effective s.flat a ctl ≠ none) False
75	
76	/-- Decidability of the controller fact. -/
77	instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (CtrlRight L s e f) := by
78	  unfold CtrlRight; infer_instance
79	
80	/-- The authorization facts of WC4 C14 for an entry: C14.1 (live), C14.2 (`grant = none`), C14.3
81	(`CtrlRight`). -/
82	def EntryAuth (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
83	  e.Live s ∧ e.grant = none ∧ CtrlRight L s e f
84	
85	/-- Decidability of the library authorization of an entry. -/
86	instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (EntryAuth L s e f) := by
87	  unfold EntryAuth; infer_instance
88	
89	/-- Instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, sync_registry, guarded, requesting_frame)` by the
90	library (WC4 C14, C25): an entry of the registry with the requested `guarded` identity satisfies
91	the authorization facts C14.1–C14.3. -/
92	def LibSyncAuthorized (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) : Prop :=
93	  ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ EntryAuth L s e f
94	
95	/-- Decidability of the library instantiation. -/
96	instance (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
97	    Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f) := by
98	  unfold LibSyncAuthorized; infer_instance
99	
100	/-- The contract `K_C` instantiated by the library (WC4 C14, C25), the registry type being
101	`SyncReg` (WC4 C2). -/
102	def libKC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : KC SyncReg :=
103	  { k with SyncAuthorized := LibSyncAuthorized L }
104	
105	/-- Decidability of the instantiated predicate. -/
106	instance (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
107	    Decidable ((libKC k L).SyncAuthorized reg s g f) :=
108	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f))
109	
110	/-- Contract obligation of WC4 C14 ("cannot be used outside the corresponding valid
111	synchronization contract"), in state `s` with registry `reg`: `SyncAuthorized` holds only for the
112	`guarded` of a live entry of `reg`. -/
113	def SyncSound (kc : KC SyncReg) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) : Prop :=
114	  ∀ g f, kc.SyncAuthorized reg s g f → ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ e.Live s
115	
116	/-- The library instantiation satisfies the obligation of WC4 C14. -/
117	theorem libKC_sound (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) :
118	    SyncSound (libKC k L) reg s :=
119	  fun _ _ ⟨e, he, hg, hl, _⟩ => ⟨e, he, hg, hl⟩
120	
121	/-- The holder is a usable place (WC4 C12, C13.1, C21.1). -/
122	def PlaceUsable (t : S3) : Holder → Prop
123	  | .place q => t.Usable q
124	  | .frame _ => False
125	
126	/-- Decidability of `PlaceUsable` (WC4 C12). -/
127	instance (t : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (PlaceUsable t h) := by
128	  cases h <;> unfold PlaceUsable <;> infer_instance
129	
130	/-- Spec 1 §65.3 for an authority held by a place `q`: it covers neither a leaf of `q` nor a leaf
131	of storage transitively owned by `q` (WC4 C13.5). -/
132	def StoredOK (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
133	  match y.holder with
134	  | .place q => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∉ footprint P q ∧
135	      ∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, OwnedIn P q r → l ∉ footprint P r
136	  | .frame _ => True
137	
138	/-- Decidability of `StoredOK` (Spec 1 §65.3). -/
139	instance (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Decidable (StoredOK P y) := by
140	  unfold StoredOK; split <;> infer_instance
141	
142	/-- The place `slot` holding `guarded` (WC4 C12). -/
143	def slotOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
144	  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
145	  | some (Holder.place h) => some h
146	  | _ => none
147	
148	/-! ## Invariants (WC4 C21, C22) -/
149	
150	/-- Active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf, a leaf of `footprint(guarded)`
151	(WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C21.5, C22). -/
152	def CoveringDesc (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Prop :=
153	  g ∈ s.flat.ancs j ∧ s.flat.Active j ∧ ∃ l ∈ s.flat.afp j, l ∈ s.flat.afp g
154	
155	/-- Decidability of `CoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
156	instance (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (CoveringDesc s g j) := by
157	  unfold CoveringDesc; infer_instance
158	
159	/-- No active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf (WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C22). -/
160	def NoCoveringDesc (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Prop := ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ CoveringDesc s g j
161	
162	/-- Decidability of `NoCoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
163	instance (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Decidable (NoCoveringDesc s g) := by
164	  unfold NoCoveringDesc; infer_instance
165	
166	/-- `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22). -/
167	def GrantDiscipline (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
168	  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
169	
170	/-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: distinct live entries (by position in the registry) have distinct
171	`ControlOf` leaves. -/
172	def CtlUnique (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
173	  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry) (ctl : Nat), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
174	    e.Live s → e'.Live s → ControlOf L s e = some ctl → ControlOf L s e' = some ctl → i = j
175	
176	/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `slot`: for every live entry, every structural leaf of
177	the place holding `guarded` is `Init`. -/
178	def SlotInit (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
179	  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
180	    OptP (slotOf s e.guarded) (fun q => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.I l = .init) False
181	
182	/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `ctl`: for every live entry, the controller leaf
183	`ControlOf(entry)` is `Init`. -/
184	def CtlInit (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
185	  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.I ctl = .init) False
186	
187	/-- `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.1–C21.7): items 1–5 and 7 over live entries, item 6 over every entry. -/
188	structure SyncInv (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop where
189	  /-- WC4 C21.1: `guarded` is active (liveness), has own mode `Modify`, and is held by a usable
190	  place. -/
191	  guarded : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
192	    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
193	  /-- WC4 C21.2: a recorded grant exists, has origin `guarded` and footprint
194	  `footprint(guarded)`. -/
195	  grant : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
196	    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
197	  /-- WC4 C21.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a usable
198	  leaf. -/
199	  control : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
200	    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
201	  /-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: controller uniqueness among live entries. -/
202	  ctlUnique : CtlUnique L s reg
203	  /-- WC4 C21.4, second clause (the guarded-identity uniqueness guard of WC4 C13.7): distinct
204	  live entries have distinct `guarded` identities. -/
205	  unique : ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
206	    e.Live s → e'.Live s →
207	    e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
208	  /-- WC4 C21.5, `GrantSubtree`. -/
209	  grantSubtree : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
210	    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
211	  /-- WC4 C21.6, `RegBound`, over every entry: the registered `guarded` identity exists (Spec 1
212	  §38: identities are indices). -/
213	  regBound : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length
214	  /-- WC4 C21.7: the structural leaves of `slot` are `Init`. -/
215	  slotInit : SlotInit s reg
216	  /-- WC4 C21.7: the controller leaf is `Init`. -/
217	  ctlInit : CtlInit L s reg
218	
219	/-! ## Derived operations (WC4 C13, C16–C18) -/
220	
221	/-- The mutex value `M` of WC4 C12, C13: the immediate structural parent of the place `slot`
222	holding `guarded`. -/
223	def mutexOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
224	  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
225	  | some (Holder.place h) => parentOf s.P h
226	  | _ => none
227	
228	/-- Preconditions of `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13.1–C13.10), with `adm` the
229	identities used by the other live administrations (Spec 1 §56). The interface and realization
230	obligations of WC4 C13 (C13.3, C13.6, former C13.10) are not represented: WC4 C13 says they "are
231	not claimed to follow from the authority-only state `S_C`". -/
232	structure NewMutexPre (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg)
233	    (c g : Nat) : Prop where
234	  /-- WC4 C13.1: `guarded` is active, of own mode `Modify`, and held by a usable place. -/
235	  guarded : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
236	    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
237	  /-- WC4 C13.2: ordinary exercisable `Modify` over `guarded` (Spec 1 §43). -/
238	  exercisable : (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify
239	  /-- WC4 C13.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a
240	  usable leaf. -/
241	  control : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
242	  /-- WC4 C13.4: `footprint(guarded) ∩ footprint(M) = ∅`. -/
243	  disjointM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False
244	  /-- WC4 C13.10: every structural leaf of `footprint(M)` is `Init`. -/
245	  initM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False
246	  /-- WC4 C13.5: when `guarded` is stored (derived), Spec 1 §65.3 holds: it covers neither a leaf
247	  of its holder nor a leaf of storage transitively owned by it. -/
248	  stored : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False
249	  /-- WC4 C13.6: `K.SharedMutable(ctl)`. -/
250	  sharedMutable : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False
251	  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live entry. -/
252	  unique : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g
253	  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live administration. -/
254	  otherAdmin : g ∉ adm
255	  /-- WC4 C13.8: no other live entry is associated with `ctl`. -/
256	  ctlUnique : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
257	    ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False
258	  /-- WC4 C13.9. -/
259	  available : NoCoveringDesc s g
260	
261	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `newMutex` (WC4 C13). -/
262	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC)
263	    (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat) : Decidable (NewMutexPre k L adm s reg c g) :=
264	  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
265	      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False ∧
266	    (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify ∧
267	    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
268	    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False ∧
269	    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False ∧
270	    OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False ∧
271	    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False ∧
272	    (∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g) ∧ g ∉ adm ∧
273	    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
274	      ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False ∧
275	    NoCoveringDesc s g)
276	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩,
277	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩⟩
278	
279	/-- `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13): registers the entry `⟨guarded, none⟩`; the
280	kernel state is unchanged and no authority is created (WC4 C13 effect). WC4 C13 states no outcome
281	other than success; only `ok` is defined. -/
282	def NewMutexOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat)
283	    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
284	  s.Live c ∧ NewMutexPre k L adm s reg c g ∧ st' = (s, reg ++ [⟨g, none⟩])
285	
286	/-- `acquire` on entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C16): with the library instantiation of
287	`SyncAuthorized` for the entry, `deriveSync(guarded)` on the registry `reg` and the record of the
288	fresh grant identity `|A|` in the entry. A taken controller (`grant ≠ none`) leaves `acquire` not
289	enabled; WC4 C16 states no other outcome than success, so only `ok` is defined. -/
290	def AcquireOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat)
291	    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
292	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ EntryAuth L s e (s.view c).top ∧
293	    DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L) reg s c e.guarded ∧
294	    st' = (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded, reg.set i { e with grant := some s.A.length })
295	
296	/-- `unlock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C17.1–C17.4): O3 releases the grant and the registry
297	records `grant = none` (WC4 C17 effect). C17.2 and C17.3 are the preconditions of O3 (Spec 1 §62);
298	C17.4 is `CtrlRight`. The controller update is a realization obligation (WC4 C17), not a
299	precondition; only `ok` is defined. -/
300	def UnlockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
301	    Prop :=
302	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e g, reg[i]? = some e ∧ e.Live s ∧ e.grant = some g ∧ ReleasePre (s.view c) g ∧
303	    CtrlRight L s e (s.view c).top ∧
304	    st' = (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g), reg.set i { e with grant := none })
305	
306	/-- `resetLock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C18.1–C18.3): the entry becomes available; the
307	kernel state is unchanged (WC4 C18 effect). WC4 C18.3: "`ControlOf(entry)` resolves to an
308	existing, usable controller **leaf**, as required by C21.3"; the controller-initialization
309	invariant is not a precondition (WC4 C18.3: "established separately for every live entry by
310	C21.7"). Only `ok` is defined. -/
311	def ResetLockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
312	    Prop :=
313	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ (s.view c).ExercisableAt e.guarded .modify ∧
314	    NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded ∧
315	    OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
316	    st' = (s, reg.set i { e with grant := none })
317	
318	/-! ## Labelled steps, runs, encapsulation (WC4 C22, C23) -/
319	
320	/-- Label of a step of the kernel with the synchronization library. -/
321	inductive Label where
322	  | kernel (c : Nat) (op : KernelOp)
323	  | spawn (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
324	  | terminate (c : Nat)
325	  | join (c d : Nat)
326	  | deriveSync (c g : Nat)
327	  | newMutex (c g : Nat) (adm : List Nat)
328	  | acquire (c i : Nat)
329	  | unlock (c i : Nat)
330	  | resetLock (c i : Nat)
331	  | spawnVal (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (vs : List (Nat × Nat))
332	
333	/-- Labelled `ok` step of the concurrent kernel with the synchronization library (WC4 C2, C4,
334	C5, C6–C8, C13, C15–C18; WC4 C23 for the by-value composite): kernel and
335	frame steps keep the registry; raw `deriveSync` runs under the
336	library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` on the current registry (WC4 C14). -/
337	inductive LStep (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Label → SC × SyncReg → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
338	  | kernel {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} :
339	      opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → LStep k L (.kernel c op) (s, reg) (s', reg)
340	  | spawn {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
341	      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawn c ps ls) (s, reg) (s', reg)
342	  | terminate {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} :
343	      TermStep k s c (.ok s') → LStep k L (.terminate c) (s, reg) (s', reg)
344	  | join {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c d : Nat} :
345	      JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → LStep k L (.join c d) (s, reg) (s', reg)
346	  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} :
347	      DeriveSyncStep (libKC k L) reg s c g (.ok s') → LStep k L (.deriveSync c g) (s, reg) (s', reg)
348	  | newMutex {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} {adm : List Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
349	      NewMutexOk k L adm s reg c g st' → LStep k L (.newMutex c g adm) (s, reg) st'
350	  | acquire {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
351	      AcquireOk k L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.acquire c i) (s, reg) st'
352	  | unlock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
353	      UnlockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.unlock c i) (s, reg) st'
354	  | resetLock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
355	      ResetLockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.resetLock c i) (s, reg) st'
356	  | spawnVal {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
357	      {vs : List (Nat × Nat)} :
358	      SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawnVal c ps ls vs) (s, reg) (s', reg)
359	
360	/-- WC4 C22.3 for the source `src` of a transfer in state `st`: for each live entry, `src` is
361	neither the place `slot` holding `guarded`, nor a strict structural subplace of `slot`, nor the
362	controller leaf `ctl`. -/
363	def TransferExcl (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Prop :=
364	  ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 →
365	    OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => ¬ partOf st.1.P src q) True ∧
366	      ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some src
367	
368	/-- Decidability of `TransferExcl` (WC4 C22.3). -/
369	instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Decidable (TransferExcl L st src) := by
370	  unfold TransferExcl; infer_instance
371	
372	/-- WC4 C22.3 for the transfers of the by-value composite (WC4 C23):
373	the source of every transfer phase satisfies `TransferExcl` in the state where that phase starts
374	(WC4 C5.2), the registry being `reg`. -/
375	def EncapVals (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Prop
376	  | _, [] => True
377	  | t, v :: vs => TransferExcl L (t, reg) v.1 ∧ EncapVals L reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs
378	
379	/-- Encapsulation of one step in state `st` (hypothesis on traces, WC4 C22, C23): for each live
380	entry, WC4 C22.1 (`derive`, `split`), C22.2 (raw `deriveSync`), C22.3 (`transfer`, and the
381	transfer phases of the by-value composite) and C22.5 (`endUse` whose place is the controller leaf
382	`ctl` or a strict structural subplace of `slot`). WC4 C22.4 (controller-write protocol) is a
383	realization/interface obligation (WC4 C22) with no content in `S_C`, which has no values (Spec 1
384	§41), and is not represented. -/
385	def Encap (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
386	  | .kernel _ (.derive src _ _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
387	  | .kernel _ (.split src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
388	  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => TransferExcl L st src
389	  | .kernel _ (.endUse p) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some p ∧
390	      OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf st.1.P p q → p = q) True
391	  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs => EncapVals L st.2 c (spawnCreate st.1 c ls) vs
392	  | .deriveSync _ g => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → g ≠ e.guarded
393	  | _ => True
394	
395	/-- Runs of labelled steps. -/
396	inductive LRun (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
397	  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : LRun k L st [] st
398	  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
399	      LStep k L lbl st st₁ → LRun k L st₁ lbls st₂ → LRun k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂
400	
401	/-- `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22, C23: "Any lemma conditional on encapsulation must expose that
402	condition in its theorem statement or the reachable-trace assumptions"): a run every step of which
403	satisfies `Encap` in the state where it is taken. -/
404	inductive EncapsulatedTrace (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
405	    SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
406	  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : EncapsulatedTrace k L st [] st
407	  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
408	      Encap L st lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ → EncapsulatedTrace k L st₁ lbls st₂ →
409	      EncapsulatedTrace k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂
410	
411	/-- An encapsulated trace is a run. -/
412	theorem EncapsulatedTrace.run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
413	    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') : LRun k L st lbls st' := by
414	  induction h with
415	  | nil => exact .nil
416	  | cons _ hs _ ih => exact .cons hs ih
417	
418	/-! ## Theorem 1, last part: `SyncAuthorized` and `deriveSync` without live entry (WC4 C14, C24) -/
419	
420	/-- Theorem 1 (WC4 C14, C24): in a state whose registry has no live entry, the obligation of WC4

import Ern.Concurrency.Sync
import Ern.Concurrency.Transfer

/-!
# Reference synchronization library

Library state separate from `S_C` (WC4 C2, C12), on the pattern of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (Spec
1 §46, §55, §56):

* the registry of `SyncEntry { guarded, grant }` (WC4 C12), liveness of an entry, the positional
  `ControlOf` relationship (WC4 C12) for declared field positions `MutexLayout`;
* `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.1–C21.7) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22);
* the library instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized` on the registry (WC4 C14.1–C14.3), and the
  contract obligation `SyncSound` of WC4 C14 ("cannot be used outside the corresponding valid
  synchronization contract");
* derived operations `newMutex` (C13), `acquire` (C16), `unlock` (C17), `resetLock` (C18);
* labelled library steps, the by-value composite included (WC4 C23), runs, and the encapsulation
  hypothesis `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22.1–C22.3, C22.5; C23), a predicate on runs, never a
  precondition of a kernel operation.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Registry (WC4 C12) -/

/-- Synchronization entry (WC4 C12): the protected authority `guarded` and the recorded grant. -/
structure SyncEntry where
  guarded : Nat
  grant : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Synchronization registry (WC4 C12), library state separate from `S_C`. -/
abbrev SyncReg := List SyncEntry

/-- Declared field positions of the reference mutex value (WC4 C12: "at its declared field
position", `guardedField`, `controlField`): the position of the field holding `guarded` and that of the controller, among the
ordered children of the mutex value. -/
structure MutexLayout where
  guardedField : Nat
  controlField : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An entry is live exactly while `guarded` is active (WC4 C12). -/
def SyncEntry.Live (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop := s.flat.Active e.guarded

/-- Decidability of liveness of an entry (WC4 C12). -/
instance (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Decidable (e.Live s) := by
  unfold SyncEntry.Live; infer_instance

/-- Positional `ControlOf` (WC4 C12): `guarded` is held by the field `h` at position
`guardedField` of the mutex value `m` (the structural parent of `h`); the controller is the child
of `m` at position `controlField`. -/
def ControlOf (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (Holder.place h) =>
    match parentOf s.P h with
    | some m =>
      if (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some h then (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? else none
    | none => none
  | _ => none

/-- The `S3` whose current frame is `f` (WC4 C14: `SyncAuthorized` names the requesting frame;
Spec 1 §43 reads the stack only through its top and membership). -/
def SC.viewAt (s : SC) (f : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := f :: s.frames.filter fun g => decide (g ≠ f) }

/-- WC4 C14.3: the frame `f` has effective and exercisable access to `ControlOf(e)` under the
condition of Spec 1 §68.2: some authority exercisable by `f` in a mode at least `Observe` has a
present effective mode on the controller. -/
def CtrlRight (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    (s.viewAt f).ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ effective s.flat a ctl ≠ none) False

/-- Decidability of the controller fact. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (CtrlRight L s e f) := by
  unfold CtrlRight; infer_instance

/-- The authorization facts of WC4 C14 for an entry: C14.1 (live), C14.2 (`grant = none`), C14.3
(`CtrlRight`). -/
def EntryAuth (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
  e.Live s ∧ e.grant = none ∧ CtrlRight L s e f

/-- Decidability of the library authorization of an entry. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (EntryAuth L s e f) := by
  unfold EntryAuth; infer_instance

/-- Instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, sync_registry, guarded, requesting_frame)` by the
library (WC4 C14, C25): an entry of the registry with the requested `guarded` identity satisfies
the authorization facts C14.1–C14.3. -/
def LibSyncAuthorized (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ EntryAuth L s e f

/-- Decidability of the library instantiation. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
    Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f) := by
  unfold LibSyncAuthorized; infer_instance

/-- The contract `K_C` instantiated by the library (WC4 C14, C25), the registry type being
`SyncReg` (WC4 C2). -/
def libKC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : KC SyncReg :=
  { k with SyncAuthorized := LibSyncAuthorized L }

/-- Decidability of the instantiated predicate. -/
instance (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
    Decidable ((libKC k L).SyncAuthorized reg s g f) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f))

/-- Contract obligation of WC4 C14 ("cannot be used outside the corresponding valid
synchronization contract"), in state `s` with registry `reg`: `SyncAuthorized` holds only for the
`guarded` of a live entry of `reg`. -/
def SyncSound (kc : KC SyncReg) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ g f, kc.SyncAuthorized reg s g f → ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ e.Live s

/-- The library instantiation satisfies the obligation of WC4 C14. -/
theorem libKC_sound (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) :
    SyncSound (libKC k L) reg s :=
  fun _ _ ⟨e, he, hg, hl, _⟩ => ⟨e, he, hg, hl⟩

/-- The holder is a usable place (WC4 C12, C13.1, C21.1). -/
def PlaceUsable (t : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place q => t.Usable q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `PlaceUsable` (WC4 C12). -/
instance (t : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (PlaceUsable t h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold PlaceUsable <;> infer_instance

/-- Spec 1 §65.3 for an authority held by a place `q`: it covers neither a leaf of `q` nor a leaf
of storage transitively owned by `q` (WC4 C13.5). -/
def StoredOK (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  match y.holder with
  | .place q => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∉ footprint P q ∧
      ∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, OwnedIn P q r → l ∉ footprint P r
  | .frame _ => True

/-- Decidability of `StoredOK` (Spec 1 §65.3). -/
instance (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Decidable (StoredOK P y) := by
  unfold StoredOK; split <;> infer_instance

/-- The place `slot` holding `guarded` (WC4 C12). -/
def slotOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (Holder.place h) => some h
  | _ => none

/-! ## Invariants (WC4 C21, C22) -/

/-- Active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf, a leaf of `footprint(guarded)`
(WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C21.5, C22). -/
def CoveringDesc (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ s.flat.ancs j ∧ s.flat.Active j ∧ ∃ l ∈ s.flat.afp j, l ∈ s.flat.afp g

/-- Decidability of `CoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
instance (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (CoveringDesc s g j) := by
  unfold CoveringDesc; infer_instance

/-- No active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf (WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C22). -/
def NoCoveringDesc (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Prop := ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ CoveringDesc s g j

/-- Decidability of `NoCoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
instance (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Decidable (NoCoveringDesc s g) := by
  unfold NoCoveringDesc; infer_instance

/-- `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22). -/
def GrantDiscipline (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded

/-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: distinct live entries (by position in the registry) have distinct
`ControlOf` leaves. -/
def CtlUnique (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry) (ctl : Nat), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
    e.Live s → e'.Live s → ControlOf L s e = some ctl → ControlOf L s e' = some ctl → i = j

/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `slot`: for every live entry, every structural leaf of
the place holding `guarded` is `Init`. -/
def SlotInit (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
    OptP (slotOf s e.guarded) (fun q => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.I l = .init) False

/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `ctl`: for every live entry, the controller leaf
`ControlOf(entry)` is `Init`. -/
def CtlInit (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.I ctl = .init) False

/-- `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.1–C21.7): items 1–5 and 7 over live entries, item 6 over every entry. -/
structure SyncInv (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C21.1: `guarded` is active (liveness), has own mode `Modify`, and is held by a usable
  place. -/
  guarded : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  /-- WC4 C21.2: a recorded grant exists, has origin `guarded` and footprint
  `footprint(guarded)`. -/
  grant : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  /-- WC4 C21.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a usable
  leaf. -/
  control : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  /-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: controller uniqueness among live entries. -/
  ctlUnique : CtlUnique L s reg
  /-- WC4 C21.4, second clause (the guarded-identity uniqueness guard of WC4 C13.7): distinct
  live entries have distinct `guarded` identities. -/
  unique : ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
    e.Live s → e'.Live s →
    e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
  /-- WC4 C21.5, `GrantSubtree`. -/
  grantSubtree : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  /-- WC4 C21.6, `RegBound`, over every entry: the registered `guarded` identity exists (Spec 1
  §38: identities are indices). -/
  regBound : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length
  /-- WC4 C21.7: the structural leaves of `slot` are `Init`. -/
  slotInit : SlotInit s reg
  /-- WC4 C21.7: the controller leaf is `Init`. -/
  ctlInit : CtlInit L s reg

/-! ## Derived operations (WC4 C13, C16–C18) -/

/-- The mutex value `M` of WC4 C12, C13: the immediate structural parent of the place `slot`
holding `guarded`. -/
def mutexOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (Holder.place h) => parentOf s.P h
  | _ => none

/-- Preconditions of `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13.1–C13.10), with `adm` the
identities used by the other live administrations (Spec 1 §56). The interface and realization
obligations of WC4 C13 (C13.3, C13.6, former C13.10) are not represented: WC4 C13 says they "are
not claimed to follow from the authority-only state `S_C`". -/
structure NewMutexPre (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg)
    (c g : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C13.1: `guarded` is active, of own mode `Modify`, and held by a usable place. -/
  guarded : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  /-- WC4 C13.2: ordinary exercisable `Modify` over `guarded` (Spec 1 §43). -/
  exercisable : (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify
  /-- WC4 C13.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a
  usable leaf. -/
  control : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  /-- WC4 C13.4: `footprint(guarded) ∩ footprint(M) = ∅`. -/
  disjointM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False
  /-- WC4 C13.10: every structural leaf of `footprint(M)` is `Init`. -/
  initM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False
  /-- WC4 C13.5: when `guarded` is stored (derived), Spec 1 §65.3 holds: it covers neither a leaf
  of its holder nor a leaf of storage transitively owned by it. -/
  stored : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False
  /-- WC4 C13.6: `K.SharedMutable(ctl)`. -/
  sharedMutable : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False
  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live entry. -/
  unique : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g
  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live administration. -/
  otherAdmin : g ∉ adm
  /-- WC4 C13.8: no other live entry is associated with `ctl`. -/
  ctlUnique : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
    ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False
  /-- WC4 C13.9. -/
  available : NoCoveringDesc s g

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `newMutex` (WC4 C13). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC)
    (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat) : Decidable (NewMutexPre k L adm s reg c g) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False ∧
    (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False ∧
    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False ∧
    (∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g) ∧ g ∉ adm ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
      ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False ∧
    NoCoveringDesc s g)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩⟩

/-- `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13): registers the entry `⟨guarded, none⟩`; the
kernel state is unchanged and no authority is created (WC4 C13 effect). WC4 C13 states no outcome
other than success; only `ok` is defined. -/
def NewMutexOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ NewMutexPre k L adm s reg c g ∧ st' = (s, reg ++ [⟨g, none⟩])

/-- `acquire` on entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C16): with the library instantiation of
`SyncAuthorized` for the entry, `deriveSync(guarded)` on the registry `reg` and the record of the
fresh grant identity `|A|` in the entry. A taken controller (`grant ≠ none`) leaves `acquire` not
enabled; WC4 C16 states no other outcome than success, so only `ok` is defined. -/
def AcquireOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ EntryAuth L s e (s.view c).top ∧
    DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L) reg s c e.guarded ∧
    st' = (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded, reg.set i { e with grant := some s.A.length })

/-- `unlock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C17.1–C17.4): O3 releases the grant and the registry
records `grant = none` (WC4 C17 effect). C17.2 and C17.3 are the preconditions of O3 (Spec 1 §62);
C17.4 is `CtrlRight`. The controller update is a realization obligation (WC4 C17), not a
precondition; only `ok` is defined. -/
def UnlockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
    Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e g, reg[i]? = some e ∧ e.Live s ∧ e.grant = some g ∧ ReleasePre (s.view c) g ∧
    CtrlRight L s e (s.view c).top ∧
    st' = (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g), reg.set i { e with grant := none })

/-- `resetLock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C18.1–C18.3): the entry becomes available; the
kernel state is unchanged (WC4 C18 effect). WC4 C18.3: "`ControlOf(entry)` resolves to an
existing, usable controller **leaf**, as required by C21.3"; the controller-initialization
invariant is not a precondition (WC4 C18.3: "established separately for every live entry by
C21.7"). Only `ok` is defined. -/
def ResetLockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
    Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ (s.view c).ExercisableAt e.guarded .modify ∧
    NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
    st' = (s, reg.set i { e with grant := none })

/-! ## Labelled steps, runs, encapsulation (WC4 C22, C23) -/

/-- Label of a step of the kernel with the synchronization library. -/
inductive Label where
  | kernel (c : Nat) (op : KernelOp)
  | spawn (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | terminate (c : Nat)
  | join (c d : Nat)
  | deriveSync (c g : Nat)
  | newMutex (c g : Nat) (adm : List Nat)
  | acquire (c i : Nat)
  | unlock (c i : Nat)
  | resetLock (c i : Nat)
  | spawnVal (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (vs : List (Nat × Nat))

/-- Labelled `ok` step of the concurrent kernel with the synchronization library (WC4 C2, C4,
C5, C6–C8, C13, C15–C18; WC4 C23 for the by-value composite): kernel and
frame steps keep the registry; raw `deriveSync` runs under the
library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` on the current registry (WC4 C14). -/
inductive LStep (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Label → SC × SyncReg → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} :
      opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → LStep k L (.kernel c op) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | spawn {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawn c ps ls) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | terminate {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} :
      TermStep k s c (.ok s') → LStep k L (.terminate c) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | join {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c d : Nat} :
      JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → LStep k L (.join c d) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} :
      DeriveSyncStep (libKC k L) reg s c g (.ok s') → LStep k L (.deriveSync c g) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | newMutex {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} {adm : List Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      NewMutexOk k L adm s reg c g st' → LStep k L (.newMutex c g adm) (s, reg) st'
  | acquire {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      AcquireOk k L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.acquire c i) (s, reg) st'
  | unlock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      UnlockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.unlock c i) (s, reg) st'
  | resetLock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      ResetLockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.resetLock c i) (s, reg) st'
  | spawnVal {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
      {vs : List (Nat × Nat)} :
      SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawnVal c ps ls vs) (s, reg) (s', reg)

/-- WC4 C22.3 for the source `src` of a transfer in state `st`: for each live entry, `src` is
neither the place `slot` holding `guarded`, nor a strict structural subplace of `slot`, nor the
controller leaf `ctl`. -/
def TransferExcl (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 →
    OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => ¬ partOf st.1.P src q) True ∧
      ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some src

/-- Decidability of `TransferExcl` (WC4 C22.3). -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Decidable (TransferExcl L st src) := by
  unfold TransferExcl; infer_instance

/-- WC4 C22.3 for the transfers of the by-value composite (WC4 C23):
the source of every transfer phase satisfies `TransferExcl` in the state where that phase starts
(WC4 C5.2), the registry being `reg`. -/
def EncapVals (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | t, v :: vs => TransferExcl L (t, reg) v.1 ∧ EncapVals L reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Encapsulation of one step in state `st` (hypothesis on traces, WC4 C22, C23): for each live
entry, WC4 C22.1 (`derive`, `split`), C22.2 (raw `deriveSync`), C22.3 (`transfer`, and the
transfer phases of the by-value composite) and C22.5 (`endUse` whose place is the controller leaf
`ctl` or a strict structural subplace of `slot`). WC4 C22.4 (controller-write protocol) is a
realization/interface obligation (WC4 C22) with no content in `S_C`, which has no values (Spec 1
§41), and is not represented. -/
def Encap (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.derive src _ _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.split src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => TransferExcl L st src
  | .kernel _ (.endUse p) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some p ∧
